Authors: Jiawei Chen, Simin Huang, Jiawei Du, Shuaihang Chen, Yu Tian, Mingjie Wei, Chao Yu, Zhaoxia Yin

Realistic Lip Motion Generation Based on 3D Dynamic Viseme and Coarticulation Modeling for Human-Robot Interaction

Abstract (English): Realistic lip synchronization is essential for the natural human-robot non-verbal interaction of humanoid robots. Motivated by this need, this paper presents a lip motion generation framework based on 3D dynamic viseme and coarticulation modeling. By analyzing Chinese pronunciation theory, a 3D dynamic viseme library is constructed based on the ARKit standard, which offers coherent prior trajectories of lips. To resolve motion conflicts within continuous speech streams, a coarticulation mechanism is developed by incorporating initial-final (Shengmu-Yunmu) decoupling and energy modulation. After developing a strategy to retarget high-dimensional spatial lip motion to a 14-DOF lip actuation system of a humanoid head platform, the efficiency and accuracy of the proposed architecture is experimentally validated and demonstrated with quantitative ablation experiments using the metrics of the Pearson Correlation Coefficient (PCC) and the Mean Absolute Jerk (MAJ). This research offers a lightweight, efficient, and highly practical paradigm for the speech-driven lip motion generation of humanoid robots. The 3D dynamic viseme library and real-world deployment videos are available at {https://github.com/yuesheng21/Phoneme-to-Lip-14DOF}

摘要（中文）: 逼真的唇部同步对于人形机器人自然的人机非语言交互至关重要。基于此需求，本文提出了一种基于三维动态视位模型与协同发音建模的唇部运动生成框架。通过分析汉语发音理论，构建了基于ARKit标准的三维动态视位库，该库提供了连贯的唇部先验轨迹。为解决连续语音流中的运动冲突，我们通过引入声韵母解耦与能量调制机制构建了协同发音模型。在开发了将高维空间唇部运动映射至人形机器人头部平台14自由度唇部驱动系统的重定向策略后，通过皮尔逊相关系数（PCC）和平均绝对加加速度（MAJ）指标的定量消融实验，验证并展示了所提出架构的效能与准确性。本研究为人形机器人的语音驱动唇部运动生成提供了一种轻量化、高效且具备高度实用性的范式。三维动态视位库及实际部署视频已发布于{https://github.com/yuesheng21/Phoneme-to-Lip-14DOF}。

TLDR: This paper presents a framework for generating realistic lip motion on humanoid robots using 3D dynamic visemes and coarticulation modeling, specifically for Chinese speech. It is a technical solution for robot control (facial actuation) in a human-robot interaction context.

简要说明: 本文提出了一种基于3D动态视素和协同发音建模的框架，专门用于为仿人机器人（在中文语境下）生成逼真的唇部运动，以实现自然的人机非语言交互。

Authors: Sheng Li, Jingcheng Huang, Min Li

Not All Tokens See Equally: Perception-Grounded Policy Optimization for Large Vision-Language Models

Abstract (English): While Reinforcement Learning from Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has advanced reasoning in Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs), prevailing frameworks suffer from a foundational methodological flaw: by distributing identical advantages across all generated tokens, these methods inherently dilute the learning signals essential for optimizing the critical, visually-grounded steps of multimodal reasoning. To bridge this gap, we formulate \textit{Token Visual Dependency}, quantifying the causal information gain of visual inputs via the Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence between visual-conditioned and text-only predictive distributions. Revealing that this dependency is highly sparse and semantically pivotal, we introduce Perception-Grounded Policy Optimization (PGPO), which is a novel fine-grained credit assignment framework that dynamically reshapes advantages at the token level. Through a threshold-gated, mass-conserving mechanism, PGPO actively amplifies learning signals for visually-dependent tokens while suppressing gradient noise from linguistic priors. Extensive experiments based on the Qwen2.5-VL series across seven challenging multimodal reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that PGPO boosts models by 18.7% on average. Both theoretical and empirical analyses confirm that PGPO effectively reduces gradient variance, prevents training collapse, and acts as a potent regularizer for robust, perception-grounded multimodal reasoning. Code will be published on https://github.com/Yzk1114/PGPO.

摘要（中文）: 摘要：尽管基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）推动了大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）在推理能力上的进步，但当前主流框架存在一个根本性方法缺陷：通过在所有生成的令牌上分配相同的优势值，这些方法本质上稀释了优化多模态推理中关键视觉基础步骤所必需的学习信号。为弥补这一差距，我们提出“令牌视觉依赖度”的概念，通过视觉条件与纯文本预测分布之间的Kullback-Leibler（KL）散度来量化视觉输入带来的因果信息增益。研究发现这种依赖具有高度稀疏性和语义关键性，据此我们提出感知基础策略优化（PGPO）——一种新颖的细粒度信用分配框架，可在令牌层面动态重塑优势值。通过阈值门控的质量守恒机制，PGPO主动增强对视觉依赖令牌的学习信号，同时抑制来自语言先验的梯度噪声。基于Qwen2.5-VL系列模型在七个具有挑战性的多模态推理基准上进行的广泛实验表明，PGPO平均提升模型性能达18.7%。理论与实证分析均证实，PGPO能有效降低梯度方差、防止训练崩溃，并作为强效正则化器促进鲁棒且感知基础的多模态推理。代码将发布于https://github.com/Yzk1114/PGPO。

TLDR: This paper introduces Perception-Grounded Policy Optimization (PGPO), a novel credit assignment method that dynamically reshapes reinforcement learning advantages at the token level for large vision-language models to improve multimodal reasoning by focusing on visually-dependent tokens.

简要说明: 本文提出了一种感知驱动的策略优化方法（PGPO），通过动态调整标记层面的强化学习优势，以改进大型视觉语言模型的多模态推理能力，重点关注视觉相关的标记。

Authors: Zekai Ye, Qiming Li, Xiaocheng Feng, Ruihan Chen, Ziming Li, Haoyu Ren, Kun Chen, Dandan Tu, Bing Qin

LatentUM: Unleashing the Potential of Interleaved Cross-Modal Reasoning via a Latent-Space Unified Model

Abstract (English): Unified models (UMs) hold promise for their ability to understand and generate content across heterogeneous modalities. Compared to merely generating visual content, the use of UMs for interleaved cross-modal reasoning is more promising and valuable, e.g., for solving understanding problems that require dense visual thinking, improving visual generation through self-reflection, or modeling visual dynamics of the physical world guided by stepwise action interventions. However, existing UMs necessitate pixel decoding as a bridge due to their disjoint visual representations for understanding and generation, which is both ineffective and inefficient. In this paper, we introduce LatentUM, a novel unified model that represents all modalities within a shared semantic latent space, eliminating the need for pixel-space mediation between visual understanding and generation. This design naturally enables flexible interleaved cross-modal reasoning and generation. Beyond improved computational efficiency, the shared representation substantially alleviates codec bias and strengthens cross-modal alignment, allowing LatentUM to achieve state-of-the-art performance on the Visual Spatial Planning benchmark, push the limits of visual generation through self-reflection, and support world modeling by predicting future visual states within the shared semantic latent space.

摘要（中文）: 统一模型（UMs）因其理解和生成跨异构模态内容的能力而展现出广阔前景。与仅生成视觉内容相比，利用UM进行交错式跨模态推理更具前景和价值，例如解决需要密集视觉思维的理解问题、通过自我反思改进视觉生成，或在逐步行动干预的引导下对物理世界的视觉动态进行建模。然而，现有UM由于在理解和生成任务中采用分离的视觉表示，必须依赖像素解码作为桥梁，这既低效又缺乏灵活性。本文提出LatentUM，一种新颖的统一模型，它将所有模态表示在共享的语义潜在空间中，从而消除了视觉理解与生成之间对像素空间中介的需求。这一设计天然支持灵活的交错式跨模态推理与生成。除了提升计算效率外，共享表示显著减轻了编解码偏差并强化了跨模态对齐，使得LatentUM在视觉空间规划基准测试中达到最优性能，通过自我反思突破视觉生成的边界，并能在共享语义潜在空间内预测未来视觉状态以支持世界建模。

TLDR: LatentUM is a unified model using a shared semantic latent space to enable efficient interleaved cross-modal reasoning and generation, claiming state-of-the-art performance on visual spatial planning and potential for world modeling.

简要说明: LatentUM是一种在共享语义潜在空间中实现跨模态推理与生成的统一模型，宣称在视觉空间规划任务中达到SOTA性能，并具有世界建模的潜力。

Authors: Jiachun Jin, Zetong Zhou, Xiao Yang, Hao Zhang, Pengfei Liu, Jun Zhu, Zhijie Deng

Model-Based Reinforcement Learning for Control under Time-Varying Dynamics

Abstract (English): Learning-based control methods typically assume stationary system dynamics, an assumption often violated in real-world systems due to drift, wear, or changing operating conditions. We study reinforcement learning for control under time-varying dynamics. We consider a continual model-based reinforcement learning setting in which an agent repeatedly learns and controls a dynamical system whose transition dynamics evolve across episodes. We analyze the problem using Gaussian process dynamics models under frequentist variation-budget assumptions. Our analysis shows that persistent non-stationarity requires explicitly limiting the influence of outdated data to maintain calibrated uncertainty and meaningful dynamic regret guarantees. Motivated by these insights, we propose a practical optimistic model-based reinforcement learning algorithm with adaptive data buffer mechanisms and demonstrate improved performance on continuous control benchmarks with non-stationary dynamics.

摘要（中文）: 基于学习型控制方法通常假设系统动力学是静态的，这一假设在实际系统中常因系统漂移、磨损或运行条件变化而失效。我们研究了时变动力学条件下的强化学习控制问题，考虑一种持续的基于模型强化学习场景：智能体需反复学习并控制一个其状态转移动力学随任务周期不断演变的动态系统。通过采用高斯过程动力学模型并在频率学派变化预算假设下进行分析，我们发现持续性非平稳特征要求明确限制过时数据的影响，以保持校准化的不确定性度量并实现有效的动态遗憾保证。基于这些发现，我们提出了一种具有自适应数据缓冲机制的实用型乐观模型强化学习算法，并在具有非平稳动力学特征的连续控制基准测试中验证了其性能提升。

TLDR: The paper proposes a model-based reinforcement learning algorithm for control tasks with non-stationary system dynamics, using Gaussian process models and an adaptive data buffer mechanism to handle time-varying dynamics across episodes.

简要说明: 该论文提出了一种用于处理非平稳系统动态控制任务的基于模型的强化学习算法，使用高斯过程模型和自适应数据缓冲机制来处理不同时间段的动态变化。

Authors: Klemens Iten, Bruce Lee, Chenhao Li, Lenart Treven, Andreas Krause, Bhavya Sukhija

Integrated Identification of Collaborative Robots for Robot Assisted 3D Printing Processes

Abstract (English): In recent years, the integration of additive manufacturing (AM) and industrial robotics has opened new perspectives for the production of complex components, particularly in the automotive sector. Robot-assisted additive manufacturing processes overcome the dimensional and kinematic limitations of traditional Cartesian systems, enabling non-planar deposition and greater geometric flexibility. However, the increasing dynamic complexity of robotic manipulators introduces challenges related to precision, control, and error prediction. This work proposes a model-based approach equipped with an integrated identification procedure of the system's parameters, including the robot, the actuators and the controllers. We show that the integrated modeling procedure allows to obtain a reliable dynamic model even in the presence of sensory and programming limitations typical of collaborative robots. The manipulator's dynamic model is identified through an integrated five step methodology: starting with geometric and inertial analysis, followed by friction and controller parameters identification, all the way to the remaining parameters identification. The proposed procedure intrinsically ensures the physical consistency of the identified parameters. The identification approach is validated on a real world case study involving a 6-Degrees-Of-Freedom (DoFs) collaborative robot used in a thermoplastic extrusion process. The very good matching between the experimental results given by actual robot and those given by the identified model shows the potential enhancement of precision, control, and error prediction in Robot Assisted 3D Printing Processes.

摘要（中文）: 近年来，增材制造与工业机器人技术的融合为复杂构件（尤其是汽车领域）的生产开辟了新的前景。机器人辅助增材制造工艺克服了传统笛卡尔系统在尺寸和运动学上的局限性，实现了非平面材料沉积并提升了几何灵活性。然而，机器人操纵器日益增长的动态复杂性给精度控制、运动控制及误差预测带来了挑战。本研究提出一种基于模型的系统化方法，并配备了集成式系统参数识别流程，涵盖机器人本体、执行器及控制器模块。研究表明，即使在协作机器人普遍存在的传感与编程限制条件下，该集成建模方法仍能构建可靠的动态模型。机器人动态模型的识别通过集成化五步法实现：从几何与惯性分析开始，逐步完成摩擦参数识别、控制器参数识别，直至剩余参数的全方位辨识。该方法从本质上保证了识别参数的物理一致性。识别流程在一个真实案例研究中得到验证，该案例涉及一台用于热塑性挤出工艺的六自由度协作机器人。实际机器人实验结果与识别模型输出结果的高度吻合，证明了该方法在机器人辅助3D打印过程中提升精度控制、运动控制及误差预测能力的巨大潜力。

TLDR: This paper presents a model-based identification procedure for the dynamic parameters of a collaborative robot used in a 3D printing process, aiming to improve control and precision.

简要说明: 本文提出了一种用于协作机器人（用于3D打印过程）动力学参数的基于模型的辨识方法，旨在提高控制精度和误差预测能力。

Authors: Alessandro Dimauro, Davide Tebaldi, Fabio Pini, Luigi Biagiotti, Francesco Leali

DriveDreamer-Policy: A Geometry-Grounded World-Action Model for Unified Generation and Planning

Abstract (English): Recently, world-action models (WAM) have emerged to bridge vision-language-action (VLA) models and world models, unifying their reasoning and instruction-following capabilities and spatio-temporal world modeling. However, existing WAM approaches often focus on modeling 2D appearance or latent representations, with limited geometric grounding-an essential element for embodied systems operating in the physical world. We present DriveDreamer-Policy, a unified driving world-action model that integrates depth generation, future video generation, and motion planning within a single modular architecture. The model employs a large language model to process language instructions, multi-view images, and actions, followed by three lightweight generators that produce depth, future video, and actions. By learning a geometry-aware world representation and using it to guide both future prediction and planning within a unified framework, the proposed model produces more coherent imagined futures and more informed driving actions, while maintaining modularity and controllable latency. Experiments on the Navsim v1 and v2 benchmarks demonstrate that DriveDreamer-Policy achieves strong performance on both closed-loop planning and world generation tasks. In particular, our model reaches 89.2 PDMS on Navsim v1 and 88.7 EPDMS on Navsim v2, outperforming existing world-model-based approaches while producing higher-quality future video and depth predictions. Ablation studies further show that explicit depth learning provides complementary benefits to video imagination and improves planning robustness.

摘要（中文）: 近年来，世界行动模型（WAM）应运而生，旨在连接视觉-语言-行动（VLA）模型与世界模型，统一其推理与指令遵循能力以及时空世界建模能力。然而，现有WAM方法多聚焦于二维外观或潜在表征建模，对几何基础——这一在物理世界中运行的具身系统关键要素——的关注较为有限。本文提出DriveDreamer-Policy，一种统一的驾驶世界行动模型，将深度生成、未来视频生成与运动规划集成于单一模块化架构中。该模型采用大型语言模型处理语言指令、多视角图像与动作序列，随后通过三个轻量级生成器分别产生深度信息、未来视频与动作决策。通过习得几何感知的世界表征，并利用其在统一框架中指导未来预测与规划，本模型能够生成更连贯的想象未来场景与更具前瞻性的驾驶行为，同时保持模块化特性与可控延迟。在Navsim v1与v2基准测试上的实验表明，DriveDreamer-Policy在闭环规划与世界生成任务上均表现出强劲性能。特别地，我们的模型在Navsim v1上达到89.2 PDMS，在Navsim v2上达到88.7 EPDMS，其性能优于现有基于世界模型的方法，同时能生成更高质量的未来视频与深度预测。消融研究进一步证明，显式深度学习为视频想象提供互补性增益，并提升了规划鲁棒性。

TLDR: DriveDreamer-Policy is a unified driving world-action model that integrates depth generation, future video generation, and motion planning within a single modular architecture, using a geometry-aware world representation to guide future prediction and action planning.

简要说明: DriveDreamer-Policy是一个统一的驾驶世界-动作模型，它将深度生成、未来视频生成和运动规划集成在一个模块化架构中，利用几何感知的世界表征来指导未来预测和动作规划。

Authors: Yang Zhou, Xiaofeng Wang, Hao Shao, Letian Wang, Guosheng Zhao, Jiangnan Shao, Jiagang Zhu, Tingdong Yu, Zheng Zhu, Guan Huang, Steven L. Waslander

A soft and lightweight fabric-based pneumatic interface for multimodal fingertip tactile feedback

Abstract (English): Wearable fingertip haptic devices are critical for realistic interaction in virtual reality, augmented reality, and teleoperation, yet existing approaches struggle to simultaneously achieve adequate tactile output, low mass, simple fabrication, and untethered portability. Here we show that fabric-based pneumatic actuation can address this gap. Our device comprises four pneumatic chambers fabricated from thermoplastic polyurethane-coated fabric via computer numerical control heat-sealing, yielding a soft, conformable interface weighing 2.1 g that operates untethered with a wrist-mounted control unit. Mechanical and dynamic characterization confirms that the fabric actuators produce sufficient force, displacement, and bandwidth for fingertip tactile rendering. A psychophysical study with 15 participants demonstrates classification accuracy exceeding 90% across three distinct tactile modes -- contact configuration, directional sliding, and vibrotactile frequency. These findings establish fabric-based pneumatic actuation as a viable technology route for lightweight, low-cost, and multimodal fingertip haptic interfaces.

摘要（中文）: 可穿戴指尖触觉设备对于虚拟现实、增强现实及遥操作中的真实交互至关重要，但现有技术难以同时实现充足的触觉输出、轻量化、简易制造和无束缚便携性。本研究证明基于织物的气动驱动技术能够填补这一空白。该设备由四个气动腔室构成，采用热塑性聚氨酯涂层织物通过计算机数控热封工艺制造，形成仅重2.1克的柔软适形界面，配合腕戴式控制单元实现无线操作。机械与动态特性表征证实，织物致动器能产生满足指尖触觉渲染所需的足够力度、位移与带宽。一项包含15名参与者的心理物理学研究表明，在接触构型、定向滑动和振动触觉频率三种不同触觉模式下，被试者的分类准确率均超过90%。这些发现确立了基于织物的气动驱动技术可作为实现轻量化、低成本、多模态指尖触觉界面的可行技术路径。

TLDR: This paper presents a lightweight, fabric-based pneumatic haptic interface for the fingertip, designed for VR/AR and teleoperation. It demonstrates high classification accuracy across multiple tactile feedback modes.

简要说明: 本文提出了一种基于织物的轻量级气动指尖触觉接口，用于VR/AR和遥操作，并在多种触觉反馈模式下展示了高分类准确性。

Authors: Rui Chen, Daniele Leonardis, Antonio Frisoli

Open-loop POMDP Simplification and Safe Skipping of Replanning with Formal Performance Guarantees

Abstract (English): Partially Observable Markov Decision Processes (POMDPs) provide a principled mathematical framework for decision-making under uncertainty. However, the exact solution to POMDPs is computationally intractable. In this paper, we address the computational intractability by introducing a novel framework for adaptive open-loop simplification with formal performance guarantees. Our method adaptively interleaves open-loop and closed-loop planning via a topology-based belief tree, enabling a significant reduction in planning complexity. The key contribution lies in the derivation of efficiently computable bounds which provide formal guarantees and can be used to ensure that our simplification can identify the immediate optimal action of the original POMDP problem. Our framework therefore provides computationally tractable performance guarantees for macro-actions within POMDPs. Furthermore, we propose a novel framework for safely skipping replanning during execution, supported by theoretical guarantees on multi-step open-loop action sequences. To the best of our knowledge, this framework is the first to address skipping replanning with formal performance guarantees. Practical online solvers for our proposed simplification are developed, including a sampling-based solver and an anytime solver. Empirical results demonstrate substantial computational speedups while maintaining provable performance guarantees, advancing the tractability and efficiency of POMDP planning.

摘要（中文）: 部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（POMDPs）为不确定性环境下的决策问题提供了严谨的数学框架。然而，求解POMDP的精确解在计算上是不可行的。本文通过提出一种具有形式化性能保证的自适应开环简化框架，以应对计算复杂性问题。该方法通过基于拓扑的信念树自适应地交织开环与闭环规划，从而显著降低规划复杂度。核心贡献在于推导出可高效计算的边界条件，这些边界不仅提供形式化保证，还能确保我们的简化方法能识别原始POMDP问题的最优即时动作。因此，本框架为POMDP中的宏动作提供了可计算处理的性能保证。此外，我们提出了一种在执行阶段安全跳过重规划的新框架，该框架通过理论保证支持多步开环动作序列的可靠性。据我们所知，这是首个通过形式化性能保证解决重规划跳过问题的框架。针对所提出的简化方法，我们开发了实用的在线求解器，包括基于采样的求解器和任意时间求解器。实验结果表明，在保持可证明性能保证的同时，该方法实现了显著的计算加速，从而推进了POMDP规划的可处理性与效率。

TLDR: Proposes a framework for adaptively simplifying POMDP planning by interleaving open-loop and closed-loop methods, with theoretical performance guarantees and techniques to skip replanning, aiming to improve computational tractability.

简要说明: 提出了一个POMDP规划自适应简化框架，通过交错开环和闭环规划，并带有理论性能保证和跳过重规划的技术，旨在提高计算可行性。

Authors: Da Kong, Vadim Indelman

ActionParty: Multi-Subject Action Binding in Generative Video Games

Abstract (English): Recent advances in video diffusion have enabled the development of "world models" capable of simulating interactive environments. However, these models are largely restricted to single-agent settings, failing to control multiple agents simultaneously in a scene. In this work, we tackle a fundamental issue of action binding in existing video diffusion models, which struggle to associate specific actions with their corresponding subjects. For this purpose, we propose ActionParty, an action controllable multi-subject world model for generative video games. It introduces subject state tokens, i.e. latent variables that persistently capture the state of each subject in the scene. By jointly modeling state tokens and video latents with a spatial biasing mechanism, we disentangle global video frame rendering from individual action-controlled subject updates. We evaluate ActionParty on the Melting Pot benchmark, demonstrating the first video world model capable of controlling up to seven players simultaneously across 46 diverse environments. Our results show significant improvements in action-following accuracy and identity consistency, while enabling robust autoregressive tracking of subjects through complex interactions.

摘要（中文）: 近年来视频扩散模型的进展使得能够模拟交互环境的"世界模型"得以发展。然而，这些模型大多局限于单智能体场景，无法同时控制场景中的多个智能体。本文针对现有视频扩散模型中动作绑定的基础性问题展开研究，这些模型难以将特定动作与其对应的主体进行关联。为此，我们提出ActionParty——一种面向生成式视频游戏的动作可控多主体世界模型。该模型引入了主体状态标记，即持续捕捉场景中每个主体状态的潜在变量。通过结合空间偏置机制对状态标记和视频潜在表示进行联合建模，我们实现了全局视频帧渲染与个体动作控制的主体更新之间的解耦。在Melting Pot基准测试中，ActionParty展示了首个能够同时控制多达七个智能体、覆盖46种不同环境的视频世界模型。实验结果表明，该方法在动作执行准确性和身份一致性方面取得显著提升，同时能够通过复杂交互实现鲁棒的自回归主体追踪。

TLDR: ActionParty is a video diffusion world model that introduces subject state tokens and a spatial biasing mechanism to enable multi-subject action control in generative video games, improving action-following and identity consistency in complex environments.

简要说明: ActionParty 是一种视频扩散世界模型，通过引入主体状态标记和空间偏置机制，在生成式视频游戏中实现多主体动作控制，在复杂交互环境中显著提升了动作跟随准确性和身份一致性。

Authors: Alexander Pondaven, Ziyi Wu, Igor Gilitschenski, Philip Torr, Sergey Tulyakov, Fabio Pizzati, Aliaksandr Siarohin

Steerable Visual Representations

Abstract (English): Pretrained Vision Transformers (ViTs) such as DINOv2 and MAE provide generic image features that can be applied to a variety of downstream tasks such as retrieval, classification, and segmentation. However, such representations tend to focus on the most salient visual cues in the image, with no way to direct them toward less prominent concepts of interest. In contrast, Multimodal LLMs can be guided with textual prompts, but the resulting representations tend to be language-centric and lose their effectiveness for generic visual tasks. To address this, we introduce Steerable Visual Representations, a new class of visual representations, whose global and local features can be steered with natural language. While most vision-language models (e.g., CLIP) fuse text with visual features after encoding (late fusion), we inject text directly into the layers of the visual encoder (early fusion) via lightweight cross-attention. We introduce benchmarks for measuring representational steerability, and demonstrate that our steerable visual features can focus on any desired objects in an image while preserving the underlying representation quality. Our method also matches or outperforms dedicated approaches on anomaly detection and personalized object discrimination, exhibiting zero-shot generalization to out-of-distribution tasks.

摘要（中文）: 诸如DINOv2和MAE等预训练的视觉变换器（ViTs）能够提供适用于多种下游任务（如检索、分类和分割）的通用图像特征。然而，这些表征往往聚焦于图像中最显著的视觉线索，无法引导其关注那些不显著但感兴趣的概念。相比之下，多模态大语言模型（LLMs）可以通过文本提示进行引导，但由此产生的表征往往以语言为中心，在通用视觉任务中失去其有效性。为解决这一问题，我们提出了可引导的视觉表征，这是一种新型视觉表征方法，其全局和局部特征均可通过自然语言进行引导。大多数视觉语言模型（如CLIP）在编码后融合文本与视觉特征（后期融合），而我们的方法则通过轻量级跨注意力机制，将文本直接注入视觉编码器的各层中（早期融合）。我们引入了用于衡量表征可引导性的基准测试，并证明我们的可引导视觉特征能够在保持底层表征质量的同时，聚焦于图像中任意指定的目标对象。此外，我们的方法在异常检测和个性化对象判别等任务上，与专用方法的表现相当或更优，并展现出对分布外任务的零样本泛化能力。

TLDR: This paper introduces Steerable Visual Representations, which use early text injection via cross-attention to allow natural language to steer the global and local features of a visual encoder, enabling focus on less prominent image concepts while preserving generic visual task performance.

简要说明: 该论文提出了一种可引导的视觉表示方法，通过跨注意力的早期文本注入，使自然语言能够引导视觉编码器的全局和局部特征，从而聚焦于图像中不太显著的概念，同时保持通用视觉任务的性能。

Authors: Jona Ruthardt, Manu Gaur, Deva Ramanan, Makarand Tapaswi, Yuki M. Asano

Leveraging the Value of Information in POMDP Planning

Abstract (English): Partially observable Markov decision processes (POMDPs) offer a principled formalism for planning under state and transition uncertainty. Despite advances made towards solving large POMDPs, obtaining performant policies under limited planning time remains a major challenge due to the curse of dimensionality and the curse of history. For many POMDP problems, the value of information (VOI) - the expected performance gain from reasoning about observations - varies over the belief space. We introduce a dynamic programming framework that exploits this structure by conditionally processing observations based on the value of information at each belief. Building on this framework, we propose Value of Information Monte Carlo planning (VOIMCP), a Monte Carlo Tree Search algorithm that allocates computational effort more efficiently by selectively disregarding observation information when the VOI is low, avoiding unnecessary branching of observations. We provide theoretical guarantees on the near-optimality of our VOI reasoning framework and derive non-asymptotic convergence bounds for VOIMCP. Simulation evaluations demonstrate that VOIMCP outperforms baselines on several POMDP benchmarks.

摘要（中文）: 部分可观察马尔可夫决策过程（POMDPs）为状态和转移不确定性下的规划提供了一种原则性的形式化方法。尽管在求解大规模POMDPs方面已取得进展，但由于维数灾难和历史灾难，在有限规划时间内获得高性能策略仍是一个主要挑战。对于许多POMDP问题，信息价值（VOI）——即通过观测推理所能获得的预期性能增益——会随信念空间的变化而不同。本文提出一种动态规划框架，该框架通过基于各信念点的信息价值有条件地处理观测数据，从而利用这一结构特性。在此框架基础上，我们进一步提出信息价值蒙特卡洛规划算法（VOIMCP），这是一种蒙特卡洛树搜索算法，通过在信息价值较低时有选择地忽略观测信息，避免不必要的观测分支，从而更高效地分配计算资源。我们为信息价值推理框架提供了理论上的近最优性保证，并推导出VOIMCP的非渐近收敛界。仿真评估表明，在多个POMDP基准测试中，VOIMCP均优于基线方法。

TLDR: This paper introduces a novel POMDP planning algorithm called VOIMCP that dynamically allocates computational effort based on the value of information, reducing unnecessary observation branching to improve planning efficiency under limited time.

简要说明: 本文提出了一种新的POMDP规划算法VOIMCP，该算法基于信息价值动态分配计算资源，通过减少不必要的观测分支来提高有限时间内的规划效率。

Authors: Zakariya Laouar, Qi Heng Ho, Zachary Sunberg

A3R: Agentic Affordance Reasoning via Cross-Dimensional Evidence in 3D Gaussian Scenes

Abstract (English): Affordance reasoning in 3D Gaussian scenes aims to identify the region that supports the action specified by a given text instruction in complex environments. Existing methods typically cast this problem as one-shot prediction from static scene observations, assuming sufficient evidence is already available for reasoning. However, in complex 3D scenes, many failure cases arise not from weak prediction capacity, but from incomplete task-relevant evidence under fixed observations. To address this limitation, we reformulate fine-grained affordance reasoning as a sequential evidence acquisition process, where ambiguity is progressively reduced through complementary 3D geometric and 2D semantic evidence. Building on this formulation, we propose A3R, an agentic affordance reasoning framework that enables an MLLM-based policy to iteratively select evidence acquisition actions and update the affordance belief through cross-dimensional evidence acquisition. To optimize such sequential decision making, we further introduce a GRPO-based policy learning strategy that improves evidence acquisition efficiency and reasoning accuracy. Extensive experiments on scene-level benchmarks show that A3R consistently surpasses static one-shot baselines, demonstrating the advantage of agentic cross-dimensional evidence acquisition for fine-grained affordance reasoning in complex 3D Gaussian scenes.

摘要（中文）: 三维高斯场景中的可供性推理旨在识别复杂环境中支持给定文本指令所指定动作的区域。现有方法通常将这一问题视为基于静态场景观测的一次性预测，假定已有足够证据支撑推理。然而，在复杂三维场景中，许多失败案例并非源于预测能力不足，而是由于固定观测条件下任务相关证据的缺失。为突破这一局限，我们将细粒度可供性推理重新定义为序列化证据获取过程：通过互补的三维几何证据与二维语义证据逐步消解歧义。基于此框架，我们提出A3R——一种能动的可供性推理框架，其基于多模态大语言模型的策略模块可迭代选择证据获取动作，并通过跨维度证据采集持续更新可供性认知。为进一步优化序列决策过程，我们引入基于GRPO的策略学习策略，显著提升证据获取效率与推理精度。在场景级基准测试上的大量实验表明，A3R持续超越静态一次性预测基线，验证了能动跨维度证据获取机制在复杂三维高斯场景中实现细粒度可供性推理的优越性。

TLDR: The paper proposes A3R, an agentic framework that uses an MLLM-based policy to iteratively acquire 3D geometric and 2D semantic evidence for fine-grained affordance reasoning in 3D Gaussian scenes, improving over static one-shot prediction methods.

简要说明: 该论文提出A3R，一种基于MLLM策略的智能框架，通过迭代获取三维几何和二维语义证据，在复杂三维高斯场景中执行精细的物性推理，优于静态的一步预测方法。

Authors: Di Li, Jie Feng, Guanbin Li, Ronghua Shang, Yuhui Zheng, Weisheng Dong, Guangming Shi

MonoSAOD: Monocular 3D Object Detection with Sparsely Annotated Label

Abstract (English): Monocular 3D object detection has achieved impressive performance on densely annotated datasets. However, it struggles when only a fraction of objects are labeled due to the high cost of 3D annotation. This sparsely annotated setting is common in real-world scenarios where annotating every object is impractical. To address this, we propose a novel framework for sparsely annotated monocular 3D object detection with two key modules. First, we propose Road-Aware Patch Augmentation (RAPA), which leverages sparse annotations by augmenting segmented object patches onto road regions while preserving 3D geometric consistency. Second, we propose Prototype-Based Filtering (PBF), which generates high-quality pseudo-labels by filtering predictions through prototype similarity and depth uncertainty. It maintains global 2D RoI feature prototypes and selects pseudo-labels that are both feature-consistent with learned prototypes and have reliable depth estimates. Our training strategy combines geometry-preserving augmentation with prototype-guided pseudo-labeling to achieve robust detection under sparse supervision. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method. The source code is available at https://github.com/VisualAIKHU/MonoSAOD .

摘要（中文）: 单目3D目标检测在密集标注数据集上取得了显著性能。然而，由于3D标注成本高昂，当仅部分物体被标注时，该技术面临挑战。这种稀疏标注的场景在现实世界中十分常见，因为对每个物体进行标注并不现实。为此，我们提出了一种新颖的稀疏标注单目3D目标检测框架，包含两个核心模块。首先，我们提出了道路感知补丁增强模块，通过将分割出的物体补丁增强到道路区域并保持3D几何一致性，从而有效利用稀疏标注。其次，我们提出了原型过滤模块，通过原型相似性和深度不确定性过滤预测结果，生成高质量伪标签。该模块维护全局二维感兴趣区域特征原型，并筛选出既与学习到的原型特征一致，又具有可靠深度估计的伪标签。我们的训练策略将几何保持增强与原型引导的伪标签生成相结合，实现了稀疏监督下的鲁棒检测。大量实验验证了所提方法的有效性。源代码已公开于https://github.com/VisualAIKHU/MonoSAOD。

TLDR: A novel method for monocular 3D object detection using sparse annotations, featuring geometry-preserving data augmentation and prototype-guided pseudo-labeling.

简要说明: 一种利用稀疏标注的端到端单目3D目标检测新方法，提出了几何感知数据增强和原型引导伪标签生成两大模块，以降低标注成本。

Authors: Junyoung Jung, Seokwon Kim, Jun Uk Kim

EgoFlow: Gradient-Guided Flow Matching for Egocentric 6DoF Object Motion Generation

Abstract (English): Understanding and predicting object motion from egocentric video is fundamental to embodied perception and interaction. However, generating physically consistent 6DoF trajectories remains challenging due to occlusions, fast motion, and the lack of explicit physical reasoning in existing generative models. We present EgoFlow, a flow-matching framework that synthesizes realistic and physically plausible trajectories conditioned on multimodal egocentric observations. EgoFlow employs a hybrid Mamba-Transformer-Perceiver architecture to jointly model temporal dynamics, scene geometry, and semantic intent, while a gradient-guided inference process enforces differentiable physical constraints such as collision avoidance and motion smoothness. This combination yields coherent and controllable motion generation without post-hoc filtering or additional supervision. Experiments on real-world datasets HD-EPIC, EgoExo4D, and HOT3D show that EgoFlow outperforms diffusion-based and transformer baselines in accuracy, generalization, and physical realism, reducing collision rates by up to 79%, and strong generalization to unseen scenes. Our results highlight the promise of flow-based generative modeling for scalable and physically grounded egocentric motion understanding.

摘要（中文）: 从以自我为中心的视角理解和预测物体运动是具身感知与交互的基础任务。然而，由于遮挡、快速运动以及现有生成模型缺乏显式物理推理，生成物理一致的六自由度轨迹仍面临挑战。我们提出EgoFlow——一种基于流匹配的框架，能够通过多模态第一视角观测合成真实且物理合理的运动轨迹。该框架采用混合式Mamba-Transformer-Perceiver架构，联合建模时序动态、场景几何与语义意图，同时通过梯度引导的推理过程强化可微分物理约束（如避障和运动平滑性）。这种设计实现了连贯可控的运动生成，无需后验滤波或额外监督。在真实世界数据集HD-EPIC、EgoExo4D和HOT3D上的实验表明，EgoFlow在准确性、泛化性和物理真实性方面均优于基于扩散模型和Transformer的基线方法，碰撞率降低最高达79%，并在未见场景中表现出强泛化能力。本研究成果揭示了基于流的生成模型在可扩展且具有物理基础的自我中心运动理解方面的巨大潜力。

TLDR: EgoFlow is a flow-matching framework for generating physically plausible 6DoF object trajectories from egocentric video, using a hybrid architecture and gradient-guided inference to enforce physical constraints.

简要说明: EgoFlow 是一个流匹配框架，用于从第一人称视角视频生成物理上合理的 6DoF 物体轨迹，采用混合架构和梯度引导推理来强制执行物理约束。

Authors: Abhishek Saroha, Huajian Zeng, Xingxing Zuo, Daniel Cremers, Xi Wang

Auction-Based Online Policy Adaptation for Evolving Objectives

Abstract (English): We consider multi-objective reinforcement learning problems where objectives come from an identical family -- such as the class of reachability objectives -- and may appear or disappear at runtime. Our goal is to design adaptive policies that can efficiently adjust their behaviors as the set of active objectives changes. To solve this problem, we propose a modular framework where each objective is supported by a selfish local policy, and coordination is achieved through a novel auction-based mechanism: policies bid for the right to execute their actions, with bids reflecting the urgency of the current state. The highest bidder selects the action, enabling a dynamic and interpretable trade-off among objectives. Going back to the original adaptation problem, when objectives change, the system adapts by simply adding or removing the corresponding policies. Moreover, as objectives arise from the same family, identical copies of a parameterized policy can be deployed, facilitating immediate adaptation at runtime. We show how the selfish local policies can be computed by turning the problem into a general-sum game, where the policies compete against each other to fulfill their own objectives. To succeed, each policy must not only optimize its own objective, but also reason about the presence of other goals and learn to produce calibrated bids that reflect relative priority. In our implementation, the policies are trained concurrently using proximal policy optimization (PPO). We evaluate on Atari Assault and a gridworld-based path-planning task with dynamic targets. Our method achieves substantially better performance than monolithic policies trained with PPO.

摘要（中文）: 摘要：我们研究多目标强化学习问题，其中目标来自同一族（如可达性目标类），且可能在运行时动态出现或消失。我们的目标是设计自适应策略，使其能够随着活跃目标集合的变化而高效调整行为。为解决此问题，我们提出一个模块化框架：每个目标由自私的局部策略支持，并通过一种新颖的拍卖机制实现协调——各策略通过竞价争夺行动执行权，出价反映了当前状态的紧急程度。出价最高者选择行动，从而在目标间实现动态且可解释的权衡。回到原始适应问题，当目标发生变化时，系统仅需添加或移除对应策略即可完成调整。此外，由于目标源自同一族，可部署参数化策略的相同副本，从而在运行时实现即时适应。我们展示了如何通过将问题转化为广义和博弈来计算自私的局部策略：各策略为达成自身目标相互竞争。为取得成功，每个策略不仅需优化自身目标，还需推理其他目标的存在，并学习生成反映相对优先级的校准出价。在实现中，我们使用近端策略优化（PPO）并发训练策略。我们在Atari Assault和基于网格世界的动态目标路径规划任务中评估方法，结果显示本方法的性能显著优于使用PPO训练的单一策略。

TLDR: The paper proposes an auction-based online policy adaptation framework for multi-objective RL, where selfish local policies bid for action control to handle dynamic objectives. It uses concurrent PPO training and is evaluated on Atari and gridworld tasks.

简要说明: 该论文提出了一种用于多目标强化学习的基于拍卖的在线策略适应框架，其中自私的局部策略通过竞标获得行动控制权以处理动态目标。它使用并行的PPO训练，并在Atari和网格世界任务上进行了评估。

Authors: Guruprerana Shabadi, Kaushik Mallik

UniDriveVLA: Unifying Understanding, Perception, and Action Planning for Autonomous Driving

Abstract (English): Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have recently emerged in autonomous driving, with the promise of leveraging rich world knowledge to improve the cognitive capabilities of driving systems. However, adapting such models for driving tasks currently faces a critical dilemma between spatial perception and semantic reasoning. Consequently, existing VLA systems are forced into suboptimal compromises: directly adopting 2D Vision-Language Models yields limited spatial perception, whereas enhancing them with 3D spatial representations often impairs the native reasoning capacity of VLMs. We argue that this dilemma largely stems from the coupled optimization of spatial perception and semantic reasoning within shared model parameters. To overcome this, we propose UniDriveVLA, a Unified Driving Vision-Language-Action model based on Mixture-of-Transformers that addresses the perception-reasoning conflict via expert decoupling. Specifically, it comprises three experts for driving understanding, scene perception, and action planning, which are coordinated through masked joint attention. In addition, we combine a sparse perception paradigm with a three-stage progressive training strategy to improve spatial perception while maintaining semantic reasoning capability. Extensive experiments show that UniDriveVLA achieves state-of-the-art performance in open-loop evaluation on nuScenes and closed-loop evaluation on Bench2Drive. Moreover, it demonstrates strong performance across a broad range of perception, prediction, and understanding tasks, including 3D detection, online mapping, motion forecasting, and driving-oriented VQA, highlighting its broad applicability as a unified model for autonomous driving. Code and model have been released at https://github.com/xiaomi-research/unidrivevla

摘要（中文）: 视觉-语言-行为（VLA）模型近期在自动驾驶领域崭露头角，其有望利用丰富的世界知识提升驾驶系统的认知能力。然而，当前此类模型在适应驾驶任务时面临空间感知与语义推理间的关键困境。现有VLA系统因此被迫做出次优折衷：直接采用2D视觉-语言模型会导致空间感知受限，而引入3D空间表征增强又常削弱VLM原有的推理能力。我们认为这一困境主要源于空间感知与语义推理在共享模型参数中的耦合优化。为此，我们提出UniDriveVLA——一种基于混合专家Transformer的统一驾驶视觉-语言-行为模型，通过专家解耦机制解决感知与推理的冲突。该模型包含驾驶理解、场景感知和动作规划三个专家模块，通过掩码联合注意力机制进行协同工作。此外，我们结合稀疏感知范式与三阶段渐进训练策略，在提升空间感知能力的同时保持语义推理性能。大量实验表明，UniDriveVLA在nuScenes数据集的开环评估和Bench2Drive平台的闭环测试中均达到最先进水平。该模型在感知、预测与理解等广泛任务中均展现强大性能，包括3D检测、在线建图、运动轨迹预测和驾驶导向的视觉问答，彰显其作为自动驾驶统一模型的广泛适用性。代码与模型已发布于https://github.com/xiaomi-research/unidrivevla。

TLDR: Proposes UniDriveVLA, a unified Vision-Language-Action model for autonomous driving that decouples spatial perception and semantic reasoning using a Mixture-of-Transformers architecture, achieving state-of-the-art results on driving benchmarks.

简要说明: 提出 UniDriveVLA，一个用于自动驾驶的统一视觉-语言-动作模型，通过混合专家Transformer架构解耦空间感知和语义推理，在多个驾驶基准测试中实现了最先进的性能。

Authors: Yongkang Li, Lijun Zhou, Sixu Yan, Bencheng Liao, Tianyi Yan, Kaixin Xiong, Long Chen, Hongwei Xie, Bing Wang, Guang Chen, Hangjun Ye, Wenyu Liu, Haiyang Sun, Xinggang Wang

O-ConNet: Geometry-Aware End-to-End Inference of Over-Constrained Spatial Mechanisms

Abstract (English): Deep learning has shown strong potential for scientific discovery, but its ability to model macroscopic rigid-body kinematic constraints remains underexplored. We study this problem on spatial over-constrained mechanisms and propose O-ConNet, an end-to-end framework that infers mechanism structural parameters from only three sparse reachable points while reconstructing the full motion trajectory, without explicitly solving constraint equations during inference. On a self-constructed Bennett 4R dataset of 42,860 valid samples, O-ConNet achieves Param-MAE 0.276 +/- 0.077 and Traj-MAE 0.145 +/- 0.018 (mean +/- std over 10 runs), outperforming the strongest sequence baseline (LSTM-Seq2Seq) by 65.1 percent and 88.2 percent, respectively. These results suggest that end-to-end learning can capture closed-loop geometric structure and provide a practical route for inverse design of spatial over-constrained mechanisms under extremely sparse observations.

摘要（中文）: 深度学习在科学发现领域展现出强大潜力，但其对宏观刚体运动学约束的建模能力仍未得到充分探索。本研究以空间过约束机构为对象，提出O-ConNet端到端框架：该框架仅需三个稀疏可达点即可推断机构结构参数并重建完整运动轨迹，且无需在推理过程中显式求解约束方程。在包含42,860个有效样本的自建Bennett 4R数据集上，O-ConNet取得Param-MAE 0.276±0.077和Traj-MAE 0.145±0.018（10次运行均值±标准差），分别比最强序列基线模型（LSTM-Seq2Seq）提升65.1%和88.2%。实验结果表明，端到端学习能够有效捕捉闭环几何结构，为极端稀疏观测条件下的空间过约束机构逆向设计提供了实用路径。

TLDR: The paper introduces O-ConNet, an end-to-end deep learning framework for inferring structural parameters and reconstructing full motion trajectories of spatial over-constrained mechanisms from sparse reachable points.

简要说明: 本文提出了O-ConNet，一个端到端的深度学习框架，用于从稀疏可达点推断空间过约束机构的结构参数并重建其完整运动轨迹。

Authors: Haoyu Sun, Meng Zhao, Tianhao Wang, Jianxu Wu

Ego-Grounding for Personalized Question-Answering in Egocentric Videos

Abstract (English): We present the first systematic analysis of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) in personalized question-answering requiring ego-grounding - the ability to understand the camera-wearer in egocentric videos. To this end, we introduce MyEgo, the first egocentric VideoQA dataset designed to evaluate MLLMs' ability to understand, remember, and reason about the camera wearer. MyEgo comprises 541 long videos and 5K personalized questions asking about "my things", "my activities", and "my past". Benchmarking reveals that competitive MLLMs across variants, including open-source vs. proprietary, thinking vs. non-thinking, small vs. large scales all struggle on MyEgo. Top closed- and open-source models (e.g., GPT-5 and Qwen3-VL) achieve only~46% and 36% accuracy, trailing human performance by near 40% and 50% respectively. Surprisingly, neither explicit reasoning nor model scaling yield consistent improvements. Models improve when relevant evidence is explicitly provided, but gains drop over time, indicating limitations in tracking and remembering "me" and "my past". These findings collectively highlight the crucial role of ego-grounding and long-range memory in enabling personalized QA in egocentric videos. We hope MyEgo and our analyses catalyze further progress in these areas for egocentric personalized assistance. Data and code are available at https://github.com/Ryougetsu3606/MyEgo

摘要（中文）: 本研究首次系统分析了多模态大语言模型在需要自我定位（ego-grounding）能力的个性化问答任务中的表现，该能力要求模型从第一视角视频中理解摄像佩戴者。为此，我们推出了MyEgo——首个专为评估多模态大语言模型在理解、记忆和推理摄像佩戴者信息能力而设计的第一视角视频问答数据集。MyEgo包含541段长视频及5000个涉及“我的物品”、“我的活动”和“我的过往”的个性化问题。基准测试表明，当前各类主流多模态大语言模型——包括开源与闭源模型、具备思考能力与无思考能力模型、小规模与大规模模型——在MyEgo数据集上均表现欠佳。顶级闭源与开源模型（如GPT-5与Qwen3-VL）的准确率仅分别达到约46%和36%，与人类表现相比分别落后近40%和50%。值得注意的是，显式推理机制与模型规模扩大均未带来持续性能提升。当提供相关证据时模型表现有所改善，但随着时间推移增益下降，这反映出模型在追踪和记忆“我”及“我的过往”方面存在局限。这些发现共同揭示了自我定位与长程记忆能力在实现第一视角视频个性化问答中的关键作用。我们期望MyEgo数据集及相关分析能推动第一视角个性化辅助技术在这些领域的进一步发展。数据与代码已公开于https://github.com/Ryougetsu3606/MyEgo。

TLDR: The paper introduces MyEgo, a new dataset and benchmark for evaluating multimodal large language models' ability to understand and reason about the camera-wearer ('ego-grounding') in long egocentric videos for personalized question-answering, finding current models significantly lag behind human performance.

简要说明: 该论文提出了MyEgo数据集和基准，用于评估多模态大语言模型在长视角第一人称视频中理解及推理摄像机佩戴者（“自我定位”）的能力，以进行个性化问答，发现当前模型性能显著落后于人类。

Authors: Junbin Xiao, Shenglang Zhang, Pengxiang Zhu, Angela Yao

Global Geometry of Orthogonal Foliations in the Control Allocation of Signed-Quadratic Systems

Abstract (English): This work formalizes the differential topology of redundancy resolution for systems governed by signed-quadratic actuation maps. By analyzing the minimally redundant case, the global topology of the continuous fiber bundle defining the nonlinear actuation null-space is established. The distribution orthogonal to these fibers is proven to be globally integrable and governed by an exact logarithmic potential field. This field foliates the actuator space, inducing a structural stratification of all orthants into transverse layers whose combinatorial sizes follow a strictly binomial progression. Within these layers, adjacent orthants are continuously connected via lower-dimensional strata termed reciprocal hinges, while the layers themselves are separated by boundary hyperplanes, or portals, that act as global sections of the fibers. This partition formally distinguishes extremal and transitional layers, which exhibit fundamentally distinct fiber topologies and foliation properties. Through this geometric framework, classical pseudo-linear static allocation strategies are shown to inevitably intersect singular boundary hyperplanes, triggering infinite-derivative kinetic singularities and fragmenting the task space into an exponential number of singularity-separated sectors. In contrast, allocators derived from the orthogonal manifolds yield continuously differentiable global sections with only a linear number of sectors for transversal layers, or can even form a single global diffeomorphism to the task space in the case of the two extremal layers, thus completely avoiding geometric rank-loss and boundary-crossing singularities. These theoretical results directly apply to the control allocation of propeller-driven architectures, including multirotor UAVs, marine, and underwater vehicles.

摘要（中文）: 本研究形式化了受符号二次驱动映射支配的系统的冗余解析微分拓扑。通过分析最小冗余情况，确立了定义非线性驱动零空间连续纤维丛的整体拓扑结构。与这些纤维正交的分布被证明是全局可积的，且受精确对数势场支配。该势场将执行器空间分层为叶状结构，诱导所有象限按组合规模严格遵循二项式递进规律的结构化层次划分。在这些层级内部，相邻象限通过称为互易铰链的低维态连续连接，而各层级之间由作为纤维全局截面的边界超平面（即门户）分隔。这种划分形式化地区分了极值层与过渡层，二者展现出本质不同的纤维拓扑与叶状结构特性。 在此几何框架下，经典伪线性静态分配策略被证明必然与奇异边界超平面相交，从而触发无限导数动力学奇点，并将任务空间分割为指数级数量的奇点隔离扇区。与之相反，从正交流形导出的分配器能产生连续可微的全局截面，其横向层仅需线性数量的扇区；对于两个极值层情况，甚至可形成与任务空间的单全局微分同胚映射，从而完全避免几何秩损与边界穿越奇点。这些理论成果可直接应用于推进器驱动架构的控制分配，包括多旋翼无人机、水上及水下航行器系统。

TLDR: The paper presents a geometric framework for control allocation in systems with signed-quadratic actuation, analyzing singularity avoidance and applying it to propeller-driven vehicles like UAVs.

简要说明: 本文提出了一个用于带符号二次驱动系统的控制分配几何框架，分析了奇异性的避免问题，并应用于多旋翼无人机等螺旋桨驱动系统。

Authors: Antonio Franchi

Efficient Equivariant Transformer for Self-Driving Agent Modeling

Abstract (English): Accurately modeling agent behaviors is an important task in self-driving. It is also a task with many symmetries, such as equivariance to the order of agents and objects in the scene or equivariance to arbitrary roto-translations of the entire scene as a whole; i.e., SE(2)-equivariance. The transformer architecture is a ubiquitous tool for modeling these symmetries. While standard self-attention is inherently permutation equivariant, explicit pairwise relative positional encodings have been the standard for introducing SE(2)-equivariance. However, this approach introduces an additional cost that is quadratic in the number of agents, limiting its scalability to larger scenes and batch sizes. In this work, we propose DriveGATr, a novel transformer-based architecture for agent modeling that achieves SE(2)-equivariance without the computational cost of existing methods. Inspired by recent advances in geometric deep learning, DriveGATr encodes scene elements as multivectors in the 2D projective geometric algebra $\mathbb{R}^*_{2,0,1}$ and processes them with a stack of equivariant transformer blocks. Crucially, DriveGATr models geometric relationships using standard attention between multivectors, eliminating the need for costly explicit pairwise relative positional encodings. Experiments on the Waymo Open Motion Dataset demonstrate that DriveGATr is comparable to the state-of-the-art in traffic simulation and establishes a superior Pareto front for performance vs computational cost.

摘要（中文）: 精确建模智能体行为是自动驾驶领域的重要任务。这项任务具有诸多对称性，例如对场景中智能体与物体顺序的等变性，或对整个场景任意旋转平移的等变性（即SE(2)-等变性）。Transformer架构已成为建模这些对称性的通用工具。标准自注意力机制天生具有置换等变性，而显式的成对相对位置编码一直是实现SE(2)-等变性的常规方法。然而，这种方法引入了与智能体数量平方相关的额外计算成本，限制了其在更大场景和批处理规模上的可扩展性。本研究提出DriveGATr——一种基于Transformer的新型智能体建模架构，能在不增加现有方法计算成本的前提下实现SE(2)-等变性。受几何深度学习最新进展的启发，DriveGATr将场景元素编码为二维投影几何代数$\mathbb{R}^*_{2,0,1}$中的多重向量，并通过一系列等变Transformer模块进行处理。关键创新在于，DriveGATr利用多重向量间的标准注意力机制建模几何关系，从而无需昂贵的显式成对相对位置编码。在Waymo开放运动数据集上的实验表明，DriveGATr在交通模拟任务中达到业界先进水平，并在性能与计算成本之间建立了更优的帕累托前沿。

TLDR: This paper introduces DriveGATr, a novel SE(2)-equivariant transformer for agent modeling in self-driving, which uses geometric algebra multivectors to avoid costly explicit pairwise encodings, showing comparable performance with better efficiency.

简要说明: 本文提出了DriveGATr，一种用于自动驾驶中智能体建模的新型SE(2)等变transformer，它使用几何代数多重向量来避免昂贵的显式成对编码，展现出相当的性能和更好的计算效率。

Authors: Scott Xu, Dian Chen, Kelvin Wong, Chris Zhang, Kion Fallah, Raquel Urtasun

VOID: Video Object and Interaction Deletion

Abstract (English): Existing video object removal methods excel at inpainting content "behind" the object and correcting appearance-level artifacts such as shadows and reflections. However, when the removed object has more significant interactions, such as collisions with other objects, current models fail to correct them and produce implausible results. We present VOID, a video object removal framework designed to perform physically-plausible inpainting in these complex scenarios. To train the model, we generate a new paired dataset of counterfactual object removals using Kubric and HUMOTO, where removing an object requires altering downstream physical interactions. During inference, a vision-language model identifies regions of the scene affected by the removed object. These regions are then used to guide a video diffusion model that generates physically consistent counterfactual outcomes. Experiments on both synthetic and real data show that our approach better preserves consistent scene dynamics after object removal compared to prior video object removal methods. We hope this framework sheds light on how to make video editing models better simulators of the world through high-level causal reasoning.

摘要（中文）: 现有视频物体移除方法擅长修补物体"后方"的内容，并校正阴影、反射等外观层面的伪影。然而，当被移除物体存在更显著的交互作用（如与其他物体碰撞）时，现有模型无法修正这些物理相互作用，导致生成结果失真。本文提出VOID视频物体移除框架，专门针对此类复杂场景执行符合物理规律的修复。为训练模型，我们使用Kubric和HUMOTO生成了新的反事实物体移除配对数据集，其中移除物体需要改变后续的物理交互过程。在推理阶段，通过视觉语言模型识别受移除物体影响的场景区域，进而引导视频扩散模型生成物理一致的反事实结果。在合成数据与真实数据上的实验表明，相较于现有视频物体移除方法，本方法能更好地保持物体移除后场景动态的一致性。我们希望该框架能通过高层因果推理，为提升视频编辑模型的世界模拟能力提供新的思路。

TLDR: This paper proposes VOID, a video object removal framework that uses a vision-language model and a video diffusion model to generate physically-plausible counterfactual outcomes by altering downstream physical interactions.

简要说明: 本文提出VOID，一种视频物体移除框架，使用视觉语言模型和视频扩散模型通过改变下游物理交互来生成物理上合理的反事实结果。

Authors: Saman Motamed, William Harvey, Benjamin Klein, Luc Van Gool, Zhuoning Yuan, Ta-Ying Cheng

Omni123: Exploring 3D Native Foundation Models with Limited 3D Data by Unifying Text to 2D and 3D Generation

Abstract (English): Recent multimodal large language models have achieved strong performance in unified text and image understanding and generation, yet extending such native capability to 3D remains challenging due to limited data. Compared to abundant 2D imagery, high-quality 3D assets are scarce, making 3D synthesis under-constrained. Existing methods often rely on indirect pipelines that edit in 2D and lift results into 3D via optimization, sacrificing geometric consistency. We present Omni123, a 3D-native foundation model that unifies text-to-2D and text-to-3D generation within a single autoregressive framework. Our key insight is that cross-modal consistency between images and 3D can serve as an implicit structural constraint. By representing text, images, and 3D as discrete tokens in a shared sequence space, the model leverages abundant 2D data as a geometric prior to improve 3D representations. We introduce an interleaved X-to-X training paradigm that coordinates diverse cross-modal tasks over heterogeneous paired datasets without requiring fully aligned text-image-3D triplets. By traversing semantic-visual-geometric cycles (e.g., text to image to 3D to image) within autoregressive sequences, the model jointly enforces semantic alignment, appearance fidelity, and multi-view geometric consistency. Experiments show that Omni123 significantly improves text-guided 3D generation and editing, demonstrating a scalable path toward multimodal 3D world models.

摘要（中文）: 摘要： 近期，多模态大语言模型在文本与图像的统一理解与生成方面取得了显著进展，但受限于数据稀缺，将这种原生能力扩展至三维领域仍面临挑战。相较于丰富的二维图像，高质量三维数据较为匮乏，使得三维合成任务存在约束不足的问题。现有方法通常依赖间接流程，即先在二维空间进行编辑，再通过优化将结果提升至三维，这往往牺牲了几何一致性。本文提出Omni123，一种三维原生基础模型，将文本到二维和文本到三维的生成统一于单一自回归框架中。我们的核心洞见在于，图像与三维之间的跨模态一致性可作为隐式结构约束。通过将文本、图像和三维数据表示为共享序列空间中的离散标记，模型能够利用丰富的二维数据作为几何先验，以提升三维表征质量。我们引入了一种交错式X-to-X训练范式，在异构配对数据集上协调多种跨模态任务，无需完全对齐的文本-图像-三维三元组。通过在自回归序列中遍历语义-视觉-几何循环（如文本到图像、图像到三维、三维到图像），该模型联合实现了语义对齐、外观保真度与多视角几何一致性。实验表明，Omni123显著提升了文本引导的三维生成与编辑效果，为多模态三维世界模型的可扩展路径提供了重要启示。

TLDR: Omni123 is a 3D-native foundation model that unifies text-to-2D and text-to-3D generation in a single autoregressive framework, using cross-modal consistency between images and 3D as an implicit structural constraint to improve 3D synthesis.

简要说明: Omni123 是一种原生 3D 基础模型，将文本生成 2D 和文本生成 3D 统一在一个自回归框架中，利用图像和 3D 之间的跨模态一致性作为隐式结构约束来改进 3D 合成。

Authors: Chongjie Ye, Cheng Cao, Chuanyu Pan, Yiming Hao, Yihao Zhi, Yuanming Hu, Xiaoguang Han

LEO: Graph Attention Network based Hybrid Multi Sensor Extended Object Fusion and Tracking for Autonomous Driving Applications

Abstract (English): Accurate shape and trajectory estimation of dynamic objects is essential for reliable automated driving. Classical Bayesian extended-object models offer theoretical robustness and efficiency but depend on completeness of a-priori and update-likelihood functions, while deep learning methods bring adaptability at the cost of dense annotations and high compute. We bridge these strengths with LEO (Learned Extension of Objects), a spatio-temporal Graph Attention Network that fuses multi-modal production-grade sensor tracks to learn adaptive fusion weights, ensure temporal consistency, and represent multi-scale shapes. Using a task-specific parallelogram ground-truth formulation, LEO models complex geometries (e.g. articulated trucks and trailers) and generalizes across sensor types, configurations, object classes, and regions, remaining robust for challenging and long-range targets. Evaluations on the Mercedes-Benz DRIVE PILOT SAE L3 dataset demonstrate real-time computational efficiency suitable for production systems; additional validation on public datasets such as View of Delft (VoD) further confirms cross-dataset generalization.

摘要（中文）: 动态目标的精确形状与轨迹估计是可靠自动驾驶的关键。经典贝叶斯扩展目标模型虽具备理论鲁棒性与高效性，但依赖于先验知识和更新似然函数的完备性；深度学习方法虽带来适应性，却以密集标注和高计算成本为代价。我们提出LEO（对象学习扩展模型）来融合二者优势：这一时空图注意力网络通过融合多模态量产级传感器轨迹数据，自适应学习融合权重，确保时间一致性，并表征多尺度目标形态。借助任务专用的平行四边形真值表达框架，LEO能够建模复杂几何结构（如铰接式卡车与挂车），并适应不同传感器类型、配置方案、目标类别及区域场景，即使在极具挑战性的远距离目标检测中仍保持稳健性。基于梅赛德斯-奔驰DRIVE PILOT SAE L3数据集的评估表明，该模型具备适用于量产系统的实时计算效率；在View of Delft（VoD）等公开数据集上的额外验证进一步证实了其跨数据集泛化能力。

TLDR: This paper proposes a Graph Attention Network for multi-sensor fusion and shape/trajectory tracking of dynamic objects, primarily for autonomous driving, not general robotics.

简要说明: 本文提出了一种基于图注意力网络的多传感器融合模型，用于自动驾驶场景中动态物体的形状和轨迹估计，与通用机器人学关联度低。

Authors: Mayank Mayank, Bharanidhar Duraisamy, Florian Geiss

Hierarchical Memory Orchestration for Personalized Persistent Agents

Abstract (English): While long-term memory is essential for intelligent agents to maintain consistent historical awareness, the accumulation of extensive interaction data often leads to performance bottlenecks. Naive storage expansion increases retrieval noise and computational latency, overwhelming the reasoning capacity of models deployed on constrained personal devices. To address this, we propose Hierarchical Memory Orchestration (HMO), a framework that organizes interaction history into a three-tiered directory driven by user-centric contextual relevance. Our system maintains a compact primary cache, coupling recent and pivotal memories with an evolving user profile to ensure agent reasoning remains aligned with individual behavioral traits. This primary cache is complemented by a high-priority secondary layer, both of which are managed within a global archive of the full interaction history. Crucially, the user persona dictates memory redistribution across this hierarchy, promoting records mapped to long-term patterns toward more active tiers while relegating less relevant information. This targeted orchestration surfaces historical knowledge precisely when needed while maintaining a lean and efficient active search space. Evaluations on multiple benchmarks achieve state-of-the-art performance. Real-world deployments in ecosystems like OpenClaw demonstrate that HMO significantly enhances agent fluidity and personalization.

摘要（中文）: 摘要： 尽管长期记忆对于智能体保持历史一致性感知至关重要，但海量交互数据的积累常引发性能瓶颈。简单的存储扩展会增加检索噪声与计算延迟，从而超出受限个人设备上部署模型的推理负载能力。为此，我们提出分层记忆编排框架，通过以用户情境相关性驱动的三级目录结构组织交互历史。该系统维护一个紧凑的主缓存，将近期关键记忆与动态演化的用户画像耦合，确保智能体推理始终与个体行为特征保持一致。主缓存由高优先级次级存储层进行补充，两者均在完整交互历史的全局归档库中统一管理。关键机制在于：用户画像主导记忆在层级间的动态调度，将与长期行为模式相关的记录提升至活跃层级，同时将低关联信息降级存储。这种定向编排机制能在需要时精准调用历史知识，同时保持轻量高效的活动检索空间。在多个基准测试中，该框架实现了最优性能指标。在OpenClaw等实际生态系统的部署表明，HMO显著提升了智能体的交互流畅度与个性化程度。

TLDR: Proposes a hierarchical memory orchestration framework to manage long-term memory for personalized persistent agents, improving efficiency and personalization by organizing interaction history based on contextual relevance and user persona.

简要说明: 提出了一个分层记忆编排框架，用于管理个性化持久智能体的长期记忆。该框架基于上下文相关性和用户画像来组织交互历史，从而提高效率与个性化水平。

Authors: Junming Liu, Yifei Sun, Weihua Cheng, Haodong Lei, Yuqi Li, Yirong Chen, Ding Wang

ContextBudget: Budget-Aware Context Management for Long-Horizon Search Agents

Abstract (English): LLM-based agents show strong potential for long-horizon reasoning, yet their context size is limited by deployment factors (e.g., memory, latency, and cost), yielding a constrained context budget. As interaction histories grow, this induces a trade-off between retaining past information and staying within the context limit. To address this challenge, we propose Budget-Aware Context Management (BACM), which formulates context management as a sequential decision problem with a context budget constraint. It enables agents to assess the available budget before incorporating new observations and decide when and how much of the interaction history to compress. We further develop BACM-RL, an end-to-end curriculum-based reinforcement learning approach that learns compression strategies under varying context budgets. Experiments on compositional multi-objective QA and long-horizon web browsing benchmarks show that BACM-RL consistently outperforms prior methods across model scales and task complexities, achieving over $1.6\times$ gains over strong baselines in high-complexity settings, while maintaining strong advantages as budgets shrink, where most methods exhibit a downward performance trend.

摘要（中文）: 摘要： 基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体在长时序推理任务中展现出强大潜力，但其上下文规模受限于实际部署因素（如内存、延迟和成本），导致可用上下文预算受限。随着交互历史增长，智能体需在保留历史信息与遵守上下文限制之间做出权衡。为应对这一挑战，我们提出预算感知上下文管理（BACM），将上下文管理建模为具有预算约束的序列决策问题。该方法使智能体在引入新观察前能评估可用预算，并决策何时、以何种程度压缩交互历史。我们进一步开发了BACM-RL，一种基于课程学习的端到端强化学习方法，可在不同上下文预算下学习压缩策略。在组合式多目标问答与长时序网页浏览基准测试中，BACM-RL在多种模型规模和任务复杂度下均优于现有方法，在高复杂度场景中相对基线模型取得超过$1.6\times$的性能提升，同时在预算缩减时保持显著优势，而此时多数方法的性能呈下降趋势。

TLDR: The paper proposes a budget-aware context management framework (BACM) and an RL method (BACM-RL) to optimize the compression of long interaction histories for LLM-based agents, improving performance on long-horizon tasks like QA and web browsing under constrained context windows.

简要说明: 该论文提出了一种预算感知的上下文管理框架（BACM）和一种强化学习方法（BACM-RL），用于优化基于LLM的智能体在长程任务（如QA和网页浏览）中的历史交互信息压缩，以在受限的上下文窗口下提升性能。

Authors: Yong Wu, YanZhao Zheng, TianZe Xu, ZhenTao Zhang, YuanQiang Yu, JiHuai Zhu, Chao Ma, BinBin Lin, BaoHua Dong, HangCheng Zhu, RuoHui Huang, Gang Yu

GraphWalk: Enabling Reasoning in Large Language Models through Tool-Based Graph Navigation

Abstract (English): The use of knowledge graphs for grounding agents in real-world Q&A applications has become increasingly common. Answering complex queries often requires multi-hop reasoning and the ability to navigate vast relational structures. Standard approaches rely on prompting techniques that steer large language models to reason over raw graph context, or retrieval-augmented generation pipelines where relevant subgraphs are injected into the context. These, however, face severe limitations with enterprise-scale KGs that cannot fit in even the largest context windows available today. We present GraphWalk, a problem-agnostic, training-free, tool-based framework that allows off-the-shelf LLMs to reason through sequential graph navigation, dramatically increasing performance across different tasks. Unlike task-specific agent frameworks that encode domain knowledge into specialized tools, GraphWalk equips the LLM with a minimal set of orthogonal graph operations sufficient to traverse any graph structure. We evaluate whether models equipped with GraphWalk can compose these operations into correct multi-step reasoning chains, where each tool call represents a verifiable step creating a transparent execution trace. We first demonstrate our approach on maze traversal, a problem non-reasoning models are completely unable to solve, then present results on graphs resembling real-world enterprise knowledge graphs. To isolate structural reasoning from world knowledge, we evaluate on entirely synthetic graphs with random, non-semantic labels. Our benchmark spans 12 query templates from basic retrieval to compound first-order logic queries. Results show that tool-based traversal yields substantial and consistent gains over in-context baselines across all model families tested, with gains becoming more pronounced as scale increases, precisely where in-context approaches fail catastrophically.

摘要（中文）: 在真实世界的问答应用中，利用知识图谱为智能体提供基础支撑已日益普遍。回答复杂查询常需多跳推理能力及对庞大关系结构的遍历。标准方法依赖于提示技术引导大语言模型在原始图谱上下文中进行推理，或采用检索增强生成流程将相关子图注入上下文。然而，这些方法在面对企业级规模的图谱时面临严重局限——即使当前最大的上下文窗口也无法容纳如此庞大的数据。我们提出GraphWalk：一种与问题无关、无需训练、基于工具的框架，使得现成的大语言模型能够通过序列化图谱导航进行推理，显著提升了各类任务的表现。不同于将领域知识编码至专用工具的任务特定型智能体框架，GraphWalk为大语言模型配备了一组极小化的正交图谱操作集合，足以遍历任何图结构。我们评估了搭载GraphWalk的模型能否将这些操作组合成正确的多步推理链——其中每个工具调用代表一个可验证的步骤，形成透明的执行轨迹。我们首先在迷宫遍历问题上验证了该方法（非推理模型完全无法解决此类问题），随后在模拟真实企业知识图谱的图结构上展示结果。为将结构推理与世界知识分离，我们在完全由随机非语义标签构成的合成图谱上进行评估。我们的基准测试涵盖从基础检索到复合一阶逻辑查询的12种查询模板。结果表明，在所有测试模型族中，基于工具的遍历方法相较于上下文基线均产生显著且稳定的性能提升，且这种优势随着模型规模增大而愈加明显——而这正是上下文方法完全失效的场景。

TLDR: GraphWalk is a tool-based framework that enables LLMs to reason by navigating large knowledge graphs through a minimal set of graph operations, improving performance on complex multi-hop queries.

简要说明: GraphWalk是一个基于工具的框架，使大型语言模型能够通过一组最小的图操作来导航大型知识图谱，从而提高复杂多跳推理任务的性能。

Authors: Taraneh Ghandi, Hamidreza Mahyar, Shachar Klaiman

SHOE: Semantic HOI Open-Vocabulary Evaluation Metric

Abstract (English): Open-vocabulary human-object interaction (HOI) detection is a step towards building scalable systems that generalize to unseen interactions in real-world scenarios and support grounded multimodal systems that reason about human-object relationships. However, standard evaluation metrics, such as mean Average Precision (mAP), treat HOI classes as discrete categorical labels and fail to credit semantically valid but lexically different predictions (e.g., "lean on couch" vs. "sit on couch"), limiting their applicability for evaluating open-vocabulary predictions that go beyond any predefined set of HOI labels. We introduce SHOE (Semantic HOI Open-Vocabulary Evaluation), a new evaluation framework that incorporates semantic similarity between predicted and ground-truth HOI labels. SHOE decomposes each HOI prediction into its verb and object components, estimates their semantic similarity using the average of multiple large language models (LLMs), and combines them into a similarity score to evaluate alignment beyond exact string match. This enables a flexible and scalable evaluation of both existing HOI detection methods and open-ended generative models using standard benchmarks such as HICO-DET. Experimental results show that SHOE scores align more closely with human judgments than existing metrics, including LLM-based and embedding-based baselines, achieving an agreement of 85.73% with the average human ratings. Our work underscores the need for semantically grounded HOI evaluation that better mirrors human understanding of interactions. We will release our evaluation metric to the public to facilitate future research.

摘要（中文）: 开放词汇人-物交互检测是构建可扩展系统的重要一步，该系统能够泛化至现实场景中未见的交互行为，并支持基于人-物关系推理的接地多模态系统。然而，现有标准评估指标（如平均精度均值）将人-物交互类别视为离散分类标签，无法对语义正确但表述不同的预测结果（例如"倚靠沙发"与"坐在沙发上"）给予有效评价，这限制了其在超越预定义人-物交互标签集的开放词汇预测评估中的适用性。我们提出SHOE（语义人-物交互开放词汇评估）框架，该框架通过衡量预测结果与真实标注之间的语义相似性实现评估创新。SHOE将每个人-物交互预测分解为动词和对象组分，利用多个大型语言模型的平均语义相似度进行评估，最终融合为综合相似度分数，从而突破传统精确字符串匹配的局限。该框架支持对现有人-物交互检测方法和开放式生成模型在HICO-DET等标准基准上进行灵活可扩展的评估。实验结果表明，SHOE评分相比现有指标（包括基于大型语言模型和嵌入向量的基线方法）更贴近人类判断，与人类平均评分的一致性达到85.73%。本研究强调了建立基于语义的人-物交互评估体系的必要性，该体系能更好地反映人类对交互行为的理解。我们将公开评估指标以促进后续研究。

TLDR: The paper introduces SHOE, a new evaluation metric for open-vocabulary human-object interaction detection that uses semantic similarity from LLMs, rather than exact string matching, to better align with human judgments.

简要说明: 本文提出SHOE，一种用于开放词汇人-物交互检测的新评估指标，它利用大型语言模型的语义相似度而非精确字符串匹配，以更好地与人类判断保持一致。

Authors: Maja Noack, Qinqian Lei, Taipeng Tian, Bihan Dong, Robby T. Tan, Yixin Chen, John Young, Saijun Zhang, Bo Wang

Generative World Renderer

Abstract (English): Scaling generative inverse and forward rendering to real-world scenarios is bottlenecked by the limited realism and temporal coherence of existing synthetic datasets. To bridge this persistent domain gap, we introduce a large-scale, dynamic dataset curated from visually complex AAA games. Using a novel dual-screen stitched capture method, we extracted 4M continuous frames (720p/30 FPS) of synchronized RGB and five G-buffer channels across diverse scenes, visual effects, and environments, including adverse weather and motion-blur variants. This dataset uniquely advances bidirectional rendering: enabling robust in-the-wild geometry and material decomposition, and facilitating high-fidelity G-buffer-guided video generation. Furthermore, to evaluate the real-world performance of inverse rendering without ground truth, we propose a novel VLM-based assessment protocol measuring semantic, spatial, and temporal consistency. Experiments demonstrate that inverse renderers fine-tuned on our data achieve superior cross-dataset generalization and controllable generation, while our VLM evaluation strongly correlates with human judgment. Combined with our toolkit, our forward renderer enables users to edit styles of AAA games from G-buffers using text prompts.

摘要（中文）: 生成式逆向渲染与正向渲染技术在现实世界中的扩展应用，正受到现有合成数据集真实性不足与时序连贯性有限的制约。为弥合这一长期存在的领域鸿沟，我们推出了一个从视觉复杂的AAA级游戏中精心构建的大规模动态数据集。通过创新的双屏拼接采集方法，我们在多样化场景、视觉效果及环境（包括恶劣天气与动态模糊变体）中捕获了400万帧连续画面（720p/30 FPS），同步获取了RGB图像及五个G-buffer通道数据。该数据集在双向渲染领域实现了突破性进展：既能支持复杂真实场景下的几何与材质分解，又能促进高保真G-buffer引导的视频生成。此外，为在缺乏真实数据的情况下评估逆向渲染的实际性能，我们提出了一种基于视觉语言模型的新型评估协议，可从语义、空间和时序三个维度衡量一致性。实验表明，基于本数据微调的逆向渲染器在跨数据集泛化与可控生成方面表现优异，且我们的视觉语言模型评估结果与人类主观判断高度吻合。结合我们开发的工具套件，所提出的正向渲染器使用户能够通过文本提示直接基于G-buffer对AAA级游戏进行风格化编辑。

TLDR: This paper introduces a large-scale dataset from AAA games for training and evaluating inverse/forward rendering models, proposing a VLM-based method for assessing performance without ground truth.

简要说明: 本文提出了一个从AAA游戏构建的大规模数据集，用于训练和评估逆向/前向渲染模型，并引入了一种基于VLM的、无需真值标签的性能评估方法。

Authors: Zheng-Hui Huang, Zhixiang Wang, Jiaming Tan, Ruihan Yu, Yidan Zhang, Bo Zheng, Yu-Lun Liu, Yung-Yu Chuang, Kaipeng Zhang

GroundVTS: Visual Token Sampling in Multimodal Large Language Models for Video Temporal Grounding

Abstract (English): Video temporal grounding (VTG) is a critical task in video understanding and a key capability for extending video large language models (Vid-LLMs) to broader applications. However, existing Vid-LLMs rely on uniform frame sampling to extract video information, resulting in a sparse distribution of key frames and the loss of crucial temporal cues. To address this limitation, we propose Grounded Visual Token Sampling (GroundVTS), a Vid-LLM architecture that focuses on the most informative temporal segments. GroundVTS employs a fine-grained, query-guided mechanism to filter visual tokens before feeding them into the LLM, thereby preserving essential spatio-temporal information and maintaining temporal coherence. Futhermore, we introduce a progressive optimization strategy that enables the LLM to effectively adapt to the non-uniform distribution of visual features, enhancing its ability to model temporal dependencies and achieve precise video localization. We comprehensively evaluate GroundVTS on three standard VTG benchmarks, where it outperforms existing methods, achieving a 7.7-point improvement in mIoU for moment retrieval and 12.0-point improvement in mAP for highlight detection. Code is available at https://github.com/Florence365/GroundVTS.

摘要（中文）: 视频时序定位（VTG）是视频理解中的关键任务，也是拓展视频大语言模型（Vid-LLMs）应用范围的核心能力。然而，现有Vid-LLMs依赖均匀帧采样提取视频信息，导致关键帧分布稀疏且重要时序线索丢失。为突破此限制，我们提出基于视觉令牌的时序定位采样方法（GroundVTS），这是一种聚焦于信息最丰富时序片段的Vid-LLM架构。该方法采用细粒度、查询引导的机制，在视觉令牌输入大语言模型前进行筛选，从而保留关键时空信息并维持时序连贯性。此外，我们引入渐进式优化策略，使大语言模型能有效适应视觉特征的非均匀分布，增强其对时序依赖关系的建模能力，实现精准的视频定位。我们在三个标准VTG基准上对GroundVTS进行全面评估，其性能超越现有方法，在片段检索任务中mIoU提升7.7个百分点，在高光检测任务中mAP提升12.0个百分点。项目代码开源地址：https://github.com/Florence365/GroundVTS。

TLDR: Proposes a query-guided visual token sampling method for Video Large Language Models (Vid-LLMs) to improve temporal grounding in videos by focusing on informative segments.

简要说明: 提出了一种用于视频大语言模型（Vid-LLM）的查询引导视觉令牌采样方法，通过关注信息丰富的片段来改进视频中的时间定位任务。

Authors: Rong Fan, Kaiyan Xiao, Minghao Zhu, Liuyi Wang, Kai Dai, Zhao Yang

IndoorCrowd: A Multi-Scene Dataset for Human Detection, Segmentation, and Tracking with an Automated Annotation Pipeline

Abstract (English): Understanding human behaviour in crowded indoor environments is central to surveillance, smart buildings, and human-robot interaction, yet existing datasets rarely capture real-world indoor complexity at scale. We introduce IndoorCrowd, a multi-scene dataset for indoor human detection, instance segmentation, and multi-object tracking, collected across four campus locations (ACS-EC, ACS-EG, IE-Central, R-Central). It comprises $31$ videos ($9{,}913$ frames at $5$fps) with human-verified, per-instance segmentation masks. A $620$-frame control subset benchmarks three foundation-model auto-annotators: SAM3, GroundingSAM, and EfficientGroundingSAM, against human labels using Cohen's $κ$, AP, precision, recall, and mask IoU. A further $2{,}552$-frame subset supports multi-object tracking with continuous identity tracks in MOTChallenge format. We establish detection, segmentation, and tracking baselines using YOLOv8n, YOLOv26n, and RT-DETR-L paired with ByteTrack, BoT-SORT, and OC-SORT. Per-scene analysis reveals substantial difficulty variation driven by crowd density, scale, and occlusion: ACS-EC, with $79.3\%$ dense frames and a mean instance scale of $60.8$px, is the most challenging scene. The project page is available at https://sheepseb.github.io/IndoorCrowd/.

摘要（中文）: 理解室内拥挤环境中的人类行为对于监控、智能建筑和人机交互至关重要，但现有数据集很少能大规模捕捉真实室内环境的复杂性。我们提出了IndoorCrowd——一个用于室内人体检测、实例分割和多目标跟踪的多场景数据集，采集自四个校园场景（ACS-EC、ACS-EG、IE-Central、R-Central）。该数据集包含31段视频（共计9,913帧，帧率为5fps），并提供经人工逐实例验证的分割掩码。我们通过620帧的对照子集，以Cohen's κ、AP、精确率、召回率和掩码IoU为指标，对比评估了SAM3、GroundingSAM和EfficientGroundingSAM三种基础模型自动标注器与人工标注的一致性。另有2,552帧子集以MOTChallenge格式提供连续身份轨迹，支持多目标跟踪研究。我们采用YOLOv8n、YOLOv26n、RT-DETR-L结合ByteTrack、BoT-SORT和OC-SORT建立了检测、分割与跟踪的基准性能。逐场景分析表明：不同场景的难度差异显著，主要受人群密度、目标尺度和遮挡程度影响。其中ACS-EC场景79.3%的帧为高密度人群，平均实例尺度仅60.8像素，是挑战性最高的场景。项目页面详见：https://sheepseb.github.io/IndoorCrowd/

TLDR: The paper introduces a large-scale dataset, IndoorCrowd, for human detection, segmentation, and tracking in crowded indoor environments, aimed at applications like surveillance and human-robot interaction. It includes benchmarks for automated annotation tools and tracking methods, highlighting performance variations across different scenes.

简要说明: 本文介绍了 IndoorCrowd 数据集，这是一个用于拥挤室内环境中人体检测、分割和跟踪的大规模数据集，面向监控和人机交互等应用。它包含对自动化标注工具和跟踪方法的基准测试，并展示了不同场景下的性能差异。

Authors: Sebastian-Ion Nae, Radu Moldoveanu, Alexandra Stefania Ghita, Adina Magda Florea

HieraVid: Hierarchical Token Pruning for Fast Video Large Language Models

Abstract (English): Video Large Language Models (VideoLLMs) have demonstrated impressive capabilities in video understanding, yet the massive number of input video tokens incurs a significant computational burden for deployment. Existing methods mainly prune video tokens at input level while neglecting the inherent information structure embedded in videos and large language models (LLMs). To address this, we propose HieraVid, a hierarchical pruning framework that progressively and dynamically reduces visual redundancy. Based on two observations that videos possess the segment-frame structure and LLMs internally propagate multi-modal information unidirectionally, we decompose pruning into three levels: 1) segment-level, where video tokens are first temporally segmented and spatially merged; 2) frame-level, where similar frames within the same segment are jointly pruned to preserve diversity; 3) layer-level, redundancy gradually shrinks as LLM layer increases w/o compromising performance. We conduct extensive experiments on four widely used video understanding benchmarks to comprehensively evaluate the effectiveness of HieraVid. Remarkably, with only 30% of tokens retained, HieraVid achieves new state-of-the-art performance, while maintaining over 98% and 99% of the performance of LLaVA-Video-7B and LLaVA-OneVision-7B, respectively.

摘要（中文）: 视频大语言模型在视频理解方面展现出卓越能力，但海量输入视频令牌给实际部署带来巨大计算负担。现有方法主要在输入层面进行令牌剪枝，却忽略了视频与大语言模型内部固有的信息结构。为此，我们提出HieraVid——一种分层剪枝框架，通过渐进式动态机制减少视觉冗余。基于视频具有片段-帧结构且大语言模型内部单向传播多模态信息的双重观察，我们将剪枝分解为三个层级：1）片段级：视频令牌首先进行时序分段与空间合并；2）帧级：同一片段内相似帧进行联合剪枝以保留多样性；3）层级：随着大语言模型层数增加，在保证性能的前提下逐步缩减冗余。我们在四个广泛使用的视频理解基准上进行了大量实验，全面评估HieraVid的有效性。显著的是，仅保留30%令牌时，HieraVid取得了全新的最先进性能，同时分别保持了LLaVA-Video-7B和LLaVA-OneVision-7B模型98%与99%以上的性能表现。

TLDR: HieraVid is a hierarchical token pruning framework for Video Large Language Models that reduces computational cost by progressively pruning redundant tokens across segment, frame, and model layers while maintaining high performance on video understanding benchmarks.

简要说明: HieraVid是一个用于视频大语言模型的层次化token剪枝框架，它通过跨片段、帧和模型层的渐进式剪枝来减少冗余token和计算成本，同时在视频理解基准上保持高性能。

Authors: Yansong Guo, Chaoyang Zhu, Jiayi Ji, Jianghang Lin, Liujuan Cao

Unifying UAV Cross-View Geo-Localization via 3D Geometric Perception

Abstract (English): Cross-view geo-localization for Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) operating in GNSS-denied environments remains challenging due to the severe geometric discrepancy between oblique UAV imagery and orthogonal satellite maps. Most existing methods address this problem through a decoupled pipeline of place retrieval and pose estimation, implicitly treating perspective distortion as appearance noise rather than an explicit geometric transformation. In this work, we propose a geometry-aware UAV geo-localization framework that explicitly models the 3D scene geometry to unify coarse place recognition and fine-grained pose estimation within a single inference pipeline. Our approach reconstructs a local 3D scene from multi-view UAV image sequences using a Visual Geometry Grounded Transformer (VGGT), and renders a virtual Bird's-Eye View (BEV) representation that orthorectifies the UAV perspective to align with satellite imagery. This BEV serves as a geometric intermediary that enables robust cross-view retrieval and provides spatial priors for accurate 3 Degrees of Freedom (3-DoF) pose regression. To efficiently handle multiple location hypotheses, we introduce a Satellite-wise Attention Block that isolates the interaction between each satellite candidate and the reconstructed UAV scene, preventing inter-candidate interference while maintaining linear computational complexity. In addition, we release a recalibrated version of the University-1652 dataset with precise coordinate annotations and spatial overlap analysis, enabling rigorous evaluation of end-to-end localization accuracy. Extensive experiments on the refined University-1652 benchmark and SUES-200 demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving robust meter-level localization accuracy and improved generalization in complex urban environments.

摘要（中文）: 在GNSS拒止环境下运行的无人机，其跨视角地理定位因倾斜航拍影像与正射卫星地图之间的显著几何差异而面临持续挑战。现有方法大多通过解耦的地点检索与位姿估计流程处理该问题，将透视畸变隐式视为外观噪声而非显式几何变换。本研究提出一种几何感知的无人机地理定位框架，通过显式建模三维场景几何，将粗粒度地点识别与细粒度位姿估计统一于单次推理流程中。该方法利用视觉几何基础变换器从多视角无人机图像序列重建局部三维场景，并渲染虚拟鸟瞰图表示以正交校正无人机视角，实现与卫星影像的对齐。该鸟瞰图作为几何中介，既能支持鲁棒的跨视角检索，又能为精确的三自由度位姿回归提供空间先验。为高效处理多位置假设，我们引入卫星级注意力模块，隔离各卫星候选点与重建无人机场景的交互，在保持线性计算复杂度的同时避免候选点间相互干扰。此外，我们发布了经过重新校准的University-1652数据集版本，包含精确坐标标注与空间重叠分析，支持端到端定位精度的严格评估。在优化的University-1652基准与SUES-200数据集上的大量实验表明，本方法显著优于现有先进基线，在复杂城市环境中实现了鲁棒的米级定位精度与更强的泛化能力。

TLDR: Proposes a geometry-aware framework for UAV cross-view geo-localization by reconstructing a 3D scene from UAV images and rendering a virtual Bird's-Eye View to align with satellite maps, unifying retrieval and pose estimation.

简要说明: 提出一种用于无人机跨视角地理定位的几何感知框架，通过从无人机图像序列重建3D场景并渲染虚拟鸟瞰图来与卫星图像对齐，统一了检索和姿态估计。

Authors: Haoyuan Li, Wen Yang, Fang Xu, Hong Tan, Haijian Zhang, Shengyang Li, Gui-Song Xia

Director: Instance-aware Gaussian Splatting for Dynamic Scene Modeling and Understanding

Abstract (English): Volumetric video seeks to model dynamic scenes as temporally coherent 4D representations. While recent Gaussian-based approaches achieve impressive rendering fidelity, they primarily emphasize appearance but are largely agnostic to instance-level structure, limiting stable tracking and semantic reasoning in highly dynamic scenarios. In this paper, we present Director, a unified spatio-temporal Gaussian representation that jointly models human performance, high-fidelity rendering, and instance-level semantics. Our key insight is that embedding instance-consistent semantics naturally complements 4D modeling, enabling more accurate scene decomposition while supporting robust dynamic scene understanding. To this end, we leverage temporally aligned instance masks and sentence embeddings derived from Multimodal Large Language Models to supervise the learnable semantic features of each Gaussian via two MLP decoders, enabling language-aligned 4D representations and enforcing identity consistency over time. To enhance temporal stability, we bridge 2D optical flow with 4D Gaussians and finetune their motions, yielding reliable initialization and reducing drift. For the training, we further introduce a geometry-aware SDF constraints, along with regularization terms that enforces surface continuity, enhancing temporal coherence in dynamic foreground modeling. Experiments demonstrate that Director achieves temporally coherent 4D reconstructions while simultaneously enabling instance segmentation and open-vocabulary querying.

摘要（中文）: 体积视频旨在将动态场景建模为时序连贯的四维表示。虽然近期基于高斯辐射场的方法实现了令人印象深刻的渲染精度，但这些方法主要侧重于外观表现，而对实例级结构缺乏感知能力，限制了在高度动态场景中的稳定跟踪与语义推理能力。本文提出了Director——一种统一时空高斯表示方法，能够同时对人体动作、高保真渲染与实例级语义进行联合建模。我们的核心观点在于：嵌入实例一致的语义信息能够自然补充四维建模过程，既可实现更精准的场景解构，又能支撑鲁棒的动态场景理解。为此，我们利用时序对齐的实例分割掩码与来自多模态大语言模型的语义嵌入向量，通过两个MLP解码器监督每个高斯点的可学习语义特征，从而构建语言对齐的四维表示并强制实现跨时间维度的身份一致性。为增强时序稳定性，我们将二维光流与四维高斯表示相结合，通过微调其运动参数生成可靠初始化并减少漂移现象。在训练过程中，我们进一步引入几何感知的符号距离场约束以及强化表面连续性的正则化项，从而提升动态前景建模中的时序连贯性。实验表明，Director能够同时实现时序连贯的四维重建、实例分割和开放词汇查询功能。

TLDR: Director integrates instance-aware semantics into a 4D Gaussian Splatting model for dynamic scene modeling, enabling language-aligned open-vocabulary queries and stable tracking, but does not explicitly address robotics or embodied control.

简要说明: Director是一种将实例级语义集成到4D高斯溅射模型中的动态场景建模方法，支持基于语言的开放词汇查询和稳定跟踪，但未明确涉及机器人或具身控制。
