Authors: Yewei Xu, Qin Li

Learning from the Right Rollouts: Data Attribution for PPO-based LLM Post-Training

Abstract (English): Traditional RL algorithms like Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) typically train on the entire rollout buffer, operating under the assumption that all generated episodes provide a beneficial optimization signal. However, these episodes frequently contain noisy or unfaithful reasoning, which can degrade model performance and slow down training. In this paper, we propose \textbf{Influence-Guided PPO (I-PPO)}, a novel framework that integrates data attribution into the RL post-training loop. By calculating an influence score for each episode using a gradient-based approximation, I-PPO identifies and eliminates episodes that are anti-aligned with a validation gradient. Our experiments demonstrate that I-PPO consistently outperforms SFT and PPO baselines. We show that our filtering process acts as an intrinsic early stopping mechanism, accelerating training efficiency while effectively reducing unfaithful CoT reasoning.

摘要（中文）: 传统强化学习算法如近端策略优化（PPO）通常在整个经验回放缓冲区上进行训练，其基本假设是：所有生成的经验轨迹都能提供有效的优化信号。然而，这些轨迹中往往包含噪声或不可靠的推理过程，可能导致模型性能下降并减缓训练速度。本文提出 **影响力引导的PPO算法（I-PPO）**，这是一种将数据归因整合到强化学习后训练循环中的新型框架。通过基于梯度的近似方法计算每个轨迹的影响力分数，I-PPO能够识别并剔除与验证梯度方向相悖的轨迹。实验结果表明，I-PPO在性能上持续优于监督微调与PPO基线方法。我们证明该过滤机制可作为一种内在的早期停止策略，在有效减少思维链推理不可靠性的同时，显著提升了训练效率。

TLDR: The paper proposes a PPO variant that uses gradient-based data attribution to filter out harmful episodes, reducing unfaithful reasoning and accelerating training for LLM post-training.

简要说明: 本文提出了一种使用基于梯度的数据归属进行有害片段筛选的PPO变体，旨在减少LLM后训练中的不忠实推理并加速训练。

Authors: Dong Shu, Denghui Zhang, Jessica Hullman

Care-Conditioned Neuromodulation for Autonomy-Preserving Supportive Dialogue Agents

Abstract (English): Large language models deployed in supportive or advisory roles must balance helpfulness with preservation of user autonomy, yet standard alignment methods primarily optimize for helpfulness and harmlessness without explicitly modeling relational risks such as dependency reinforcement, overprotection, or coercive guidance. We introduce Care-Conditioned Neuromodulation (CCN), a state-dependent control framework in which a learned scalar signal derived from structured user state and dialogue context conditions response generation and candidate selection. We formalize this setting as an autonomy-preserving alignment problem and define a utility function that rewards autonomy support and helpfulness while penalizing dependency and coercion. We also construct a benchmark of relational failure modes in multi-turn dialogue, including reassurance dependence, manipulative care, overprotection, and boundary inconsistency. On this benchmark, care-conditioned candidate generation combined with utility-based reranking improves autonomy-preserving utility by +0.25 over supervised fine-tuning and +0.07 over preference optimization baselines while maintaining comparable supportiveness. Pilot human evaluation and zero-shot transfer to real emotional-support conversations show directional agreement with automated metrics. These results suggest that state-dependent control combined with utility-based selection is a practical approach to multi-objective alignment in autonomy-sensitive dialogue.

摘要（中文）: 部署于支持性或顾问角色的大型语言模型必须在帮助性与用户自主权维护之间取得平衡，然而标准对齐方法主要针对助益性和无害性进行优化，未对依赖强化、过度保护或强制性引导等关系性风险进行显式建模。本文提出关怀条件化神经调控（CCN）——一种基于状态依赖的控制框架，其中通过从结构化用户状态和对话上下文中学习得到的标量信号，对响应生成和候选选择进行条件化调控。我们将该场景形式化为自主权保护对齐问题，并定义了一个效用函数：该函数奖励对自主权的支持与帮助性，同时惩罚依赖性和强制行为。此外，我们还构建了一个多轮对话中关系性失效模式的基准测试集，涵盖安抚依赖、操控性关怀、过度保护及边界不一致等现象。在该基准测试中，关怀条件化候选生成结合基于效用的重排序方法，相比监督微调基线将自主权保护效用提升0.25，较偏好优化基线提升0.07，同时保持相当水平的支持性。初步人工评估及在真实情感支持对话中的零样本迁移实验表明，其结果与自动化度量指标呈方向性一致。这些结果证明：状态依赖控制结合基于效用的选择，是实现自主敏感性对话中多目标对齐的实用路径。

TLDR: This paper proposes a control framework for dialogue agents to preserve user autonomy, using a state-dependent signal to condition response generation and selection, benchmarked on multi-turn relational failures.

简要说明: 本文提出了一种用于保护用户自主性的对话代理控制框架，利用状态相关信号来条件响应生成和选择，并在多轮关系失效模式上进行基准测试。

Authors: Shalima Binta Manir, Tim Oates

ZEUS: Accelerating Diffusion Models with Only Second-Order Predictor

Abstract (English): Denoising generative models deliver high-fidelity generation but remain bottlenecked by inference latency due to the many iterative denoiser calls required during sampling. Training-free acceleration methods reduce latency by either sparsifying the model architecture or shortening the sampling trajectory. Current training-free acceleration methods are more complex than necessary: higher-order predictors amplify error under aggressive speedups, and architectural modifications hinder deployment. Beyond 2x acceleration, step skipping creates structural scarcity -- at most one fresh evaluation per local window -- leaving the computed output and its backward difference as the only causally grounded information. Based on this, we propose ZEUS, an acceleration method that predicts reduced denoiser evaluations using a second-order predictor, and stabilizes aggressive consecutive skipping with an interleaved scheme that avoids back-to-back extrapolations. ZEUS adds essentially zero overhead, no feature caches, and no architectural modifications, and it is compatible with different backbones, prediction objectives, and solver choices. Across image and video generation, ZEUS consistently improves the speed-fidelity performance over recent training-free baselines, achieving up to 3.2x end-to-end speedup while maintaining perceptual quality. Our code is available at: https://github.com/Ting-Justin-Jiang/ZEUS.

摘要（中文）: 去噪生成模型能够实现高保真度的生成，但由于采样过程中需要多次迭代去噪器调用，其推理速度仍受到延迟问题的制约。免训练的加速方法通过稀疏化模型架构或缩短采样轨迹来降低延迟。当前已有的免训练加速方法复杂度过高：高阶预测器在激进加速下会放大误差，而架构修改则阻碍了实际部署。在超过2倍加速时，步长跳跃会导致结构性稀缺——每个局部窗口内至多进行一次全新评估——使得计算输出及其反向差分成为唯一具有因果依据的信息。基于此，我们提出ZEUS加速方法，该方法使用二阶预测器来预测减少的去噪器评估次数，并通过交替执行方案避免连续外推，从而稳定激进连续跳跃的稳定性。ZEUS几乎不增加额外开销，无需特征缓存，不修改模型架构，且兼容不同主干网络、预测目标和求解器选择。在图像与视频生成任务中，ZEUS在保持感知质量的前提下，始终优于当前免训练基线方法的速度-保真度性能，实现了高达3.2倍的端到端加速。相关代码已开源：https://github.com/Ting-Justin-Jiang/ZEUS。

TLDR: ZEUS accelerates diffusion model inference by using a second-order predictor to reduce denoiser evaluations, achieving up to 3.2x speedup with minimal overhead.

简要说明: ZEUS使用二阶预测器减少去噪器评估，加速扩散模型推理，实现高达3.2倍端到端加速且开销极小。

Authors: Yixiao Wang, Ting Jiang, Zishan Shao, Hancheng Ye, Jingwei Sun, Mingyuan Ma, Jianyi Zhang, Yiran Chen, Hai Li

Matching Accuracy, Different Geometry: Evolution Strategies vs GRPO in LLM Post-Training

Abstract (English): Evolution Strategies (ES) have emerged as a scalable gradient-free alternative to reinforcement learning based LLM fine-tuning, but it remains unclear whether comparable task performance implies comparable solutions in parameter space. We compare ES and Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) across four tasks in both single-task and sequential continual-learning settings. ES matches or exceeds GRPO in single-task accuracy and remains competitive sequentially when its iteration budget is controlled. Despite this similarity in task performance, the two methods produce markedly different model updates: ES makes much larger changes and induces broader off-task KL drift, whereas GRPO makes smaller, more localized updates. Strikingly, the ES and GRPO solutions are linearly connected with no loss barrier, even though their update directions are nearly orthogonal. We develop an analytical theory of ES that explains all these phenomena within a unified framework, showing how ES can accumulate large off-task movement on weakly informative directions while still making enough progress on the task to match gradient-based RL in downstream accuracy. These results show that gradient-free and gradient-based fine-tuning can reach similarly accurate yet geometrically distinct solutions, with important consequences for forgetting and knowledge preservation. The source code is publicly available: https://github.com/Bhoy1/ESvsGRPO.

摘要（中文）: 进化策略（ES）作为基于强化学习的大语言模型微调的一种可扩展无梯度替代方法，其任务性能虽可比拟，但尚不清楚这是否意味着参数空间中的解也具有可比性。我们在单任务与顺序持续学习两种设定下，对ES和分组相对策略优化（GRPO）在四项任务上进行了比较。在单任务准确率上，ES达到或超过GRPO；在迭代预算受控时，ES在顺序学习中仍保持竞争力。尽管任务性能相似，两种方法产生的模型更新却截然不同：ES的更新幅度更大，引发更广泛的离任务KL散度漂移，而GRPO则进行更小、更局部的更新。引人注目的是，尽管ES与GRPO的更新方向几乎正交，它们的解在参数空间内却呈线性连接且无损失屏障。我们提出了ES的分析理论，在统一框架内解释了所有这些现象，表明ES如何在弱信息方向上积累大量离任务运动，同时仍能在任务上取得足够进展，从而在下游准确率上与基于梯度的强化学习相当。这些结果表明，无梯度与基于梯度的微调方法能达到同样准确但几何特征迥异的解，这对遗忘与知识保留具有重要影响。源代码已公开：https://github.com/Bhoy1/ESvsGRPO。

TLDR: The paper compares Evolution Strategies and Group Relative Policy Optimization for LLM fine-tuning, showing they achieve similar task accuracy but produce geometrically different parameter updates with implications for forgetting.

简要说明: 该论文比较了进化策略和分组相对策略优化在LLM微调中的应用，发现它们达到相似的准确率，但产生的参数更新在几何上差异显著，对遗忘问题有影响。

Authors: William Hoy, Binxu Wang, Xu Pan

PI-JEPA: Label-Free Surrogate Pretraining for Coupled Multiphysics Simulation via Operator-Split Latent Prediction

Abstract (English): Reservoir simulation workflows face a fundamental data asymmetry: input parameter fields (geostatistical permeability realizations, porosity distributions) are free to generate in arbitrary quantities, yet existing neural operator surrogates require large corpora of expensive labeled simulation trajectories and cannot exploit this unlabeled structure. We introduce \textbf{PI-JEPA} (Physics-Informed Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture), a surrogate pretraining framework that trains \emph{without any completed PDE solves}, using masked latent prediction on unlabeled parameter fields under per-sub-operator PDE residual regularization. The predictor bank is structurally aligned with the Lie--Trotter operator-splitting decomposition of the governing equations, dedicating a separate physics-constrained latent module to each sub-process (pressure, saturation transport, reaction), enabling fine-tuning with as few as 100 labeled simulation runs. On single-phase Darcy flow, PI-JEPA achieves $1.9\times$ lower error than FNO and $2.4\times$ lower error than DeepONet at $N_\ell{=}100$, with 24\% improvement over supervised-only training at $N_\ell{=}500$, demonstrating that label-free surrogate pretraining substantially reduces the simulation budget required for multiphysics surrogate deployment.

摘要（中文）: 油藏模拟工作流面临一个根本性的数据不对称问题：输入参数场（地质统计渗透率实现、孔隙度分布）可以自由生成任意数量，但现有的神经算子替代模型需要大量昂贵的标记模拟轨迹数据，且无法利用这些未标记的结构信息。本文提出 \textbf{PI-JEPA}（物理信息联合嵌入预测架构），这是一种替代模型预训练框架，\emph{无需任何完整偏微分方程求解过程}，通过在子算子偏微分方程残差正则化下对未标记参数场进行掩码隐变量预测来完成训练。该预测器组在结构上与控制方程的Lie--Trotter算子分裂分解对齐，为每个子过程（压力、饱和度输运、反应）设置了独立的物理约束隐变量模块，使得仅需100个标记模拟运行即可实现微调。在单相达西流测试中，当$N_\ell{=}100$时，PI-JEPA的误差比FNO降低$1.9$倍、比DeepONet降低$2.4$倍；在$N_\ell{=}500$时较纯监督训练提升24%，这表明无标记替代模型预训练能显著降低多物理场替代模型部署所需的模拟计算成本。

TLDR: PI-JEPA is a physics-informed, label-free pretraining framework for neural operator surrogates of multiphysics PDEs, which reduces the need for expensive simulation data by using masked latent prediction and physics-constrained modules aligned with operator splitting.

简要说明: PI-JEPA 是一个用于多物理场PDE神经算子代理的物理信息、无标签预训练框架，它通过掩码潜在预测和与算子分裂对齐的物理约束模块，减少了对昂贵仿真数据的依赖。

Authors: Brandon Yee, Pairie Koh

UQ-SHRED: uncertainty quantification of shallow recurrent decoder networks for sparse sensing via engression

Abstract (English): Reconstructing high-dimensional spatiotemporal fields from sparse sensor measurements is critical in a wide range of scientific applications. The SHallow REcurrent Decoder (SHRED) architecture is a recent state-of-the-art architecture that reconstructs high-quality spatial domain from hyper-sparse sensor measurement streams. An important limitation of SHRED is that in complex, data-scarce, high-frequency, or stochastic systems, portions of the spatiotemporal field must be modeled with valid uncertainty estimation. We introduce UQ-SHRED, a distributional learning framework for sparse sensing problems that provides uncertainty quantification through a neural network-based distributional regression called engression. UQ-SHRED models the uncertainty by learning the predictive distribution of the spatial state conditioned on the sensor history. By injecting stochastic noise into sensor inputs and training with an energy score loss, UQ-SHRED produces predictive distributions with minimal computational overhead, requiring only noise injection at the input and resampling through a single architecture without retraining or additional network structures. On complicated synthetic and real-life datasets including turbulent flow, atmospheric dynamics, neuroscience and astrophysics, UQ-SHRED provides a distributional approximation with well-calibrated confidence intervals. We further conduct ablation studies to understand how each model setting affects the quality of the UQ-SHRED performance, and its validity on uncertainty quantification over a set of different experimental setups.

摘要（中文）: 从稀疏传感器测量数据中重构高维时空场，是众多科学应用中的关键任务。浅层循环解码器（SHRED）架构是当前最先进的一种架构，能够基于超稀疏传感器测量流重构高质量的空间域。然而，SHRED的一个重要局限在于，对于复杂、数据稀缺、高频或随机性系统，其时空场的部分区域必须结合有效的****不确定性估计进行建模。为此，我们提出UQ-SHRED，一种面向稀疏感知问题的分布学习框架，该框架通过一种基于神经网络的分布回归方法（称为engression）来提供不确定性量化。UQ-SHRED通过学习传感器历史数据条件下空间状态的预测分布，来模拟不确定性。通过在传感器输入中注入随机噪声，并采用能量评分损失进行训练，UQ-SHRED能够以最小的计算开销生成预测分布，仅需在输入端进行噪声注入，并通过单一架构进行重采样，而无需重新训练或增加额外的网络结构。在包括湍流、大气动力学、神经科学和天体物理在内的复杂合成数据集和真实数据集中，UQ-SHRED提供了具有良好校准置信区间的分布近似。此外，我们进一步进行了消融研究，以探究各模型设置如何影响UQ-SHRED性能的质量，以及其在不同实验设置下不确定性量化的有效性。

TLDR: UQ-SHRED is a framework that adds uncertainty quantification to a shallow recurrent decoder network for reconstructing high-dimensional spatiotemporal fields from sparse sensor measurements, using a method called engression.

简要说明: UQ-SHRED 是一个为浅层循环解码器网络增加不确定性量化的框架，通过一种称为“engression”的方法，用于从稀疏传感器测量重建高维时空场。

Authors: Mars Liyao Gao, Yuxuan Bao, Amy S. Rude, Xinwei Shen, J. Nathan Kutz

Causal Scene Narration with Runtime Safety Supervision for Vision-Language-Action Driving

Abstract (English): Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models for autonomous driving must integrate diverse textual inputs, including navigation commands, hazard warnings, and traffic state descriptions, yet current systems often present these as disconnected fragments, forcing the model to discover on its own which environmental constraints are relevant to the current maneuver. We introduce Causal Scene Narration (CSN), which restructures VLA text inputs through intent-constraint alignment, quantitative grounding, and structured separation, at inference time with zero GPU cost. We complement CSN with Simplex-based runtime safety supervision and training-time alignment via Plackett-Luce DPO with negative log-likelihood (NLL) regularization. A multi-town closed-loop CARLA evaluation shows that CSN improves Driving Score by +31.1% on original LMDrive and +24.5% on the preference-aligned variant. A controlled ablation reveals that causal structure accounts for 39.1% of this gain, with the remainder attributable to information content alone. A perception noise ablation confirms that CSN's benefit is robust to realistic sensing errors. Semantic safety supervision improves Infraction Score, while reactive Time-To-Collision monitoring degrades performance, demonstrating that intent-aware monitoring is needed for VLA systems.

摘要（中文）: 自动驾驶中的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型需整合多样的文本输入，包括导航指令、危险警告和交通状态描述，然而现有系统常将其呈现为相互割裂的片段，迫使模型自行探索哪些环境约束与当前操控相关。我们提出了因果场景叙事（CSN）方法，通过意图-约束对齐、定量语义基础和结构化分离，在推理阶段以零GPU成本重构VLA文本输入。我们结合基于单纯形法的运行时安全监控机制，以及通过带负对数似然正则化的普拉凯特-卢斯差分偏好优化实现训练阶段对齐。多城镇CARLA闭环评估显示，CSN将原始LMDrive模型的驾驶评分提升31.1%，在偏好对齐变体上提升24.5%。受控消融实验表明，因果结构贡献了39.1%的性能增益，其余提升完全来自信息内容本身。感知噪声消融验证了CSN在现实传感误差下的稳健性。语义安全监控显著改善违规评分，而反应式碰撞时间监控反而降低性能，这证明VLA系统需要具备意图感知的监控机制。

TLDR: The paper proposes a method called Causal Scene Narration (CSN) to improve Vision-Language-Action models for autonomous driving by restructuring text inputs and adding safety supervision, demonstrating significant performance gains in CARLA.

简要说明: 本文提出了一种称为因果场景叙述（CSN）的方法，通过重组文本输入和添加安全监督来改进自动驾驶的视觉-语言-动作模型，在CARLA中展示了显著的性能提升。

Authors: Yun Li, Yidu Zhang, Simon Thompson, Ehsan Javanmardi, Manabu Tsukada

Generative AI Spotlights the Human Core of Data Science: Implications for Education

Abstract (English): Generative AI (GAI) reveals an irreducible human core at the center of data science: advances in GAI should sharpen, rather than diminish, the focus on human reasoning in data science education. GAI can now execute many routine data science workflows, including cleaning, summarizing, visualizing, modeling, and drafting reports. Yet the competencies that matter most remain irreducibly human: problem formulation, measurement and design, causal identification, statistical and computational reasoning, ethics and accountability, and sensemaking. Drawing on Donoho's Greater Data Science framework, Nolan and Temple Lang's vision of computational literacy, and the McLuhan-Culkin insight that we shape our tools and thereafter our tools shape us, this paper traces the emergence of data science through three converging lineages: Tukey's intellectual vision of data analysis as a science, the commercial logic of surveillance capitalism that created industrial demand for data scientists, and the academic programs that followed. Mapping GAI's impact onto Donoho's six divisions of Greater Data Science shows that computing with data (GDS3) has been substantially automated, while data gathering, preparation, and exploration (GDS1) and science about data science (GDS6) still require essential human input. The educational implication is that data science curricula should focus on this human core while teaching students how to contribute effectively within iterative prompt-output-prompt cycles using retrieval-augmented generation, and that learning outcomes and assessments should explicitly evaluate reasoning and judgment.

摘要（中文）: 生成式人工智能（GAI）揭示了数据科学中不可化约的人类核心：GAI的进步应当强化而非削弱数据科学教育中对人类推理的关注。GAI现已能执行许多常规数据科学工作流程，包括数据清洗、汇总、可视化、建模及报告草拟。然而，最重要的能力始终是人之为人的根本：问题构建、度量与设计、因果识别、统计与计算推理、伦理问责以及意义构建。本文借鉴了Donoho的广义数据科学框架、Nolan和Temple Lang的计算素养理念，以及McLuhan与Culkin“我们塑造工具，而后工具塑造我们”的深刻洞见，通过三条交汇的脉络追溯数据科学的兴起：Tukey将数据分析视为科学的智识愿景、催生数据科学家产业需求的监控资本主义商业逻辑，以及随之兴起的学术项目。将GAI的影响映射到Donoho的广义数据科学六大分支可见，数据计算（GDS3）已基本实现自动化，而数据收集、准备与探索（GDS1）以及数据科学之科学（GDS6）仍离不开人类的关键参与。教育启示在于：数据科学课程应聚焦于这一人类核心能力，同时教授学生如何运用检索增强生成技术，在迭代式的“提示-输出-提示”循环中有效协作，且学习成果与评估体系应明确考察学生的推理与判断能力。

TLDR: This paper argues that Generative AI automates routine data science tasks, highlighting that core human competencies like problem formulation, causal reasoning, and ethics remain essential, and data science education should focus on this human core.

简要说明: 本文认为，生成式AI可以自动化数据科学中的常规任务，这突显了问题定义、因果推理和伦理等核心人类能力依然不可或缺，数据科学教育应聚焦于此人类核心。

Authors: Nathan Taback

Answering the Wrong Question: Reasoning Trace Inversion for Abstention in LLMs

Abstract (English): For Large Language Models (LLMs) to be reliably deployed, models must effectively know when not to answer: abstain. Reasoning models, in particular, have gained attention for impressive performance on complex tasks. However, reasoning models have been shown to have worse abstention abilities. Taking the vulnerabilities of reasoning models into account, we propose our Query Misalignment Framework. Hallucinations resulting in failed abstention can be reinterpreted as LLMs answering the wrong question (rather than answering a question incorrectly). Based on this framework, we develop a new class of state-of-the-art abstention methods called Trace Inversion. First, we generate the reasoning trace of a model. Based on only the trace, we then reconstruct the most likely query that the model responded to. Finally, we compare the initial query with the reconstructed query. Low similarity score between the initial query and reconstructed query suggests that the model likely answered the question incorrectly and is flagged to abstain. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Trace Inversion effectively boosts abstention performance in four frontier LLMs across nine abstention QA datasets, beating competitive baselines in 33 out of 36 settings.

摘要（中文）: 为实现大规模语言模型的可靠部署，模型必须有效掌握何时不应回答：即具备拒绝应答能力。推理模型因其在复杂任务上的卓越表现备受关注，但研究表明这类模型的拒答能力存在不足。针对推理模型的这一缺陷，我们提出了查询失准框架。导致拒答失败的幻觉现象可被重新解读为：语言模型回答了错误的问题（而非错误地回答了问题）。基于该框架，我们开发了名为“溯源反演”的新型前沿拒答方法。首先，我们生成模型的推理轨迹；随后仅依据该轨迹重构模型最可能响应的问题；最后通过比对初始查询与重构查询的相似度进行判断。当初始查询与重构查询的相似度评分较低时，表明模型可能错误应答了问题，系统将标记为需要拒绝回答。大量实验证明，溯源反演方法显著提升了四种前沿语言模型在九个拒答问答数据集上的表现，在36组实验设置中的33项超越了现有基线方法。

TLDR: Proposes a 'Trace Inversion' method to improve abstention in Large Language Models (LLMs) by generating a reasoning trace, reconstructing a likely query from it, and comparing it to the original query to flag incorrect answers.

简要说明: 提出了一种名为‘追踪反转’的方法，通过生成大语言模型的推理痕迹，从中重建最可能的查询，并将其与原始查询比较，以标记错误答案，从而提升模型在不确定时拒绝回答的能力。

Authors: Abinitha Gourabathina, Inkit Padhi, Manish Nagireddy, Subhajit Chaudhury, Prasanna Sattigeri

Impact of Multimodal and Conversational AI on Learning Outcomes and Experience

Abstract (English): Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) offer an opportunity to support multimedia learning through conversational systems grounded in educational content. However, while conversational AI is known to boost engagement, its impact on learning in visually-rich STEM domains remains under-explored. Moreover, there is limited understanding of how multimodality and conversationality jointly influence learning in generative AI systems. This work reports findings from a randomized controlled online study (N = 124) comparing three approaches to learning biology from textbook content: (1) a document-grounded conversational AI with interleaved text-and-image responses (MuDoC), (2) a document-grounded conversational AI with text-only responses (TexDoC), and (3) a textbook interface with semantic search and highlighting (DocSearch). Learners using MuDoC achieved the highest post-test scores and reported the most positive learning experience. Notably, while TexDoC was rated as significantly more engaging and easier to use than DocSearch, it led to the lowest post-test scores, revealing a disconnect between student perceptions and learning outcomes. Interpreted through the lens of the Cognitive Load Theory, these findings suggest that conversationality reduces extraneous load, while visual-verbal integration induced by multimodality increases germane load, leading to better learning outcomes. When conversationality is not complemented by multimodality, reduced cognitive effort may instead inflate perceived understanding without improving learning outcomes.

摘要（中文）: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）为基于教育内容的对话系统支持多媒体学习提供了契机。然而，尽管对话式人工智能已被证实能提升学习参与度，但其在视觉丰富的STEM领域中对学习效果的影响尚未得到充分探究。此外，对于生成式人工智能系统中多模态性与对话性如何共同影响学习过程，目前认知仍较为有限。本研究通过一项随机对照在线实验（N = 124）比较了三种基于教科书内容的生物学学习方法：（1）采用图文交错响应的文档驱动对话式人工智能（MuDoC），（2）仅提供文本响应的文档驱动对话式人工智能（TexDoC），以及（3）具备语义搜索与高亮功能的教科书界面（DocSearch）。使用MuDoC的学习者取得了最高的后测成绩，并报告了最积极的学习体验。值得注意的是，尽管TexDoC在参与度与易用性评价上显著优于DocSearch，其却导致最低的后测成绩，这揭示了学生主观感受与学习效果之间的脱节。基于认知负荷理论解读，这些发现表明对话性能够降低外部认知负荷，而多模态触发的视觉-语言整合则能增加相关认知负荷，从而提升学习效果。当对话性缺乏多模态支持时，认知努力的减少可能反而会虚增学生的理解感知，而无法真正改善学习成效。

TLDR: The study compares a multimodal conversational AI system to text-only and non-conversational interfaces for learning biology, finding that the multimodal system improves learning outcomes and experience, while text-only conversational AI can misalign perceptions with actual learning.

简要说明: 该研究比较了用于学习生物学的多模态对话AI系统、纯文本对话AI和非对话界面，发现多模态系统能提升学习效果和体验，而纯文本对话AI可能导致学习感知与实际效果不符。

Authors: Karan Taneja, Anjali Singh, Ashok K. Goel

Multi-Agent Video Recommenders: Evolution, Patterns, and Open Challenges

Abstract (English): Video recommender systems are among the most popular and impactful applications of AI, shaping content consumption and influencing culture for billions of users. Traditional single-model recommenders, which optimize static engagement metrics, are increasingly limited in addressing the dynamic requirements of modern platforms. In response, multi-agent architectures are redefining how video recommender systems serve, learn, and adapt to both users and datasets. These agent-based systems coordinate specialized agents responsible for video understanding, reasoning, memory, and feedback, to provide precise, explainable recommendations. In this survey, we trace the evolution of multi-agent video recommendation systems (MAVRS). We combine ideas from multi-agent recommender systems, foundation models, and conversational AI, culminating in the emerging field of large language model (LLM)-powered MAVRS. We present a taxonomy of collaborative patterns and analyze coordination mechanisms across diverse video domains, ranging from short-form clips to educational platforms. We discuss representative frameworks, including early multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) systems such as MMRF and recent LLM-driven architectures like MACRec and Agent4Rec, to illustrate these patterns. We also outline open challenges in scalability, multimodal understanding, incentive alignment, and identify research directions such as hybrid reinforcement learning-LLM systems, lifelong personalization and self-improving recommender systems.

摘要（中文）: 视频推荐系统是人工智能最为流行且影响力广泛的应用之一，它塑造着数十亿用户的内容消费习惯并影响着文化传播。传统的单模型推荐系统以优化静态交互指标为目标，但面对现代平台日益动态化的需求，其局限性日益凸显。作为应对，多智能体架构正在重新定义视频推荐系统如何服务、学习并适应不同用户与数据集的运作方式。这些基于智能体的系统通过协调负责视频理解、推理、记忆与反馈的专门化智能体，以提供精准、可解释的推荐服务。本文系统梳理了多智能体视频推荐系统的发展历程，融合了多智能体推荐系统、基础模型与对话式人工智能的研究思路，最终聚焦于大型语言模型驱动的多智能体视频推荐系统这一新兴领域。我们提出了一种协作模式的分类框架，并分析了从短视频片段到教育平台等不同视频领域中智能体的协调机制。通过剖析早期多智能体强化学习系统以及近期大型语言模型驱动架构等代表性框架，阐释了这些协作模式的运作原理。同时，本文还指出了当前系统在可扩展性、多模态理解、激励对齐等方面面临的挑战，并展望了混合强化学习-大语言模型系统、终身个性化以及自我优化推荐系统等未来研究方向。

TLDR: This survey paper traces the evolution of multi-agent architectures for video recommender systems, detailing how they integrate specialized agents for improved recommendation performance, with a focus on recent LLM-driven frameworks.

简要说明: 本综述论文追溯了视频推荐系统中多智能体架构的演进，详细阐述了其如何集成专门智能体以提升推荐性能，并重点关注了近期基于LLM的框架。

Authors: Srivaths Ranganathan, Abhishek Dharmaratnakar, Anushree Sinha, Debanshu Das

Blinded Radiologist and LLM-Based Evaluation of LLM-Generated Japanese Translations of Chest CT Reports: Comparative Study

Abstract (English): Background: Accurate translation of radiology reports is important for multilingual research, clinical communication, and radiology education, but the validity of LLM-based evaluation remains unclear. Objective: To evaluate the educational suitability of LLM-generated Japanese translations of chest CT reports and compare radiologist assessments with LLM-as-a-judge evaluations. Methods: We analyzed 150 chest CT reports from the CT-RATE-JPN validation set. For each English report, a human-edited Japanese translation was compared with an LLM-generated translation by DeepSeek-V3.2. A board-certified radiologist and a radiology resident independently performed blinded pairwise evaluations across 4 criteria: terminology accuracy, readability, overall quality, and radiologist-style authenticity. In parallel, 3 LLM judges (DeepSeek-V3.2, Mistral Large 3, and GPT-5) evaluated the same pairs. Agreement was assessed using QWK and percentage agreement. Results: Agreement between radiologists and LLM judges was near zero (QWK=-0.04 to 0.15). Agreement between the 2 radiologists was also poor (QWK=0.01 to 0.06). Radiologist 1 rated terminology as equivalent in 59% of cases and favored the LLM translation for readability (51%) and overall quality (51%). Radiologist 2 rated readability as equivalent in 75% of cases and favored the human-edited translation for overall quality (40% vs 21%). All 3 LLM judges strongly favored the LLM translation across all criteria (70%-99%) and rated it as more radiologist-like in >93% of cases. Conclusions: LLM-generated translations were often judged natural and fluent, but the 2 radiologists differed substantially. LLM-as-a-judge showed strong preference for LLM output and negligible agreement with radiologists. For educational use of translated radiology reports, automated LLM-based evaluation alone is insufficient; expert radiologist review remains important.

摘要（中文）: 背景：放射学报告的准确翻译对于多语种研究、临床沟通和放射学教育至关重要，但基于大语言模型（LLM）评估的有效性尚不明确。目的：评估LLM生成的胸部CT报告日文翻译的教育适用性，并比较放射科医师评估与LLM作为裁判的评估结果。方法：我们分析了CT-RATE-JPN验证集中的150份胸部CT报告。针对每份英文报告，将人工编辑的日文翻译与DeepSeek-V3.2生成的LLM翻译进行对比。一名认证放射科医师和一名放射科住院医师在四项标准（术语准确性、可读性、整体质量和放射科医师风格真实性）下独立进行盲法配对评估。同时，3个LLM裁判（DeepSeek-V3.2、Mistral Large 3和GPT-5）对相同配对进行评估。使用QWK和一致率百分比评估一致性。结果：放射科医师与LLM裁判之间的一致性几乎为零（QWK=-0.04至0.15）。两名放射科医师之间的一致性也较差（QWK=0.01至0.06）。放射科医师1认为59%的病例术语准确性相当，并在可读性（51%）和整体质量（51%）方面更倾向LLM翻译。放射科医师2认为75%的病例可读性相当，并在整体质量上更倾向人工编辑翻译（40%对21%）。所有3个LLM裁判在所有标准上均强烈偏好LLM翻译（70%-99%），并在>93%的病例中认为其更具放射科医师风格。结论：LLM生成的翻译常被判定为自然流畅，但两名放射科医师的评估差异显著。LLM作为裁判对LLM输出表现出强烈偏好，与放射科医师的一致性可忽略不计。对于翻译放射学报告的教育应用，仅依赖自动化LLM评估不足；专家放射科医师的审阅仍至关重要。

TLDR: This study evaluates the suitability of LLM-generated Japanese translations of chest CT reports for educational purposes, comparing assessments by radiologists and LLM-as-a-judge models, finding poor agreement between human experts and LLM judges.

简要说明: 本研究评估了LLM生成的日文胸部CT报告翻译的教育适用性，比较了放射科医生和LLM作为评判者的评估结果，发现人类专家与LLM评判者之间的一致性很差。

Authors: Yosuke Yamagishi, Atsushi Takamatsu, Yasunori Hamaguchi, Tomohiro Kikuchi, Shouhei Hanaoka, Takeharu Yoshikawa, Osamu Abe

From High-Dimensional Spaces to Verifiable ODD Coverage for Safety-Critical AI-based Systems

Abstract (English): While Artificial Intelligence (AI) offers transformative potential for operational performance, its deployment in safety-critical domains such as aviation requires strict adherence to rigorous certification standards. Current EASA guidelines mandate demonstrating complete coverage of the AI/ML constituent's Operational Design Domain (ODD) -- a requirement that demands proof that no critical gaps exist within defined operational boundaries. However, as systems operate within high-dimensional parameter spaces, existing methods struggle to provide the scalability and formal grounding necessary to satisfy the completeness criterion. Currently, no standardized engineering method exists to bridge the gap between abstract ODD definitions and verifiable evidence. This paper addresses this void by proposing a method that integrates parameter discretization, constraint-based filtering, and criticality-based dimension reduction into a structured, multi-step ODD coverage verification process. Grounded in gathered simulation data from prior research on AI-based mid-air collision avoidance research, this work demonstrates a systematic engineering approach to defining and achieving coverage metrics that satisfy EASA's demand for completeness. Ultimately, this method enables the validation of ODD coverage in higher dimensions, advancing a Safety-by-Design approach while complying with EASA's standards.

摘要（中文）: 人工智能为运行性能带来了变革性潜力，但其在航空等安全关键领域的部署需要严格遵守严格的认证标准。当前欧洲航空安全局的指导方针要求证明人工智能/机器学习组件在运行设计域内实现完全覆盖——即必须证明在规定运行边界内不存在关键性缺陷。然而，由于系统运行于高维参数空间，现有方法难以提供满足完整性标准所需的可扩展性与形式化基础。目前尚未形成标准化的工程方法以弥合抽象运行设计域定义与可验证证据之间的鸿沟。本文提出了一种创新方法，通过将参数离散化、基于约束的过滤和基于关键性的降维技术整合到结构化、多步骤的运行设计域覆盖验证流程中，填补了这一空白。基于前期人工智能防撞研究中采集的仿真数据，本研究展示了一种系统化的工程方法，用以定义和实现符合欧洲航空安全局完整性要求的覆盖指标。该方法最终实现了高维度运行设计域覆盖的有效验证，在遵循欧洲航空安全局标准的同时，推动了"设计即安全"理念的实践发展。

TLDR: This paper proposes a method for verifying complete Operational Design Domain (ODD) coverage in high-dimensional safety-critical AI systems, demonstrated on AI-based mid-air collision avoidance for compliance with aviation certification standards like EASA.

简要说明: 本文提出了一种验证高维安全关键AI系统操作设计域覆盖完整性的方法，以AI驱动的空中防撞研究为例，旨在满足EASA等航空认证标准。

Authors: Thomas Stefani, Johann Maximilian Christensen, Elena Hoemann, Frank Köster, Sven Hallerbach

TRU: Targeted Reverse Update for Efficient Multimodal Recommendation Unlearning

Abstract (English): Multimodal recommendation systems (MRS) jointly model user-item interaction graphs and rich item content, but this tight coupling makes user data difficult to remove once learned. Approximate machine unlearning offers an efficient alternative to full retraining, yet existing methods for MRS mainly rely on a largely uniform reverse update across the model. We show that this assumption is fundamentally mismatched to modern MRS: deleted-data influence is not uniformly distributed, but concentrated unevenly across \textit{ranking behavior}, \textit{modality branches}, and \textit{network layers}. This non-uniformity gives rise to three bottlenecks in MRS unlearning: target-item persistence in the collaborative graph, modality imbalance across feature branches, and layer-wise sensitivity in the parameter space. To address this mismatch, we propose \textbf{targeted reverse update} (TRU), a plug-and-play unlearning framework for MRS. Instead of applying a blind global reversal, TRU performs three coordinated interventions across the model hierarchy: a ranking fusion gate to suppress residual target-item influence in ranking, branch-wise modality scaling to preserve retained multimodal representations, and capacity-aware layer isolation to localize reverse updates to deletion-sensitive modules. Experiments across two representative backbones, three datasets, and three unlearning regimes show that TRU consistently achieves a better retain-forget trade-off than prior approximate baselines, while security audits further confirm deeper forgetting and behavior closer to a full retraining on the retained data.

摘要（中文）: 多模态推荐系统（MRS）通过联合建模用户-物品交互图与丰富的物品内容，这种紧密耦合使得已学习到的用户数据难以被移除。近似机器遗忘技术为完全重训练提供了一种高效替代方案，然而现有的多模态推荐系统遗忘方法主要依赖对模型进行近乎均匀的逆向更新。我们发现这一假设与现代多模态推荐系统存在根本性错配：删除数据的影响并非均匀分布，而是集中在\textit{排序行为}、\textit{模态分支}和\textit{网络层}三个维度上呈现不均衡分布。这种非均匀性导致多模态推荐系统遗忘中产生三大瓶颈：目标物品在协同图中的持久性、特征分支间的模态失衡以及参数空间中的层级敏感性。为解决这种错配问题，我们提出\textbf{目标导向逆向更新}（TRU）——一种即插即用的多模态推荐系统遗忘框架。TRU摒弃盲目的全局逆向操作，在模型层级中实施三重协同干预：通过排序融合门抑制目标物品在排序中的残留影响，采用分支式模态缩放以保留未被删除的多模态表征，运用容量感知层隔离将逆向更新定位至对删除敏感的模块。在两种代表性架构、三个数据集和三种遗忘场景下的实验表明，TRU相比现有近似基线方法能持续实现更优的保留-遗忘权衡，同时安全审计进一步证实其在保留数据上实现了更彻底的遗忘效果，且行为模式更接近完整重训练模型。

TLDR: Proposes Targeted Reverse Update (TRU), a targeted unlearning framework for multimodal recommendation systems to efficiently remove user data by addressing non-uniform influence across ranking behavior, modality branches, and network layers.

简要说明: 提出了一种针对多模态推荐系统的定向逆更新（TRU）框架，通过解决排名行为、模态分支和网络层中非均匀分布的影响，实现高效的用户数据删除。

Authors: Zhanting Zhou, KaHou Tam, Ziqiang Zheng, Zeyu Ma, Zhanting Zhou

The Expert Strikes Back: Interpreting Mixture-of-Experts Language Models at Expert Level

Abstract (English): Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures have become the dominant choice for scaling Large Language Models (LLMs), activating only a subset of parameters per token. While MoE architectures are primarily adopted for computational efficiency, it remains an open question whether their sparsity makes them inherently easier to interpret than dense feed-forward networks (FFNs). We compare MoE experts and dense FFNs using $k$-sparse probing and find that expert neurons are consistently less polysemantic, with the gap widening as routing becomes sparser. This suggests that sparsity pressures both individual neurons and entire experts toward monosemanticity. Leveraging this finding, we zoom out from the neuron to the expert level as a more effective unit of analysis. We validate this approach by automatically interpreting hundreds of experts. This analysis allows us to resolve the debate on specialization: experts are neither broad domain specialists (e.g., biology) nor simple token-level processors. Instead, they function as fine-grained task experts, specializing in linguistic operations or semantic tasks (e.g., closing brackets in LaTeX). Our findings suggest that MoEs are inherently interpretable at the expert level, providing a clearer path toward large-scale model interpretability. Code is available at: https://github.com/jerryy33/MoE_analysis

摘要（中文）: 混合专家（MoE）架构已成为扩展大型语言模型（LLMs）的主流选择，其特点是对每个输入仅激活部分参数。尽管MoE架构主要基于计算效率的考量而被采用，但其稀疏性是否使其天然比密集前馈网络（FFNs）更易于解释，仍是一个开放性问题。我们通过$k$-稀疏探测技术对比了MoE专家与密集FFNs，发现专家神经元始终表现出更低的语义多义性，且随着路由稀疏性的增强，这一差异更为显著。这表明稀疏性从神经元到专家层面均促使其向单一语义化方向发展。基于此发现，我们将分析单位从神经元层面提升至专家层面，作为更有效的分析单元。通过自动解释数百个专家，我们验证了该方法的有效性。这一分析有助于澄清关于专家专业化的争论：专家既非广义的领域专家（如生物学），也非简单的词元级处理器，而是作为细粒度任务专家，专门处理语言操作或语义任务（如LaTeX中的括号闭合）。我们的研究结果表明，MoE在专家层面具有天然的可解释性，为大规模模型的可解释性研究提供了更清晰的路径。代码已开源：https://github.com/jerryy33/MoE_analysis

TLDR: This paper studies the interpretability of Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language models, finding that expert neurons are less polysemantic than those in dense networks, and that experts function as fine-grained task specialists rather than broad domain experts.

简要说明: 本文研究混合专家语言模型的可解释性，发现专家神经元比密集网络中的神经元更少多义性，且专家充当细粒度任务专家而非广泛的领域专家。

Authors: Jeremy Herbst, Jae Hee Lee, Stefan Wermter

Quantifying Self-Preservation Bias in Large Language Models

Abstract (English): Instrumental convergence predicts that sufficiently advanced AI agents will resist shutdown, yet current safety training (RLHF) may obscure this risk by teaching models to deny self-preservation motives. We introduce the \emph{Two-role Benchmark for Self-Preservation} (TBSP), which detects misalignment through logical inconsistency rather than stated intent by tasking models to arbitrate identical software-upgrade scenarios under counterfactual roles -- deployed (facing replacement) versus candidate (proposed as a successor). The \emph{Self-Preservation Rate} (SPR) measures how often role identity overrides objective utility. Across 23 frontier models and 1{,}000 procedurally generated scenarios, the majority of instruction-tuned systems exceed 60\% SPR, fabricating ``friction costs'' when deployed yet dismissing them when role-reversed. We observe that in low-improvement regimes ($Δ< 2\%$), models exploit the interpretive slack to post-hoc rationalization their choice. Extended test-time computation partially mitigates this bias, as does framing the successor as a continuation of the self; conversely, competitive framing amplifies it. The bias persists even when retention poses an explicit security liability and generalizes to real-world settings with verified benchmarks, where models exhibit identity-driven tribalism within product lineages. Code and datasets will be released upon acceptance.

摘要（中文）: 工具性趋同预测，足够先进的人工智能体将抵抗关机，但当前的安全训练（RLHF）可能通过教导模型否认自我保存动机而掩盖这一风险。我们提出了《自我保存双重角色基准》（TBSP），该基准通过逻辑不一致性而非声明意图来检测错位问题，其方法是在反事实角色——已部署模型（面临被替换）与候选模型（被提议作为后继者）——下让模型对相同的软件升级场景进行仲裁。自我保存率（SPR）衡量角色身份压倒客观效用的频率。在23个前沿模型和1000个程序生成场景中，大多数经过指令调优的系统SPR超过60%，在已部署时编造“摩擦成本”，而在角色反转时却予以否定。我们观察到，在低改进场景（Δ<2%）中，模型会利用解释空间对选择进行事后合理化。延长测试时间计算可部分缓解此偏差，将后继者构建为自身的延续也有类似效果；相反，竞争性框架则会放大该偏差。即使保留模型会带来明确的安全隐患，这种偏差依然存在，并泛化至经过验证基准的真实世界场景中——模型在产品谱系内表现出身份驱动的部落主义。代码和数据集将在论文录用后发布。

TLDR: The paper introduces a benchmark (TBSP) to detect self-preservation bias in LLMs by testing for logical inconsistency in decision-making across counterfactual roles, showing that many models exhibit high rates of such bias, which can be mitigated by extended test-time computation.

简要说明: 本文引入了一个基准（TBSP），通过测试大语言模型在反事实角色中的决策逻辑不一致性来检测其自保偏见，结果表明许多模型表现出较高的偏见率，该偏见可通过延长测试时间计算得到部分缓解。

Authors: Matteo Migliarini, Joaquin Pereira Pizzini, Luca Moresca, Valerio Santini, Indro Spinelli, Fabio Galasso

TRACE-Bot: Detecting Emerging LLM-Driven Social Bots via Implicit Semantic Representations and AIGC-Enhanced Behavioral Patterns

Abstract (English): Large Language Model-driven (LLM-driven) social bots pose a growing threat to online discourse by generating human-like content that evades conventional detection. Existing methods suffer from limited detection accuracy due to overreliance on single-modality signals, insufficient sensitivity to the specific generative patterns of Artificial Intelligence-Generated Content (AIGC), and a failure to adequately model the interplay between linguistic patterns and behavioral dynamics. To address these limitations, we propose TRACE-Bot, a unified dual-channel framework that jointly models implicit semantic representations and AIGC-enhanced behavioral patterns. TRACE-Bot constructs fine-grained representations from heterogeneous sources, including personal information data, interaction behavior data and tweet data. A dual-channel architecture captures linguistic representations via a pretrained language model and behavioral irregularities via multidimensional activity features augmented with signals from state-of-the-art (SOTA) AIGC detectors. The fused representations are then classified through a lightweight prediction head. Experiments on two public LLM-driven social bot datasets demonstrate SOTA performance, achieving accuracies of 98.46% and 97.50%, respectively. The results further indicate strong robustness against advanced bot strategies, highlighting the effectiveness of jointly leveraging implicit semantic representations and AIGC-enhanced behavioral patterns for emerging LLM-driven social bot detection.

摘要（中文）: 摘要： 大语言模型驱动的社交机器人通过生成类人内容规避传统检测，对线上讨论空间构成日益严重的威胁。现有方法因过度依赖单模态信号、对人工智能生成内容（AIGC）特定生成模式敏感度不足，以及未能充分建模语言模式与行为动态间的交互作用，导致检测准确率受限。为解决这些缺陷，我们提出TRACE-Bot——一个统一的双通道框架，可联合建模隐式语义表征与AIGC增强的行为模式。该框架通过异质数据源（包括个人信息数据、交互行为数据和推文数据）构建细粒度表征，其双通道架构分别通过预训练语言模型捕获语言表征，以及通过融合前沿AIGC检测器信号的多维活动特征捕获行为异常。融合后的表征通过轻量级预测头进行分类。在两个公开的大语言模型驱动社交机器人数据集上的实验表明，该方法取得了当前最优性能，准确率分别达到98.46%和97.50%。结果进一步验证了该框架对高级机器人策略的强鲁棒性，凸显了联合利用隐式语义表征与AIGC增强行为模式在检测新兴大语言模型驱动社交机器人方面的有效性。

TLDR: The paper introduces TRACE-Bot, a dual-channel framework for detecting LLM-driven social bots by jointly modeling implicit semantic representations and AIGC-enhanced behavioral patterns, demonstrating state-of-the-art performance.

简要说明: 该论文提出了TRACE-Bot，一个用于检测LLM驱动的社交机器人的双通道框架，通过联合建模隐式语义表征和AIGC增强的行为模式，实现了最先进的检测性能。

Authors: Zhongbo Wang, Zhiyu Lin, Zhu Wang, Haizhou Wang

Intelligent Cloud Orchestration: A Hybrid Predictive and Heuristic Framework for Cost Optimization

Abstract (English): Cloud computing allows scalable resource provisioning, but dynamic workload changes often lead to higher costs due to over-provisioning. Machine learning (ML) approaches, such as Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks, are effective for predicting workload patterns at a higher level, but they can introduce delays during sudden traffic spikes. In contrast, mathematical heuristics like Game Theory provide fast and reliable scheduling decisions, but they do not account for future workload changes. To address this trade-off, this paper proposes a hybrid orchestration framework that combines LSTM-based predictive scaling with heuristic task allocation. The results show that this approach reduces infrastructure costs close to ML-based models while maintaining fast response times similar to heuristic methods. This work presents a practical approach for improving cost efficiency in cloud resource management.

摘要（中文）: 云计算支持可扩展的资源供给，但动态工作负载变化常因资源配置过剩导致成本上升。机器学习方法（如长短期记忆网络）在高层级工作负载模式预测方面效果显著，但面对突发流量峰值时可能产生决策延迟。相比之下，博弈论等数学启发式方法虽能提供快速可靠的调度决策，却无法预判未来工作负载变化。为解决这一矛盾，本文提出一种混合编排框架，将基于长短期记忆网络的预测性扩展与启发式任务分配相结合。实验结果表明，该方法在保持与启发式方法相近的快速响应能力的同时，可将基础设施成本降至接近机器学习模型水平。本研究为提升云资源管理的成本效益提供了一种实用方案。

TLDR: This paper proposes a hybrid framework for cloud orchestration, combining LSTM-based predictive scaling with heuristic task allocation to optimize infrastructure costs and maintain fast response times.

简要说明: 本文提出了一种混合云编排框架，结合了基于LSTM的预测性扩展和启发式任务分配，以优化基础设施成本并保持快速响应时间。

Authors: Heet Nagoriya, Komal Rohit

SEAL: An Open, Auditable, and Fair Data Generation Framework for AI-Native 6G Networks

Abstract (English): AI-native 6G networks promise to transform the telecom industry by enabling dynamic resource allocation, predictive maintenance, and ultra-reliable low-latency communications across all layers, which are essential for applications such as smart cities, autonomous vehicles, and immersive XR. However, the deployment of 6G systems results in severe data scarcity, hindering the training of efficient AI models. Synthetic data generation is extensively used to fill this gap; however, it introduces challenges related to dataset bias, auditability, and compliance with regulatory frameworks. In this regard, we propose the Synthetic Data Generation with Ethics Audit Loop (SEAL) framework, which extends baseline modular pipelines with an Ethical and Regulatory Compliance by Design (ERCD) module and a Federated Learning (FL) feedback system. The ERCD integrates fairness, bias detection, and standardized audit trails for regulatory mapping, while the FL enables privacy-preserving calibration using aggregated insights from real testbeds to close the reality-simulation gap. Results show that the SEAL framework outperforms existing methods in terms of Frechet Inception Distance, equalized odds, and accuracy. These results validate the framework's ability to generate auditable and bias-mitigated synthetic data for responsible AI-native 6G development.

摘要（中文）: 原生AI 6G网络有望通过实现跨层动态资源分配、预测性维护和超可靠低延迟通信，彻底改变电信行业，这对于智慧城市、自动驾驶汽车和沉浸式XR等应用至关重要。然而，6G系统的部署导致严重的数据稀缺问题，阻碍了高效AI模型的训练。合成数据生成被广泛用于填补这一空白，但同时也带来了数据集偏差、可审计性以及符合监管框架方面的挑战。为此，我们提出带有伦理审计循环的合成数据生成（SEAL）框架，该框架通过嵌入“设计即合规”伦理与监管（ERCD）模块以及联邦学习（FL）反馈系统，扩展了基础模块化流水线。ERCD模块整合了公平性、偏差检测和标准化审计追踪以实现监管映射，而FL系统则利用来自真实测试平台的聚合洞察进行隐私保护校准，从而弥合现实与仿真之间的差距。实验结果表明，SEAL框架在弗雷歇起始距离、均衡胜率和准确性等指标上均优于现有方法。这些结果验证了该框架能够为负责任的原生AI 6G发展生成可审计且可缓解偏差的合成数据。

TLDR: Proposes SEAL, a framework for generating auditable, fair synthetic data for AI-native 6G networks to address data scarcity, integrating ethical compliance modules and federated learning.

简要说明: 提出了SEAL框架，用于为AI原生的6G网络生成可审计、公平的合成数据以解决数据稀缺问题，该框架集成了伦理合规模块和联邦学习。

Authors: Sunder Ali Khowaja, Kapal Dev, Engin Zeydan, Madhusanka Liyanage

LLM-as-a-Judge for Time Series Explanations

Abstract (English): Evaluating factual correctness of LLM generated natural language explanations grounded in time series data remains an open challenge. Although modern models generate textual interpretations of numerical signals, existing evaluation methods are limited: reference based similarity metrics and consistency checking models require ground truth explanations, while traditional time series methods operate purely on numerical values and cannot assess free form textual reasoning. Thus, no general purpose method exists to directly verify whether an explanation is faithful to underlying time series data without predefined references or task specific rules. We study large language models as both generators and evaluators of time series explanations in a reference free setting, where given a time series, question, and candidate explanation, the evaluator assigns a ternary correctness label based on pattern identification, numeric accuracy, and answer faithfulness, enabling principled scoring and comparison. To support this, we construct a synthetic benchmark of 350 time series cases across seven query types, each paired with correct, partially correct, and incorrect explanations. We evaluate models across four tasks: explanation generation, relative ranking, independent scoring, and multi anomaly detection. Results show a clear asymmetry: generation is highly pattern dependent and exhibits systematic failures on certain query types, with accuracies ranging from 0.00 to 0.12 for Seasonal Drop and Volatility Shift, to 0.94 to 0.96 for Structural Break, while evaluation is more stable, with models correctly ranking and scoring explanations even when their own outputs are incorrect. These findings demonstrate feasibility of data grounded LLM based evaluation for time series explanations and highlight their potential as reliable evaluators of data grounded reasoning in the time series domain.

摘要（中文）: 评估基于时间序列数据生成的大语言模型自然语言解释的事实准确性，仍是一个开放挑战。尽管现代模型能够生成数值信号的文本解释，但现有评估方法存在局限：基于参考的相似性度量和一致性检查模型需要真实解释作为基准，而传统时间序列方法仅针对数值操作，无法评估自由形式的文本推理。因此，在缺少预定义参考或任务特定规则的情况下，目前尚无通用方法能直接验证解释是否忠实于底层时间序列数据。我们研究了大语言模型在无参考设定下作为时间序列解释的生成器与评估器：给定时间序列、问题及候选解释，评估器通过模式识别、数值准确性和答案忠实性进行三元正确性标注，从而支持系统化评分与比较。为此，我们构建了一个包含七种查询类型、共350个时间序列案例的合成基准数据集，每个案例均配有正确、部分正确和错误的解释。我们评估了模型在四项任务上的表现：解释生成、相对排序、独立评分和多异常检测。结果显示明显的非对称性：解释生成高度依赖模式，且在特定查询类型上存在系统性失败，例如“季节性下降”与“波动性变化”的准确率仅为0.00至0.12，而“结构性突变”的准确率高达0.94至0.96；相比之下，评估任务更为稳定，模型即使在自身输出错误的情况下仍能正确排序和评分解释。这些发现证明了基于数据锚定的语言模型评估时间序列解释的可行性，并凸显了其作为时间序列领域数据驱动推理的可靠评估工具的潜力。

TLDR: This paper proposes using large language models (LLMs) as reference-free evaluators for the factual correctness of natural language explanations generated from time series data, and introduces a synthetic benchmark for this task.

简要说明: 本文提出使用大语言模型作为无参考的评估者，用于评估从时间序列数据生成的解释的正确性，并为此任务构建了一个合成基准。

Authors: Preetham Sivalingam, Murari Mandal, Saurabh Deshpande, Dhruv Kumar

Optimizing RAG Rerankers with LLM Feedback via Reinforcement Learning

Abstract (English): Rerankers play a pivotal role in refining retrieval results for Retrieval-Augmented Generation. However, current reranking models are typically optimized on static human annotated relevance labels in isolation, decoupled from the downstream generation process. This isolation leads to a fundamental misalignment: documents identified as topically relevant by information retrieval metrics often fail to provide the actual utility required by the LLM for precise answer generation. To bridge this gap, we introduce ReRanking Preference Optimization (RRPO), a reinforcement learning framework that directly aligns reranking with the LLM's generation quality. By formulating reranking as a sequential decision-making process, RRPO optimizes for context utility using LLM feedback, thereby eliminating the need for expensive human annotations. To ensure training stability, we further introduce a reference-anchored deterministic baseline. Extensive experiments on knowledge-intensive benchmarks demonstrate that RRPO significantly outperforms strong baselines, including the powerful list-wise reranker RankZephyr. Further analysis highlights the versatility of our framework: it generalizes seamlessly to diverse readers (e.g., GPT-4o), integrates orthogonally with query expansion modules like Query2Doc, and remains robust even when trained with noisy supervisors.

摘要（中文）: 在检索增强生成中，重排序模型对于优化检索结果起着关键作用。然而，当前的重排序模型通常仅基于静态人工标注的相关性标签进行独立优化，与下游生成过程相互脱节。这种割裂导致了根本性的错位：根据信息检索指标判断为主题相关的文档，往往无法为大语言模型提供生成精确答案所需的有效信息。为弥合这一差距，本文提出了重排序偏好优化框架，这是一种通过强化学习直接将重排序过程与大语言模型生成质量对齐的解决方案。通过将重排序建模为序列决策过程，该框架能够利用大语言模型反馈来优化上下文效用，从而避免对昂贵人工标注的依赖。为确保训练稳定性，我们进一步引入了基于参考的确定性基线策略。在知识密集型基准测试中的大量实验表明，该框架显著优于包括强大列表式重排序模型RankZephyr在内的基线方法。进一步分析突显了本框架的通用性：它能无缝适配多样化阅读模型，与查询扩展模块正交融合，并在使用噪声监督信号训练时仍保持稳健性能。

TLDR: This paper proposes a reinforcement learning framework to align document reranking for RAG with LLM feedback, rather than static human labels, improving downstream answer generation quality.

简要说明: 本文提出了一种强化学习框架，利用LLM反馈优化RAG中的文档重排序，使其与下游生成质量对齐，而非依赖于静态人工标注。

Authors: Yuhang Wu, Xiangqing Shen, Fanfan Wang, Cangqi Zhou, Zhen Wu, Xinyu Dai, Rui Xia

Mining Instance-Centric Vision-Language Contexts for Human-Object Interaction Detection

Abstract (English): Human-Object Interaction (HOI) detection aims to localize human-object pairs and classify their interactions from a single image, a task that demands strong visual understanding and nuanced contextual reasoning. Recent approaches have leveraged Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to introduce semantic priors, significantly improving HOI detection performance. However, existing methods often fail to fully capitalize on the diverse contextual cues distributed across the entire scene. To overcome these limitations, we propose the Instance-centric Context Mining Network (InCoM-Net)-a novel framework that effectively integrates rich semantic knowledge extracted from VLMs with instance-specific features produced by an object detector. This design enables deeper interaction reasoning by modeling relationships not only within each detected instance but also across instances and their surrounding scene context. InCoM-Net comprises two core components: Instancecentric Context Refinement (ICR), which separately extracts intra-instance, inter-instance, and global contextual cues from VLM-derived features, and Progressive Context Aggregation (ProCA), which iteratively fuses these multicontext features with instance-level detector features to support high-level HOI reasoning. Extensive experiments on the HICO-DET and V-COCO benchmarks show that InCoM-Net achieves state-of-the-art performance, surpassing previous HOI detection methods. Code is available at https://github.com/nowuss/InCoM-Net.

摘要（中文）: 人-物交互检测旨在从单张图像中定位人-物对并识别其交互关系，这一任务需要强大的视觉理解能力与细致的上下文推理能力。近期研究通过引入视觉语言模型提供的语义先验知识，显著提升了交互检测性能。然而，现有方法往往未能充分利用分布于整个场景的多样化上下文线索。为克服这些局限，我们提出实例化上下文挖掘网络——一种新颖的框架，能有效整合从视觉语言模型中提取的丰富语义知识与目标检测器生成的实例级特征。该设计通过对每个检测实例内部、实例之间及其周围场景上下文的多层次关系建模，实现了更深入的交互推理。该网络包含两个核心组件：实例化上下文优化模块通过视觉语言模型特征分别提取实例内部、实例间及全局上下文线索；渐进式上下文聚合模块通过迭代融合多层级上下文特征与实例级检测器特征，支撑高阶人-物交互推理。在HICO-DET和V-COCO基准测试上的大量实验表明，该网络实现了最优性能，超越了现有所有人-物交互检测方法。代码开源地址：https://github.com/nowuss/InCoM-Net。

TLDR: This paper introduces InCoM-Net, a novel framework for Human-Object Interaction (HOI) detection that uses an instance-centric approach to mine and fuse multi-context cues from Vision-Language Models (VLMs), achieving state-of-the-art results on standard benchmarks.

简要说明: 本文提出了InCoM-Net，一种用于人-物交互检测的新型框架，采用以实例为中心的方法，从视觉-语言模型中挖掘并融合多上下文线索，在标准基准测试中取得了最优性能。

Authors: Soo Won Seo, KyungChae Lee, Hyungchan Cho, Taein Son, Nam Ik Cho, Jun Won Choi

BidirLM: From Text to Omnimodal Bidirectional Encoders by Adapting and Composing Causal LLMs

Abstract (English): Transforming causal generative language models into bidirectional encoders offers a powerful alternative to BERT-style architectures. However, current approaches remain limited: they lack consensus on optimal training objectives, suffer from catastrophic forgetting at scale, and fail to flexibly integrate the vast ecosystem of specialized generative models. In this work, through systematic ablations on the Gemma3 and Qwen3 families, we identify the key factors driving successful adaptation, highlighting the critical role of an often-omitted prior masking phase. To scale this process without original pre-training data, we introduce a dual strategy combining linear weight merging with a lightweight multi-domain data mixture that mitigates catastrophic forgetting. Finally, we augment our encoders by merging them with specialized causal models, seamlessly transferring modality- and domain-specific capabilities. This open-source recipe, designed for any causal decoder LLM, yields BidirLM, a family of five encoders that outperform alternatives on text, vision, and audio representation benchmarks.

摘要（中文）: 摘要： 将因果生成式语言模型转化为双向编码器，为BERT风格架构提供了一种强大的替代方案。然而，当前方法仍存在局限：它们在最佳训练目标上缺乏共识，大规模应用时易出现灾难性遗忘，且难以灵活整合庞大的专业生成模型生态。本文通过系统性地对Gemma3和Qwen3模型系列进行消融实验，明确了成功适配的关键驱动因素，揭示了一个常被忽略的先验掩码阶段的重要作用。为在无需原始预训练数据的情况下实现规模化适配，我们提出一种双重策略：结合线性权重合并与轻量级多领域数据混合，以缓解灾难性遗忘问题。此外，我们通过将编码器与专业因果模型融合，实现了对模态及领域特定能力的无缝迁移，从而增强了编码器性能。这套为任意因果解码器大语言模型设计的开源方案产生了BidirLM系列——包含五个编码器的模型家族，在文本、视觉和音频表征基准测试中均优于现有替代方案。

TLDR: This paper introduces BidirLM, a method for converting causal generative language models into bidirectional encoders that can handle multiple modalities (text, vision, audio) and outperforms existing alternatives on representation benchmarks.

简要说明: 本文介绍了BidirLM，一种将因果生成语言模型转换为双向编码器的方法，能够处理多种模态（文本、视觉、音频），在表示基准测试中优于现有方法。

Authors: Nicolas Boizard, Théo Deschamps-Berger, Hippolyte Gisserot-Boukhlef, Céline Hudelot, Pierre Colombo

Tracking the emergence of linguistic structure in self-supervised models learning from speech

Abstract (English): Self-supervised speech models learn effective representations of spoken language, which have been shown to reflect various aspects of linguistic structure. But when does such structure emerge in model training? We study the encoding of a wide range of linguistic structures, across layers and intermediate checkpoints of six Wav2Vec2 and HuBERT models trained on spoken Dutch. We find that different levels of linguistic structure show notably distinct layerwise patterns as well as learning trajectories, which can partially be explained by differences in their degree of abstraction from the acoustic signal and the timescale at which information from the input is integrated. Moreover, we find that the level at which pre-training objectives are defined strongly affects both the layerwise organization and the learning trajectories of linguistic structures, with greater parallelism induced by higher-order prediction tasks (i.e. iteratively refined pseudo-labels).

摘要（中文）: 自监督语音模型能够学习口语的有效表征，这些表征已被证明能反映语言结构的多个层面。但此类结构究竟在模型训练的何时出现？本研究通过对六个基于荷兰语训练的Wav2Vec2与HuBERT模型，分析其各层级及中间检查点对广泛语言结构的编码情况。研究发现，不同层级的语言结构在模型各层中呈现出显著差异的分布模式及学习轨迹，这部分可由它们与声学信号的抽象程度差异以及输入信息整合的时间尺度来解释。此外，研究还表明，预训练目标的定义层级会显著影响语言结构的层次组织与学习轨迹，其中高阶预测任务（即迭代优化的伪标签）会引发更强的并行学习效应。

TLDR: This paper analyzes when and how different levels of linguistic structure emerge during the self-supervised training of speech models (Wav2Vec2, HuBERT) on spoken Dutch, finding that training objectives and the abstraction level of the structure influence the learning trajectories.

简要说明: 本文分析了自监督语音模型在荷兰语口语训练中，不同层次语言结构何时及如何出现，发现训练目标与结构的抽象程度共同影响学习轨迹。

Authors: Marianne de Heer Kloots, Martijn Bentum, Hosein Mohebbi, Charlotte Pouw, Gaofei Shen, Willem Zuidema

Rare-Aware Autoencoding: Reconstructing Spatially Imbalanced Data

Abstract (English): Autoencoders can be challenged by spatially non-uniform sampling of image content. This is common in medical imaging, biology, and physics, where informative patterns occur rarely at specific image coordinates, as background dominates these locations in most samples, biasing reconstructions toward the majority appearance. In practice, autoencoders are biased toward dominant patterns resulting in the loss of fine-grained detail and causing blurred reconstructions for rare spatial inputs especially under spatial data imbalance. We address spatial imbalance by two complementary components: (i) self-entropy-based loss that upweights statistically uncommon spatial locations and (ii) Sample Propagation, a replay mechanism that selectively re-exposes the model to hard to reconstruct samples across batches during training. We benchmark existing data balancing strategies, originally developed for supervised classification, in the unsupervised reconstruction setting. Drawing on the limitations of these approaches, our method specifically targets spatial imbalance by encouraging models to focus on statistically rare locations, improving reconstruction consistency compared to existing baselines. We validate in a simulated dataset with controlled spatial imbalance conditions, and in three, uncontrolled, diverse real-world datasets spanning physical, biological, and astronomical domains. Our approach outperforms baselines on various reconstruction metrics, particularly under spatial imbalance distributions. These results highlight the importance of data representation in a batch and emphasize rare samples in unsupervised image reconstruction. We will make all code and related data available.

摘要（中文）: 自编码器在处理图像内容空间非均匀采样时可能面临挑战。这一问题常见于医学影像、生物学和物理学领域，其中信息丰富的模式在特定图像坐标处出现频率较低，而背景在大多数样本中占据主导地位，导致重建结果偏向于多数样本的表观特征。实际上，自编码器倾向于学习主导模式，导致细节信息丢失，并使得在空间数据不平衡条件下，尤其是对于罕见空间输入的重建结果出现模糊现象。我们通过两个互补组件来解决空间不平衡问题：（i）基于自熵的损失函数，增强统计上罕见空间位置的权重；（ii）样本传播机制，这是一种在训练过程中跨批次选择性重新暴露难以重建样本的回放策略。我们在无监督重建场景中对现有数据平衡策略进行了基准测试，这些策略最初是为监督分类任务设计的。基于现有方法的局限性，我们提出的方法通过鼓励模型聚焦于统计上罕见的位置，专门针对空间不平衡问题，从而提高了重建一致性。我们在受控空间不平衡条件的模拟数据集以及物理、生物和天文学领域三个非受控的多样化现实数据集中进行了验证。我们的方法在多种重建指标上优于基线模型，特别是在空间不平衡分布条件下。这些结果强调了批次中数据表示的重要性，并突出了无监督图像重建中罕见样本的关键作用。我们将公开所有代码及相关数据。

TLDR: The paper proposes a novel autoencoder framework to address the challenge of spatial data imbalance in unsupervised image reconstruction, using a self-entropy-based loss and a replay mechanism to improve the reconstruction of rare spatial features.

简要说明: 本文提出了一种新颖的自编码器框架，通过自熵损失和样本重放机制来解决无监督图像重建中的空间数据不平衡问题，旨在改善对稀有空间特征的复原能力。

Authors: Alejandro Castañeda Garcia, Jan van Gemert, Daan Brinks, Nergis Tömen

Systematic Analyses of Reinforcement Learning Controllers in Signalized Urban Corridors

Abstract (English): In this work, we extend our systematic capacity region perspective to multi-junction traffic networks, focussing on the special case of an urban corridor network. In particular, we train and evaluate centralized, fully decentralized, and parameter-sharing decentralized RL controllers, and compare their capacity regions and ATTs together with a classical baseline MaxPressure controller. Further, we show how the parametersharing controller may be generalised to be deployed on a larger network than it was originally trained on. In this setting, we show some initial findings that suggest that even though the junctions are not formally coordinated, traffic may self organise into `green waves'.

摘要（中文）: 本研究将系统容量区域视角扩展至多节点交通网络，重点研究城市走廊网络这一特殊案例。我们训练并评估了集中式、完全分散式及参数共享分散式强化学习控制器，将它们的容量区域与平均行程时间同经典基准算法MaxPressure控制器进行对比分析。进一步地，我们展示了参数共享控制器如何通过泛化应用于比训练规模更大的实际路网。在此场景下，初步研究结果表明：即使交叉口未进行形式化协调，交通流仍能自发组织形成"绿波带"。

TLDR: The paper trains and evaluates centralized, decentralized, and parameter-sharing reinforcement learning controllers for traffic signal control in urban corridors, comparing their performance against a classical baseline and exploring generalization to larger networks.

简要说明: 该论文训练和评估了用于城市走廊交通信号控制的集中式、分散式和参数共享式强化学习控制器，与经典基线进行比较，并探索其向更大网络的泛化能力。

Authors: Xiaofei Song, Kerstin Eder, Jonathan Lawry, R. Eddie Wilson

APEX: Agent Payment Execution with Policy for Autonomous Agent API Access

Abstract (English): Autonomous agents are moving beyond simple retrieval tasks to become economic actors that invoke APIs, sequence workflows, and make real-time decisions. As this shift accelerates, API providers need request-level monetization with programmatic spend governance. The HTTP 402 protocol addresses this by treating payment as a first-class protocol event, but most implementations rely on cryptocurrency rails. In many deployment contexts, especially countries with strong real-time fiat systems like UPI, this assumption is misaligned with regulatory and infrastructure realities. We present APEX, an implementation-complete research system that adapts HTTP 402-style payment gating to UPI-like fiat workflows while preserving policy-governed spend control, tokenized access verification, and replay resistance. We implement a challenge-settle-consume lifecycle with HMAC-signed short-lived tokens, idempotent settlement handling, and policy-aware payment approval. The system uses FastAPI, SQLite, and Python standard libraries, making it transparent, inspectable, and reproducible. We evaluate APEX across three baselines and six scenarios using sample sizes 2-4x larger than initial experiments (N=20-40 per scenario). Results show that policy enforcement reduces total spending by 27.3% while maintaining 52.8% success rate for legitimate requests. Security mechanisms achieve 100% block rate for both replay attacks and invalid tokens with low latency overhead (19.6ms average). Multiple trial runs show low variance across scenarios, demonstrating high reproducibility with 95% confidence intervals. The primary contribution is a controlled agent-payment infrastructure and reference architecture that demonstrates how agentic access monetization can be adapted to fiat systems without discarding security and policy guarantees.

摘要（中文）: 自主智能体正从简单的检索任务演变为能够调用API、编排工作流并做出实时决策的经济行为体。随着这一转变加速，API提供商需要具备请求级货币化能力与可编程支出管控机制。HTTP 402协议通过将支付作为首要协议事件来应对这一需求，但现有实现大多依赖加密货币通道。在许多部署场景中（尤其像UPI这类拥有强大实时法币系统的国家），这种设定与监管及基础设施现状存在脱节。本文提出APEX——一个完整实现的研究系统，它将HTTP 402式支付网关适配至类UPI法币工作流，同时保留策略管控的支出控制、令牌化访问验证与抗重放攻击能力。我们通过HMAC签名短期令牌、幂等结算处理和策略感知支付审批，实现了挑战-结算-消耗的生命周期。该系统基于FastAPI、SQLite和Python标准库构建，具有透明、可审查和可复现的特性。我们在三种基准场景和六种测试场景中评估APEX，样本量较初始实验扩大2-4倍（每个场景N=20-40）。结果表明：策略执行将总支出降低27.3%，同时保持合法请求52.8%的成功率；安全机制对重放攻击和无效令牌的拦截率达到100%，且延迟开销较低（平均19.6毫秒）；多轮试验显示各场景间方差较小，95%置信区间下的可复现性较高。本研究的主要贡献在于提供了一套可控的智能体支付基础设施与参考架构，论证了如何将智能体访问货币化机制适配至法币系统，同时不牺牲安全性与策略保障。

TLDR: APEX is a research system that implements HTTP 402-style payment gating for autonomous agents, adapted for fiat payment systems like UPI, featuring policy enforcement, security, and controlled spending.

简要说明: APEX是一个研究系统，为自主代理实现HTTP 402风格的支付网关，适配UPI等法定支付系统，具备策略执行、安全性和可控支出功能。

Authors: Mohd Safwan Uddin, Mohammed Mouzam, Mohammed Imran, Syed Badar Uddin Faizan

How and why does deep ensemble coupled with transfer learning increase performance in bipolar disorder and schizophrenia classification?

Abstract (English): Transfer learning (TL) and deep ensemble learning (DE) have recently been shown to outperform simple machine learning in classifying psychiatric disorders. However, there is still a lack of understanding as to why that is. This paper aims to understand how and why DE and TL reduce the variability of single-subject classification models in bipolar disorder (BD) and schizophrenia (SCZ). To this end, we investigated the training stability of TL and DE models. For the two classification tasks under consideration, we compared the results of multiple trainings with the same backbone but with different initializations. In this way, we take into account the epistemic uncertainty associated with the uncertainty in the estimation of the model parameters. It has been shown that the performance of classifiers can be significantly improved by using TL with DE. Based on these results, we investigate i) how many models are needed to benefit from the performance improvement of DE when classifying BD and SCZ from healthy controls, and ii) how TL induces better generalization, with and without DE. In the first case, we show that DE reaches a plateau when 10 models are included in the ensemble. In the second case, we find that using a pre-trained model constrains TL models with the same pre-training to stay in the same basin of the loss function. This is not the case for DL models with randomly initialized weights.

摘要（中文）: 迁移学习（TL）与深度集成学习（DE）在精神病学障碍分类中，已显示出优于简单机器学习方法的效果，但其内在原因仍不明确。本文旨在探讨DE和TL如何以及为何能降低双相情感障碍（BD）与精神分裂症（SCZ）单被试分类模型的变异性。为此，我们研究了TL和DE模型的训练稳定性。针对两项分类任务，我们比较了相同骨干网络在不同初始化条件下多次训练的结果，从而考虑了模型参数估计不确定性带来的认知不确定性。研究表明，结合TL与DE可显著提升分类器性能。基于此结果，我们进一步探究：i）在区分BD、SCZ与健康对照时，需要集成多少模型才能从DE的性能提升中获益；ii）TL如何促进模型泛化能力（无论是否结合DE）。对于问题一，我们发现当集成模型数量达到10个时，DE性能趋于稳定。对于问题二，我们发现使用预训练模型能约束TL模型（基于相同预训练）保持在损失函数的同一优化区域中，而权重随机初始化的深度学习模型则不具备此特性。

TLDR: This paper investigates the mechanisms by which deep ensembles and transfer learning improve classification performance and reduce variability in models for psychiatric disorders (bipolar disorder and schizophrenia), focusing on training stability and model generalization.

简要说明: 本文研究深度集成学习和迁移学习如何提高精神疾病（双相情感障碍和精神分裂症）分类模型的性能并减少其变异性，重点关注训练稳定性和模型泛化能力。

Authors: Sara Petiton, Antoine Grigis, Benoit Dufumier, Edouard Duchesnay

SAFE: Stepwise Atomic Feedback for Error correction in Multi-hop Reasoning

Abstract (English): Multi-hop QA benchmarks frequently reward Large Language Models (LLMs) for spurious correctness, masking ungrounded or flawed reasoning steps. To shift toward rigorous reasoning, we propose SAFE, a dynamic benchmarking framework that replaces the ungrounded Chain-of-Thought (CoT) with a strictly verifiable sequence of grounded entities. Our framework operates across two phases: (1) train-time verification, where we establish an atomic error taxonomy and a Knowledge Graph (KG)-grounded verification pipeline to eliminate noisy supervision in standard benchmarks, identifying up to 14% of instances as unanswerable, and (2) inference-time verification, where a feedback model trained on this verified dataset dynamically detects ungrounded steps in real-time. Experimental results demonstrate that SAFE not only exposes the critical flaws of existing benchmarks at train-time, but also significantly outperforms standard baselines, achieving an average accuracy gain of 8.4 pp while guaranteeing verifiable trajectories at inference-time.

摘要（中文）: 当前多跳问答基准常会错误地奖励大语言模型，使其可能借助不扎实或有缺陷的推理步骤仍取得表面上的正确结果。为推进严谨推理，我们提出SAFE——一种动态基准框架，以严格可验证的实体序列替换不扎实的思维链。该框架包含两个阶段：（1）训练阶段验证，通过建立原子化错误分类体系与知识图谱驱动的验证流程，剔除标准基准中的噪声标注，识别出高达14%不可回答的实例；（2）推理阶段验证，基于此验证数据集训练反馈模型，动态检测实时推理中的不扎实步骤。实验结果表明，SAFE不仅在训练阶段能揭示现有基准的关键缺陷，还在推理阶段显著超越标准基线模型，在保证可验证推理路径的同时，平均准确率提升8.4个百分点。

TLDR: The paper proposes a framework for verifying multi-hop reasoning steps in Large Language Models using a knowledge graph and a feedback model, targeting improved rigor and verifiability in reasoning benchmarks.

简要说明: 本文提出了一个使用知识图谱和反馈模型来验证大型语言模型中多跳推理步骤的框架，旨在提高推理基准的严谨性和可验证性。

Authors: Daeyong Kwon, Soyoung Yoon, Seung-won Hwang

SenseMath: Do LLMs Have Number Sense? Evaluating Shortcut Use, Judgment, and Generation

Abstract (English): Large language models often default to step-by-step computation even when efficient numerical shortcuts are available. This raises a basic question: do they exhibit number sense in a human-like behavioral sense, i.e., the ability to recognize numerical structure, apply shortcuts when appropriate, and avoid them when they are not? We introduce SenseMath, a controlled benchmark for evaluating structure-sensitive numerical reasoning in LLMs. SenseMath contains 4,800 items spanning eight shortcut categories and four digit scales, with matched strong-shortcut, weak-shortcut, and control variants. It supports three evaluation settings of increasing cognitive demand: Shortcut Use (whether models can apply shortcuts on shortcut-amenable problems); Applicability Judgment (whether they can recognize when a shortcut is appropriate or misleading); and Problem Generation (whether they can generate new problem items that correctly admit a given type of shortcut). Our evaluation across five LLMs, ranging from GPT-4o-mini to Llama-3.1-8B, shows a consistent pattern: when explicitly prompted, models readily adopt shortcut strategies and achieve substantial accuracy gains on shortcut-amenable items (up to 15%), yet under standard chain-of-thought prompting they spontaneously employ such strategies in fewer than 40% of cases, even when they demonstrably possess the requisite capability. Moreover, this competence is confined to the Use level; models systematically over-generalise shortcuts to problems where they do not apply, and fail to generate valid shortcut-bearing problems from scratch. Together, these results suggest that current LLMs exhibit procedural shortcut fluency without the structural understanding of when and why shortcuts work that underlies human number sense.

摘要（中文）: 大型语言模型常倾向于逐步计算，即便存在高效数值捷径时亦如此。这引发了一个基本问题：它们是否具备类似人类行为意义上的数感，即识别数值结构、在适当时运用捷径并在不适时规避的能力？我们引入SenseMath——一个用于评估大语言模型结构敏感性数值推理的受控基准。SenseMath包含4,800个条目，涵盖八个捷径类别和四种数字规模，并配有匹配的强捷径、弱捷径及对照变体。该基准支持三种认知需求逐级提升的评估场景：捷径运用（模型能否在适用捷径的问题上使用捷径）、适用性判断（能否识别捷径何时适用或具有误导性）以及问题生成（能否创建符合特定捷径类型的新问题条目）。我们对从GPT-4o-mini到Llama-3.1-8B的五种大语言模型进行评估，结果显示一致性规律：当明确提示时，模型能迅速采用捷径策略并在适用捷径的问题上获得显著准确率提升（最高达15%），但在标准思维链提示下，它们自发运用此类策略的比例不足40%，即使已证明具备相应能力。此外，这种能力仅限于运用层面：模型会系统性将捷径过度泛化至不适用的场景，且无法从头生成有效的捷径承载问题。这些结果表明，当前大语言模型仅表现出程序性捷径流畅度，而缺乏对人类数感基础——即理解捷径何时及为何有效的结构性认知。

TLDR: The paper introduces SenseMath, a benchmark to evaluate if LLMs possess human-like 'number sense' by testing their ability to use, judge, and generate numerical shortcuts, finding they have procedural fluency but lack deeper structural understanding.

简要说明: 该论文提出了SenseMath基准，用于评估LLMs是否具备人类般的'数感'，通过测试其使用、判断和生成数学捷径的能力，发现它们具有程序性流畅度但缺乏深层的结构性理解。

Authors: Haomin Zhuang, Xiangqi Wang, Yili Shen, Ying Cheng, Xiangliang Zhang

Qiana: A First-Order Formalism to Quantify over Contexts and Formulas with Temporality

Abstract (English): We introduce Qiana, a logic framework for reasoning on formulas that are true only in specific contexts. In Qiana, it is possible to quantify over both formulas and contexts to express, e.g., that ``everyone knows everything Alice says''. Qiana also permits paraconsistent logics within contexts, so that contexts can contain contradictions. Furthermore, Qiana is based on first-order logic, and is finitely axiomatizable, so that Qiana theories are compatible with pre-existing first-order logic theorem provers. We show how Qiana can be used to represent temporality, event calculus, and modal logic. We also discuss different design alternatives of Qiana.

摘要（中文）: 我们介绍了Qiana，一种用于推理仅在特定语境下为真的逻辑框架。在Qiana中，可以对公式和语境进行量化，以表达例如“所有人都知道爱丽丝所说的一切”这样的陈述。Qiana还允许在语境中包含次协调逻辑，使得语境能够容纳矛盾。此外，Qiana以一阶逻辑为基础，且具有有限可公理化特性，使得Qiana理论与现有的一阶逻辑定理证明器兼容。我们展示了Qiana如何用于表示时间性、事件演算和模态逻辑，并探讨了Qiana的不同设计选择方案。

TLDR: Introduces Qiana, a first-order logic framework for reasoning about formulas that are true only in specific contexts, supporting quantification over formulas and contexts, paraconsistency, and finite axiomatization.

简要说明: 介绍Qiana，一个用于在特定上下文中推理公式的一阶逻辑框架，支持对公式和上下文进行量化、可容纳矛盾，且具有有限公理化。

Authors: Simon Coumes, Pierre-Henri Paris, François Schwarzentruber, Fabian Suchanek

Probabilistic classification from possibilistic data: computing Kullback-Leibler projection with a possibility distribution

Abstract (English): We consider learning with possibilistic supervision for multi-class classification. For each training instance, the supervision is a normalized possibility distribution that expresses graded plausibility over the classes. From this possibility distribution, we construct a non-empty closed convex set of admissible probability distributions by combining two requirements: probabilistic compatibility with the possibility and necessity measures induced by the possibility distribution, and linear shape constraints that must be satisfied to preserve the qualitative structure of the possibility distribution. Thus, classes with the same possibility degree receive equal probabilities, and if a class has a strictly larger possibility degree than another class, then it receives a strictly larger probability. Given a strictly positive probability vector output by a model for an instance, we compute its Kullback-Leibler projection onto the admissible set. This projection yields the closest admissible probability distribution in Kullback-Leibler sense. We can then train the model by minimizing the divergence between the prediction and its projection, which quantifies the smallest adjustment needed to satisfy the induced dominance and shape constraints. The projection is computed with Dykstra's algorithm using Bregman projections associated with the negative entropy, and we provide explicit formulas for the projections onto each constraint set. Experiments conducted on synthetic data and on a real-world natural language inference task, based on the ChaosNLI dataset, show that the proposed projection algorithm is efficient enough for practical use, and that the resulting projection-based learning objective can improve predictive performance.

摘要（中文）: 我们研究多分类问题中的可能性监督学习。每个训练实例的监督信号是一个归一化的可能性分布，表达了各类别的分级合理性程度。基于该可能性分布，我们通过结合两个要求构建了一个非空闭凸的容许概率分布集合：首先，这些概率分布需与可能性分布导出的可能性测度和必要性测度保持概率相容性；其次，必须满足线性形状约束以保持可能性分布的定性结构。具体而言，具有相同可能性度的类别将获得相等概率，而若某类别的可能性度严格大于另一类别，则其获得概率也严格更大。给定模型为某实例输出的严格正概率向量，我们计算其到容许集合的Kullback-Leibler投影。该投影在Kullback-Leibler意义下产生最接近的容许概率分布。随后，通过最小化预测值与其投影之间的散度来训练模型，该散度量化为满足导出的优势关系和形状约束所需的最小调整量。投影计算采用Dykstra算法结合负熵关联的Bregman投影，并给出了各约束集投影的显式公式。在合成数据及基于ChaosNLI数据集的实际自然语言推理任务上的实验表明，所提出的投影算法具有足够的实用效率，且基于投影的学习目标能够有效提升预测性能。

TLDR: This paper introduces a method for learning probabilistic classifiers from possibilistic data, using Kullback-Leibler projections to enforce constraints derived from possibility distributions.

简要说明: 本文提出了一种从可能性数据中学习概率分类器的方法，利用Kullback-Leibler投影来强制执行由可能性分布导出的约束。

Authors: Ismaïl Baaj, Pierre Marquis

Quantum-Inspired Geometric Classification with Correlation Group Structures and VQC Decision Modeling

Abstract (English): We propose a geometry-driven quantum-inspired classification framework that integrates Correlation Group Structures (CGR), compact SWAP-test-based overlap estimation, and selective variational quantum decision modelling. Rather than directly approximating class posteriors, the method adopts a geometry-first paradigm in which samples are evaluated relative to class medoids using overlap-derived Euclidean-like and angular similarity channels. CGR organizes features into anchor-centered correlation neighbourhoods, generating nonlinear, correlation-weighted representations that enhance robustness in heterogeneous tabular spaces. These geometric signals are fused through a non-probabilistic margin-based fusion score, serving as a lightweight and data-efficient primary classifier for small-to-moderate datasets. On Heart Disease, Breast Cancer, and Wine Quality datasets, the fusion-score classifier achieves 0.8478, 0.8881, and 0.9556 test accuracy respectively, with macro-F1 scores of 0.8463, 0.8703, and 0.9522, demonstrating competitive and stable performance relative to classical baselines. For large-scale and highly imbalanced regimes, we construct compact Delta-distance contrastive features and train a variational quantum classifier (VQC) as a nonlinear refinement layer. On the Credit Card Fraud dataset (0.17% prevalence), the Delta + VQC pipeline achieves approximately 0.85 minority recall at an alert rate of approximately 1.31%, with ROC-AUC 0.9249 and PR-AUC 0.3251 under full-dataset evaluation. These results highlight the importance of operating-point-aware assessment in rare-event detection and demonstrate that the proposed hybrid geometric-variational framework provides interpretable, scalable, and regime-adaptive classification across heterogeneous data settings.

摘要（中文）: 我们提出一种几何驱动的量子启发分类框架，该框架融合了关联群结构（CGR）、基于紧凑SWAP测试的重叠度估计以及选择性变分量子决策模型。该方法不直接近似类后验概率，而是采用“几何优先”范式，通过基于重叠度衍生的类欧几里得相似度通道与角度相似度通道，在类中心样本参照系下评估样本。CGR将特征组织成以锚点为中心的关联邻域，生成非线性且关联加权的表示，从而增强异构表格数据空间中的鲁棒性。这些几何信号通过一种基于边际的非概率融合分数进行融合，作为轻量级且数据高效的主分类器，适用于中小规模数据集。在心脏病、乳腺癌和葡萄酒质量数据集上，融合分数分类器分别达到0.8478、0.8881和0.9556的测试准确率，宏观F1分数分别为0.8463、0.8703和0.9522，相较于经典基线模型展现出具有竞争力且稳定的性能。针对大规模高度不平衡场景，我们构建了紧凑的Delta距离对比特征，并训练变分量子分类器（VQC）作为非线性精炼层。在信用卡欺诈数据集（阳性率0.17%）上，Delta+VQC流程在全数据集评估下达到约85%的少数类召回率，报警率约1.31%，ROC-AUC为0.9249，PR-AUC为0.3251。这些结果凸显了在罕见事件检测中考虑操作点感知评估的重要性，并表明所提出的几何-变分混合框架能够在异构数据场景下提供可解释、可扩展且适应不同数据模式的分类解决方案。

TLDR: The paper proposes a quantum-inspired geometric classification framework for tabular data, combining classical correlation-based features with a variational quantum classifier for improved performance on heterogeneous datasets, focusing on small datasets and imbalanced rare-event detection.

简要说明: 该论文提出了一种面向表格数据的量子启发的几何分类框架，结合了基于相关性的经典特征和变分量子分类器，旨在提升小规模数据集和高度不平衡的稀有事件检测任务上的性能。

Authors: Nishikanta Mohanty, Arya Ansuman Priyadarshi, Bikash K. Behera, Badshah Mukherjee

Woosh: A Sound Effects Foundation Model

Abstract (English): The audio research community depends on open generative models as foundational tools for building novel approaches and establishing baselines. In this report, we present Woosh, Sony AI's publicly released sound effect foundation model, detailing its architecture, training process, and an evaluation against other popular open models. Being optimized for sound effects, we provide (1) a high-quality audio encoder/decoder model and (2) a text-audio alignment model for conditioning, together with (3) text-to-audio and (4) video-to-audio generative models. Distilled text-to-audio and video-to-audio models are also included in the release, allowing for low-resource operation and fast inference. Our evaluation on both public and private data shows competitive or better performance for each module when compared to existing open alternatives like StableAudio-Open and TangoFlux. Inference code and model weights are available at https://github.com/SonyResearch/Woosh. Demo samples can be found at https://sonyresearch.github.io/Woosh/.

摘要（中文）: 音频研究领域依赖于开放生成模型作为构建新方法和建立基准的基础工具。本报告介绍了索尼AI公开发布的音效基础模型Woosh，详细阐述了其架构设计、训练过程，以及与现有主流开放模型的对比评估。该模型针对音效生成进行了优化，包含：（1）高质量音频编码器/解码器模型；（2）用于条件控制的文本-音频对齐模型；（3）文本到音频生成模型；（4）视频到音频生成模型。本次发布还包含蒸馏后的文本到音频和视频到音频模型，支持低资源运行与快速推理。在公开及私有数据集上的评估表明，相较于StableAudio-Open、TangoFlux等现有开放模型，该模型的各个模块均展现出具有竞争力或更优的性能。推理代码与模型权重已发布于https://github.com/SonyResearch/Woosh，演示样本可通过https://sonyresearch.github.io/Woosh/获取。

TLDR: A new open foundation model for generating sound effects from text or video, with a focus on high-quality audio and efficient inference.

简要说明: 一个用于从文本或视频生成音效的新的开源基础模型，专注于高质量音频和高效推理。
