Authors: Gaëtan Hadjeres, Marc Ferras, Khaled Koutini, Benno Weck, Alexandre Bittar, Thomas Hummel, Zineb Lahrici, Hakim Missoum, Joan Serrà, Yuki Mitsufuji

ImplicitBBQ: Benchmarking Implicit Bias in Large Language Models through Characteristic Based Cues

Abstract (English): Large Language Models increasingly suppress biased outputs when demographic identity is stated explicitly, yet may still exhibit implicit biases when identity is conveyed indirectly. Existing benchmarks use name based proxies to detect implicit biases, which carry weak associations with many social demographics and cannot extend to dimensions like age or socioeconomic status. We introduce ImplicitBBQ, a QA benchmark that evaluates implicit bias through characteristic based cues, culturally associated attributes that signal implicitly, across age, gender, region, religion, caste, and socioeconomic status. Evaluating 11 models, we find that implicit bias in ambiguous contexts is over six times higher than explicit bias in open weight models. Safety prompting and chain-of-thought reasoning fail to substantially close this gap; even few-shot prompting, which reduces implicit bias by 84%, leaves caste bias at four times the level of any other dimension. These findings indicate that current alignment and prompting strategies address the surface of bias evaluation while leaving culturally grounded stereotypic associations largely unresolved. We publicly release our code and dataset for model providers and researchers to benchmark potential mitigation techniques.

摘要（中文）: 大型语言模型在明确提及人口统计身份时越来越多地抑制带有偏见的输出，但在身份信息被间接传达时仍可能表现出隐性偏见。现有基准测试使用基于姓名的代理指标来检测隐性偏见，但这些指标与许多社会人口统计特征的关联较弱，且无法扩展至年龄或社会经济地位等维度。我们提出ImplicitBBQ——一个通过特征性线索（即能够隐含传递身份信息的文化关联属性）来评估隐性偏见的问答基准，涵盖年龄、性别、地域、宗教、种姓和社会经济地位六大维度。通过对11个模型的评估，我们发现开放式权重模型在模糊语境中的隐性偏见水平是显性偏见的六倍以上。安全提示和思维链推理方法均未能显著缩小这一差距；即使采用少样本提示法（虽能将隐性偏见降低84%），种姓偏见的残留水平仍达到其他维度的四倍。这些发现表明，当前的对齐策略和提示技术仅触及偏见评估的表层，而植根于文化的刻板关联在很大程度上仍未得到解决。我们公开代码和数据集，供模型开发者和研究者用于评估潜在缓解技术的效果。

TLDR: This paper introduces a new benchmark (ImplicitBBQ) for evaluating implicit bias in Large Language Models using culturally associated attributes beyond names. It finds implicit bias remains high even after standard mitigation techniques, highlighting a gap in current alignment methods.

简要说明: 本文提出了ImplicitBBQ，一个通过文化关联属性来评估大语言模型隐性偏见的新基准，发现即使在标准缓解技术后隐性偏见仍很高，突显了当前对齐方法的不足。

Authors: Bhaskara Hanuma Vedula, Darshan Anghan, Ishita Goyal, Ponnurangam Kumaraguru, Abhijnan Chakraborty

Bayesian Elicitation with LLMs: Model Size Helps, Extra "Reasoning" Doesn't Always

Abstract (English): Large language models (LLMs) have been proposed as alternatives to human experts for estimating unknown quantities with associated uncertainty, a process known as Bayesian elicitation. We test this by asking eleven LLMs to estimate population statistics, such as health prevalence rates, personality trait distributions, and labor market figures, and to express their uncertainty as 95\% credible intervals. We vary each model's reasoning effort (low, medium, high) to test whether more "thinking" improves results. Our findings reveal three key results. First, larger, more capable models produce more accurate estimates, but increasing reasoning effort provides no consistent benefit. Second, all models are severely overconfident: their 95\% intervals contain the true value only 9--44\% of the time, far below the expected 95\%. Third, a statistical recalibration technique called conformal prediction can correct this overconfidence, expanding the intervals to achieve the intended coverage. In a preliminary experiment, giving models web search access degraded predictions for already-accurate models, while modestly improving predictions for weaker ones. Models performed well on commonly discussed topics but struggled with specialized health data. These results indicate that LLM uncertainty estimates require statistical correction before they can be used in decision-making.

摘要（中文）: 大型语言模型（LLM）已被提议作为人类专家的替代者，用于估计未知量及其相关不确定性，这一过程被称为贝叶斯启发。我们通过要求十一个LLM模型估计人口统计数据（如健康患病率、人格特质分布和劳动力市场数据），并以95%可信区间表达其不确定性来进行测试。我们改变每个模型的推理努力程度（低、中、高），以检验更多“思考”是否能改善结果。研究揭示了三个关键发现：首先，规模更大、能力更强的模型能产生更准确的估计，但增加推理努力并未带来一致的改善；其次，所有模型都存在严重过度自信问题——其95%区间包含真实值的概率仅为9%-44%，远低于预期的95%；第三，一种称为共形预测的统计重新校准技术可修正这种过度自信，通过扩大区间实现目标覆盖率。在初步实验中，为模型提供网络搜索功能会降低原本准确模型的预测质量，而对较弱模型仅有适度改善。模型在常见话题上表现良好，但在专业健康数据上表现不佳。这些结果表明，LLM的不确定性估计需经过统计校正后方能用于决策过程。

TLDR: The paper investigates using LLMs for Bayesian elicitation of population statistics, finding that model size improves accuracy but extra reasoning does not, all models are overconfident, and statistical calibration can correct the intervals.

简要说明: 该论文研究了使用LLM进行人口统计数据的贝叶斯启发，发现模型规模可提高准确性但额外推理无益，所有模型均过度自信，且统计校准可修正其置信区间。

Authors: Luka Hobor, Mario Brcic, Mihael Kovac, Kristijan Poje

Robust Graph Representation Learning via Adaptive Spectral Contrast

Abstract (English): Spectral graph contrastive learning has emerged as a unified paradigm for handling both homophilic and heterophilic graphs by leveraging high-frequency components. However, we identify a fundamental spectral dilemma: while high-frequency signals are indispensable for encoding heterophily, our theoretical analysis proves they exhibit significantly higher variance under spectrally concentrated perturbations. We derive a regret lower bound showing that existing global (node-agnostic) spectral fusion is provably sub-optimal: on mixed graphs with separated node-wise frequency preferences, any global fusion strategy incurs non-vanishing regret relative to a node-wise oracle. To escape this bound, we propose ASPECT, a framework that resolves this dilemma through a reliability-aware spectral gating mechanism. Formulated as a minimax game, ASPECT employs a node-wise gate that dynamically re-weights frequency channels based on their stability against a purpose-built adversary, which explicitly targets spectral energy distributions via a Rayleigh quotient penalty. This design forces the encoder to learn representations that are both structurally discriminative and spectrally robust. Empirical results show that ASPECT achieves new state-of-the-art performance on 8 out of 9 benchmarks, effectively decoupling meaningful structural heterophily from incidental noise.

摘要（中文）: 谱图对比学习已成为通过利用高频成分处理同质性和异质性图的统一范式。然而，我们发现了基础的谱困境：尽管高频信号对编码异质性不可或缺，但理论分析证明其在谱集中扰动下表现出显著更高的方差。我们推导出遗憾下界，表明现有全局（节点无关）谱融合策略在理论上存在次优性：在节点频率偏好分离的混合图上，任何全局融合策略相较于节点级最优策略都会产生不可消除的遗憾。为突破此界限，我们提出ASPECT框架，通过可靠性感知的谱门控机制解决此困境。该框架以极小极大博弈形式构建，采用节点级门控机制，基于谱通道针对专门构建的对抗器（通过瑞利商罚项显式攻击谱能量分布）的稳定性进行动态重加权。该设计迫使编码器学习兼具结构判别性与谱鲁棒性的表征。实证结果表明，ASPECT在9个基准测试中的8个上实现了新的最优性能，有效解耦了有意义的结构异质性与偶然噪声。

TLDR: Proposes a robust graph representation learning method (ASPECT) using a node-wise adaptive spectral gating mechanism to address the variance-stability trade-off in high-frequency signals for handling heterophilic and homophilic graphs, achieving state-of-the-art results on benchmarks.

简要说明: 提出一种鲁棒的图表示学习方法（ASPECT），通过节点自适应的频谱门控机制处理高频率信号在异质性和同质性图中的方差与稳定性权衡问题，在多个基准测试中达到最优性能。

Authors: Zhuolong Li, Boxue Yang, Haopeng Chen

Beyond Detection: Ethical Foundations for Automated Dyslexic Error Attribution

Abstract (English): Dyslexic spelling errors exhibit systematic phonological and orthographic patterns that distinguish them from the errors produced by typically developing writers. While this observation has motivated dyslexic-specific spell-checking and assistive writing tools, prior work has focused predominantly on error correction rather than attribution, and has largely neglected the ethical risks. The risk of harmful labelling, covert screening, algorithmic bias, and institutional misuse that automated classification of learners entails requires the development of robust ethical and legal frameworks for research in this area. This paper addresses both gaps. We formulate dyslexic error attribution as a binary classification task. Given a misspelt word and its correct target form, determine whether the error pattern is characteristic of a dyslexic or non-dyslexic writer. We develop a comprehensive feature set capturing orthographic, phonological, and morphological properties of each error, and propose a twin-input neural model evaluated against traditional machine learning baselines under writer-independent conditions. The neural model achieves 93.01% accuracy and an F1-score of 94.01%, with phonetically plausible errors and vowel confusions emerging as the strongest attribution signals. We situate these technical results within an explicit ethics-first framework, analysing fairness across subgroups, the interpretability requirements of educational deployment, and the conditions, consent, transparency, human oversight, and recourse, under which a system could be responsibly used. We provide concrete guidelines for ethical deployment and an open discussion of the systems limitations and misuse potential. Our results demonstrate that dyslexic error attribution is feasible at high accuracy while underscoring that feasibility alone is insufficient for deployment in high-stakes educational contexts.

摘要（中文）: 诵读困难者的拼写错误呈现出系统性的语音与拼写规律，这些特征使其有别于正常发展写作者的错误。尽管这一发现已催生出针对诵读困难群体的专用拼写检查与辅助写作工具，但现有研究主要集中于错误纠正而非错误归因，且普遍忽视了其中涉及的伦理风险。对学习者进行自动化分类所可能引发的有害标签化、隐性筛查、算法偏见及机构滥用等风险，要求我们必须建立坚实的伦理与法律框架来规范该领域的研究。本文旨在填补这两方面的研究空白。我们将诵读困难错误归因构建为二元分类任务：给定一个拼写错误的单词及其正确目标形式，判断该错误模式是否具有诵读困难者或非诵读困难者的典型特征。我们构建了一套涵盖拼写、语音和形态学特征的综合特征集，并提出了双输入神经网络模型，在写作者独立条件下与传统机器学习基线模型进行对比评估。该神经网络模型准确率达到93.01%，F1分数为94.01%，其中语音合理性错误和元音混淆被证明是最具鉴别力的归因信号。我们将这些技术成果置于明确的伦理优先框架中，分析了不同亚群体的公平性、教育应用场景中的可解释性要求，以及系统在何种条件下（包括知情同意、透明度、人工监督与追责机制）才能被负责任地使用。我们提出了具体的伦理部署准则，并公开探讨了系统的局限性及潜在滥用风险。研究结果表明，诵读困难错误归因能够实现高精度识别，但同时强调仅凭技术可行性并不足以支持其在高风险教育场景中的部署应用。

TLDR: This paper proposes a neural model for classifying spelling errors as dyslexic or non-dyslexic, achieving high accuracy, and emphasizes the need for ethical frameworks for deployment in educational contexts.

简要说明: 本文提出了一种神经网络模型，用于将拼写错误分类为阅读障碍性或非阅读障碍性错误，并达到高精度，同时强调了在教育环境中部署该模型需要伦理框架。

Authors: Samuel Rose, Debarati Chakraborty

CANDI: Curated Test-Time Adaptation for Multivariate Time-Series Anomaly Detection Under Distribution Shift

Abstract (English): Multivariate time-series anomaly detection (MTSAD) aims to identify deviations from normality in multivariate time-series and is critical in real-world applications. However, in real-world deployments, distribution shifts are ubiquitous and cause severe performance degradation in pre-trained anomaly detector. Test-time adaptation (TTA) updates a pre-trained model on-the-fly using only unlabeled test data, making it promising for addressing this challenge. In this study, we propose CANDI (Curated test-time adaptation for multivariate time-series ANomaly detection under DIstribution shift), a novel TTA framework that selectively identifies and adapts to potential false positives while preserving pre-trained knowledge. CANDI introduces a False Positive Mining (FPM) strategy to curate adaptation samples based on anomaly scores and latent similarity, and incorporates a plug-and-play Spatiotemporally-Aware Normality Adaptation (SANA) module for structurally informed model updates. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CANDI significantly improves the performance of MTSAD under distribution shift, improving AUROC up to 14% while using fewer adaptation samples.

摘要（中文）: 多元时间序列异常检测旨在识别多元时间序列中偏离正常模式的现象，在实际应用中具有关键意义。然而，在实际部署中，分布偏移问题普遍存在，常导致预训练异常检测模型性能严重下降。测试时适应技术仅利用未标注的测试数据对预训练模型进行实时更新，为应对这一挑战提供了有效途径。本研究提出CANDI框架——一种面向分布偏移下多元时间序列异常检测的精选测试时适应方法，该框架通过选择性识别并适应潜在误报样本，同时保留预训练知识。CANDI引入误报挖掘策略，基于异常分数与潜在相似性筛选适应样本，并集成即插即用的时空感知常态适应模块，实现结构化信息驱动的模型更新。大量实验表明，CANDI能显著提升分布偏移下多元时间序列异常检测的性能，在减少适应样本用量的同时，将AUROC指标提升最高达14%。

TLDR: This paper proposes a test-time adaptation framework called CANDI to improve the performance of multivariate time-series anomaly detection models when they encounter distribution shifts in real-world deployment.

简要说明: 本文提出了一种名为CANDI的测试时适应框架，用于提升多元时间序列异常检测模型在真实世界部署中遇到分布偏移时的性能。

Authors: HyunGi Kim, Jisoo Mok, Hyungyu Lee, Juhyeon Shin, Sungroh Yoon

Retrieval-aligned Tabular Foundation Models Enable Robust Clinical Risk Prediction in Electronic Health Records Under Real-world Constraints

Abstract (English): Clinical prediction from structured electronic health records (EHRs) is challenging due to high dimensionality, heterogeneity, class imbalance, and distribution shift. While tabular in-context learning (TICL) and retrieval-augmented methods perform well on generic benchmarks, their behavior in clinical settings remains unclear. We present a multi-cohort EHR benchmark comparing classical, deep tabular, and TICL models across varying data scale, feature dimensionality, outcome rarity, and cross-cohort generalization. PFN-based TICL models are sample-efficient in low-data regimes but degrade under naive distance-based retrieval as heterogeneity and imbalance increase. We propose AWARE, a task-aligned retrieval framework using supervised embedding learning and lightweight adapters. AWARE improves AUPRC by up to 12.2% under extreme imbalance, with gains increasing with data complexity. Our results identify retrieval quality and retrieval-inference alignment as key bottlenecks for deploying tabular in-context learning in clinical prediction.

摘要（中文）: 摘要：基于结构化电子健康记录（EHR）的临床预测面临高维度、异质性、类别不平衡和分布偏移等挑战。尽管表格上下文学习（TICL）和检索增强方法在通用基准测试中表现良好，但它们在临床环境中的行为仍不明确。我们提出了一个多队列EHR基准测试，比较了经典模型、深度表格模型和TICL模型在不同数据规模、特征维度、结果稀有性及跨队列泛化能力上的表现。基于PFN的TICL模型在低数据条件下样本效率高，但随着异质性和不平衡性的增加，其性能在基于简单距离的检索方法下会下降。我们提出AWARE框架，该框架采用监督嵌入学习和轻量级适配器实现任务对齐检索。在极端不平衡情况下，AWARE可将AUPRC提升高达12.2%，且数据复杂度越高提升越显著。研究结果表明，检索质量与检索-推断对齐是表格上下文学习在临床预测中部署的关键瓶颈。

TLDR: The paper proposes a task-aligned retrieval framework for tabular in-context learning to improve clinical risk prediction from EHR data, particularly under class imbalance and distribution shift.

简要说明: 该论文提出一种任务对齐的检索框架，用于表格数据的上下文学习，旨在改善电子健康记录（EHR）中的临床风险预测，特别是在类别不平衡和分布偏移的情况下。

Authors: Minh-Khoi Pham, Thang-Long Nguyen Ho, Thao Thi Phuong Dao, Tai Tan Mai, Minh-Triet Tran, Marie E. Ward, Una Geary, Rob Brennan, Nick McDonald, Martin Crane, Marija Bezbradica

Neural Network-Assisted Model Predictive Control for Implicit Balancing

Abstract (English): In Europe, balance responsible parties can deliberately take out-of-balance positions to support transmission system operators (TSOs) in maintaining grid stability and earn profit, a practice called implicit balancing. Model predictive control (MPC) is widely adopted as an effective approach for implicit balancing. The balancing market model accuracy in MPC is critical to decision quality. Previous studies modeled this market using either (i) a convex market clearing approximation, ignoring proactive manual actions by TSOs and the market sub-quarter-hour dynamics, or (ii) machine learning methods, which cannot be directly integrated into MPC. To address these shortcomings, we propose a data-driven balancing market model integrated into MPC using an input convex neural network to ensure convexity while capturing uncertainties. To keep the core network computationally efficient, we incorporate attention-based input gating mechanisms to remove irrelevant data. Evaluating on Belgian data shows that the proposed model both improves MPC decisions and reduces computational time.

摘要（中文）: 在欧洲，平衡责任方可以有意识地采取不平衡仓位来协助输电系统运营商维持电网稳定并获取利润，这一做法被称为隐性平衡。模型预测控制被广泛采用为实施隐性平衡的有效方法，其中平衡市场模型的准确性对决策质量至关重要。现有研究对该市场的建模存在两种局限：一是采用凸市场出清近似方法，忽略了输电系统运营商的主动人工干预及市场内部15分钟以下的动态变化；二是使用机器学习方法，但难以直接融入模型预测控制框架。为解决这些不足，本研究提出一种基于数据驱动的平衡市场模型，通过输入凸神经网络将其集成至模型预测控制中，在保证模型凸性的同时有效捕捉市场不确定性。为提升核心网络计算效率，引入基于注意力的输入门控机制以过滤无关数据。对比利时实际数据的评估表明，该模型在提升模型预测控制决策质量的同时显著降低了计算时间。

TLDR: The paper proposes a data-driven model predictive control (MPC) method using an input convex neural network to improve decision-making and computational efficiency for implicit balancing in electricity markets.

简要说明: 本文提出了一种使用输入凸神经网络的模型预测控制方法，用于提升电力市场隐性平衡的决策质量和计算效率。

Authors: Seyed Soroush Karimi Madahi, Kenneth Bruninx, Bert Claessens, Chris Develder

Domain-constrained knowledge representation: A modal framework

Abstract (English): Knowledge graphs store large numbers of relations efficiently, but they remain weak at representing a quieter difficulty: the meaning of a concept often shifts with the domain in which it is used. A triple such as Apple, instance-of, Company may be acceptable in one setting while being misleading or unusable in another. In most current systems, domain information is attached as metadata, qualifiers, or graph-level organization. These mechanisms help with filtering and provenance, but they usually do not alter the formal status of the assertion itself. This paper argues that domain should be treated as part of knowledge representation rather than as supplementary annotation. It introduces the Domain-Contextualized Concept Graph (DCG), a framework in which domain is written into the relation and interpreted as a modal world constraint. In the DCG form (C, R at D, C'), the marker at D identifies the world in which the relation holds. Formally, the relation is interpreted through a domain-indexed necessity operator, so that truth, inference, and conflict checking are all scoped to the relevant world. This move has three consequences: ambiguous concepts can be disambiguated at the point of representation; invalid assertions can be challenged against their domain; cross-domain relations can be connected through explicit predicates. The paper develops this claim through a Kripke-style semantics, a compact predicate system, a Prolog implementation, and mappings to RDF, OWL, and relational databases. The contribution is a representational reinterpretation of domain itself. The central claim is that many practical failures in knowledge systems begin when domain is treated as external to the assertion. DCG addresses that by giving domain a structural and computable role inside the representation.

摘要（中文）: 摘要：知识图谱能够高效存储大量关系，但其在应对一个更隐蔽的难题时仍显不足：概念的含义常随使用领域的变化而改变。例如，“苹果、实例-属于、公司”这样的三元组在特定情境下可被接受，而在其他场景中可能具有误导性或无法使用。当前大多数系统中，领域信息仅作为元数据、限定词或图谱层面的组织手段存在。这些机制有助于过滤和溯源，但通常不会改变断言本身的形式化状态。本文主张领域应被视为知识表示的一部分，而非补充性标注。研究提出了领域情境化概念图框架，该框架将领域写入关系内部，并将其解释为模态世界约束。在DCG形式(C, R at D, C')中，标记at D标识了关系成立的世界。形式上，该关系通过领域索引的必然性算子进行解释，使得真值判断、推理和冲突检测皆限定于相关世界范围内。这一举措产生三方面影响：模糊概念可在表示层面得到消歧；无效断言可根据其领域进行质疑；跨领域关系可通过显式谓词建立连接。本文通过克里普克式语义、紧凑谓词系统、Prolog实现方案，以及与RDF、OWL和关系数据库的映射关系来论证这一主张。其核心贡献在于对领域本身进行了表征层面的重释，主要观点是：当领域被视为断言的外部因素时，知识系统的诸多实践问题便由此产生。DCG通过赋予领域在表示结构中的可计算角色，有效应对了这一根本问题。

TLDR: This paper proposes a new knowledge representation framework (Domain-Contextualized Concept Graph) that treats domain information as a modal constraint within the relation itself, aiming to disambiguate concepts and improve reasoning across different contexts.

简要说明: 本文提出了一种新的知识表示框架（领域情境化概念图），将领域信息视为关系内部的模态约束，旨在消除概念歧义并改进跨不同领域的推理。

Authors: Chao Li, Yuru Wang, Chunyi Zhao

LiveMathematicianBench: A Live Benchmark for Mathematician-Level Reasoning with Proof Sketches

Abstract (English): Mathematical reasoning is a hallmark of human intelligence, and whether large language models (LLMs) can meaningfully perform it remains a central question in artificial intelligence and cognitive science. As LLMs are increasingly integrated into scientific workflows, rigorous evaluation of their mathematical capabilities becomes a practical necessity. Existing benchmarks are limited by synthetic settings and data contamination. We present LiveMathematicianBench, a dynamic multiple-choice benchmark for research-level mathematical reasoning built from recent arXiv papers published after model training cutoffs. By grounding evaluation in newly published theorems, it provides a realistic testbed beyond memorized patterns. The benchmark introduces a thirteen-category logical taxonomy of theorem types (e.g., implication, equivalence, existence, uniqueness), enabling fine-grained evaluation across reasoning forms. It employs a proof-sketch-guided distractor pipeline that uses high-level proof strategies to construct plausible but invalid answer choices reflecting misleading proof directions, increasing sensitivity to genuine understanding over surface-level matching. We also introduce a substitution-resistant mechanism to distinguish answer recognition from substantive reasoning. Evaluation shows the benchmark is far from saturated: Gemini-3.1-pro-preview, the best model, achieves only 43.5%. Under substitution-resistant evaluation, accuracy drops sharply: GPT-5.4 scores highest at 30.6%, while Gemini-3.1-pro-preview falls to 17.6%, below the 20% random baseline. A dual-mode protocol reveals that proof-sketch access yields consistent accuracy gains, suggesting models can leverage high-level proof strategies for reasoning. Overall, LiveMathematicianBench offers a scalable, contamination-resistant testbed for studying research-level mathematical reasoning in LLMs.

摘要（中文）: 数学推理是人类智能的标志性能力，而大语言模型能否真正具备这一能力，始终是人工智能与认知科学领域的核心议题。随着大语言模型日益融入科学工作流程，对其数学能力进行严格评估已成为现实需求。现有基准测试受限于合成场景和数据污染问题。我们提出LiveMathematicianBench——一个基于模型训练截止日期后新发表arXiv论文构建的动态多选题基准测试平台，用于评估研究级数学推理能力。该基准通过将评估锚定于最新发表的定理，构建了超越记忆模式的现实测试环境。平台依据十三类逻辑分类体系（如蕴含、等价、存在性、唯一性）对定理类型进行划分，支持跨推理形式的细粒度评估。我们采用证明纲要引导的干扰项生成流程，利用高层证明策略构建看似合理实则无效的答案选项，这些选项反映了误导性证明方向，从而增强对深层理解而非表面匹配的检测灵敏度。同时引入抗替换机制以区分答案识别与实质推理能力。评估表明该基准远未达到性能饱和：表现最佳的Gemini-3.1-pro-preview模型准确率仅达43.5%。在抗替换评估模式下，准确率急剧下降：GPT-5.4以30.6%位列第一，而Gemini-3.1-pro-preview骤降至17.6%，低于20%的随机基线水平。双模式协议显示，获取证明纲要能持续提升模型准确率，表明模型可利用高层证明策略进行推理。总体而言，LiveMathematicianBench为研究大语言模型的研究级数学推理能力提供了可扩展、抗污染的科学测试平台。

TLDR: Presents LiveMathematicianBench, a dynamic, contamination-resistant benchmark built from recent arXiv papers to evaluate LLMs' research-level mathematical reasoning, using a proof-sketch-guided distractor pipeline and a logical taxonomy of theorem types.

简要说明: 提出LiveMathematicianBench，这是一个基于最新arXiv论文构建的动态、抗污染基准，用于评估LLMs的研究级数学推理能力，采用了证明草图引导的干扰项生成流程和定理类型的逻辑分类法。

Authors: Linyang He, Qiyao Yu, Hanze Dong, Baohao Liao, Xinxing Xu, Micah Goldblum, Jiang Bian, Nima Mesgarani

AeroTherm-GPT: A Verification-Centered LLM Framework for Thermal Protection System Engineering Workflows

Abstract (English): Integrating Large Language Models (LLMs) into hypersonic thermal protection system (TPS) design is bottlenecked by cascading constraint violations when generating executable simulation artifacts. General-purpose LLMs, treating generation as single-pass text completion, fail to satisfy the sequential, multi-gate constraints inherent in safety-critical engineering workflows. To address this, we propose AeroTherm-GPT, the first TPS-specialized LLM Agent, instantiated through a Constraint-Closed-Loop Generation (CCLG) framework. CCLG organizes TPS artifact generation as an iterative workflow comprising generation, validation, CDG-guided repair, execution, and audit. The Constraint Dependency Graph (CDG) encodes empirical co-resolution structure among constraint categories, directing repair toward upstream fault candidates based on lifecycle ordering priors and empirical co-resolution probabilities. This upstream-priority mechanism resolves multiple downstream violations per action, achieving a Root-Cause Fix Efficiency of 4.16 versus 1.76 for flat-checklist repair. Evaluated on HyTPS-Bench and validated against external benchmarks, AeroTherm-GPT achieves 88.7% End-to-End Success Rate (95% CI: 87.5-89.9), a gain of +12.5 pp over the matched non-CDG ablation baseline, without catastrophic forgetting on scientific reasoning and code generation tasks.

摘要（中文）: 将大语言模型（LLM）集成至高超声速热防护系统（TPS）设计时，因生成可执行仿真产物过程中出现级联约束违规而形成瓶颈。通用大语言模型将生成过程视为单次文本完成，无法满足安全关键工程工作流中固有的顺序、多关卡约束。为此，我们提出AeroTherm-GPT——首个通过约束闭环生成（CCLG）框架实例化的TPS专用大语言模型智能体。CCLG将TPS产物生成组织为迭代工作流，包含生成、验证、CDG引导修复、执行与审计环节。约束依赖图（CDG）编码了约束类别间的经验协同解析结构，基于生命周期排序先验和协同解析概率，将修复导向至上游故障候选点。这种上游优先机制每次动作可解决多个下游违规问题，其根因修复效率达到4.16，而平面清单修复方式仅为1.76。在HyTPS-Bench上的评估及外部基准验证表明，AeroTherm-GPT实现了88.7%的端到端成功率（95%置信区间：87.5-89.9），较匹配的非CDG消融基线提升12.5个百分点，且在科学推理与代码生成任务上未出现灾难性遗忘。

TLDR: This paper introduces AeroTherm-GPT, a specialized LLM agent framework using a Constraint-Closed-Loop Generation (CCLG) mechanism to improve the generation of executable simulation artifacts for thermal protection system engineering, significantly reducing constraint violations.

简要说明: 本文提出AeroTherm-GPT，一个专门用于热防护系统工程的大语言模型代理框架，通过约束闭环生成机制提高可执行仿真工件的生成质量，显著减少约束违反。

Authors: Chuhan Qiao, Jinglai Zheng, Jie Huang, Buyue Zhao, Fan Li, Haiming Huang

LiteInception: A Lightweight and Interpretable Deep Learning Framework for General Aviation Fault Diagnosis

Abstract (English): General aviation fault diagnosis and efficient maintenance are critical to flight safety; however, deploying deep learning models on resource-constrained edge devices poses dual challenges in computational capacity and interpretability. This paper proposes LiteInception--a lightweight interpretable fault diagnosis framework designed for edge deployment. The framework adopts a two-stage cascaded architecture aligned with standard maintenance workflows: Stage 1 performs high-recall fault detection, and Stage 2 conducts fine-grained fault classification on anomalous samples, thereby decoupling optimization objectives and enabling on-demand allocation of computational resources. For model compression, a multi-method fusion strategy based on mutual information, gradient analysis, and SE attention weights is proposed to reduce the input sensor channels from 23 to 15, and a 1+1 branch LiteInception architecture is introduced that compresses InceptionTime parameters by 70%, accelerates CPU inference by over 8x, with less than 3% F1 loss. Furthermore, knowledge distillation is introduced as a precision-recall regulation mechanism, enabling the same lightweight model to adapt to different scenarios--such as safety-critical and auxiliary diagnosis--by switching training strategies. Finally, a dual-layer interpretability framework integrating four attribution methods is constructed, providing traceable evidence chains of "which sensor x which time period." Experiments on the NGAFID dataset demonstrate a fault detection accuracy of 81.92% with 83.24% recall, and a fault identification accuracy of 77.00%, validating the framework's favorable balance among efficiency, accuracy, and interpretability.

摘要（中文）: 通用航空故障诊断与高效维护对飞行安全至关重要；然而，在资源受限的边缘设备上部署深度学习模型面临计算能力与可解释性的双重挑战。本文提出LiteInception——一个专为边缘部署设计的轻量级可解释故障诊断框架。该框架采用与标准维护流程对齐的两级级联架构：第一阶段执行高召回率故障检测，第二阶段对异常样本进行细粒度故障分类，从而解耦优化目标并实现按需分配计算资源。在模型压缩方面，提出了基于互信息、梯度分析和SE注意力权重的多方法融合策略，将输入传感器通道从23个缩减至15个，并设计了一种1+1分支LiteInception架构，使InceptionTime参数量压缩70%，CPU推理速度提升8倍以上，F1损失低于3%。此外，引入知识蒸馏作为精确率-召回率调控机制，使同一轻量模型能通过切换训练策略适应不同场景（如安全关键型与辅助诊断型）。最后，构建了融合四种归因方法的双层可解释性框架，提供“哪个传感器×哪个时间段”的可追溯证据链。在NGAFID数据集上的实验表明，故障检测准确率达81.92%，召回率为83.24%，故障识别准确率达77.00%，验证了该框架在效率、准确性与可解释性间的良好平衡。

TLDR: The paper proposes a lightweight, interpretable deep learning framework for aviation fault diagnosis, focusing on model compression and efficient deployment on edge devices.

简要说明: 本文提出了一种用于航空故障诊断的轻量级、可解释深度学习框架，专注于模型压缩和边缘设备上的高效部署。

Authors: Zhihuan Wei, Xinhang Chen, Danyang Han, Yang Hu, Jie Liu, Xuewen Miao, Guijiang Li

Transformer self-attention encoder-decoder with multimodal deep learning for response time series forecasting and digital twin support in wind structural health monitoring

Abstract (English): The wind-induced structural response forecasting capabilities of a novel transformer methodology are examined here. The model also provides a digital twin component for bridge structural health monitoring. Firstly, the approach uses the temporal characteristics of the system to train a forecasting model. Secondly, the vibration predictions are compared to the measured ones to detect large deviations. Finally, the identified cases are used as an early-warning indicator of structural change. The artificial intelligence-based model outperforms approaches for response forecasting as no assumption on wind stationarity or on structural normal vibration behavior is needed. Specifically, wind-excited dynamic behavior suffers from uncertainty related to obtaining poor predictions when the environmental or traffic conditions change. This results in a hard distinction of what constitutes normal vibration behavior. To this end, a framework is rigorously examined on real-world measurements from the Hardanger Bridge monitored by the Norwegian University of Science and Technology. The approach captures accurate structural behavior in realistic conditions, and with respect to the changes in the system excitation. The results, importantly, highlight the potential of transformer-based digital twin components to serve as next-generation tools for resilient infrastructure management, continuous learning, and adaptive monitoring over the system's lifecycle with respect to temporal characteristics.

摘要（中文）: 本文研究了一种新型Transformer方法在风致结构响应预测方面的能力。该模型还为桥梁结构健康监测提供了数字孪生组件。首先，该方法利用系统的时间特性训练预测模型；其次，将振动预测值与实测值进行对比以检测显著偏差；最后，将识别出的异常情况作为结构变化的早期预警指标。这种基于人工智能的模型在响应预测方面优于传统方法，因为它无需对风的平稳性或结构正常振动行为作出假设。具体而言，风激励动力行为存在不确定性：当环境或交通条件发生变化时，预测结果往往较差，这导致难以清晰界定正常振动行为的范畴。为此，我们基于挪威科技大学监测的哈当厄大桥实测数据对该框架进行了严格验证。该方法能够在真实条件下准确捕捉结构行为，并有效反映系统激励的变化。重要的是，研究结果凸显了基于Transformer的数字孪生组件作为新一代工具的潜力：它能依托时间特性，在系统全生命周期内实现韧性基础设施管理、持续学习和自适应监测。

TLDR: This paper proposes a transformer-based deep learning model for forecasting structural vibration responses in wind-excited bridges and uses it as a digital twin component for early-warning structural health monitoring, validated on real-world bridge data.

简要说明: 本文提出了一种基于Transformer的深度学习模型，用于预测风荷载下桥梁的结构振动响应，并将其作为数字孪生组件用于早期预警结构健康监测，并在真实桥梁数据上进行了验证。

Authors: Feiyu Zhou, Marios Impraimakis

Scale over Preference: The Impact of AI-Generated Content on Online Content Ecology

Abstract (English): The rapid proliferation of Artificial Intelligence-Generated Content (AIGC) is fundamentally restructuring online content ecologies, necessitating a rigorous examination of its behavioral and distributional implications. Leveraging a comprehensive longitudinal dataset comprising tens of millions of users from a leading Chinese video-sharing platform, this study elucidated the distinct creation and consumption behaviors characterizing AIGC versus Human-Generated Content (HGC). We identified a prevalent scale-over-preference dynamic, wherein AIGC creators achieve aggregate engagement comparable to HGC creators through high-volume production, despite a marked consumer preference for HGC. Deeper analysis uncovered the ability of the algorithmic content distribution mechanism in moderating these competing interests regarding AIGC. These findings advocated for the implementation of AIGC-sensitive distribution algorithms and precise governance frameworks to ensure the long-term health of the online content platforms.

摘要（中文）: 人工智能生成内容（AIGC）的快速兴起正在从根本上重构在线内容生态，对其行为与分布效应进行严格审视已刻不容缓。本研究基于中国某领先视频分享平台涵盖数千万用户的纵向数据，系统阐明了AIGC相较于人类生成内容（HGC）在创作与消费行为上的本质差异。研究发现存在明显的“规模超越偏好”现象：尽管消费者明显更偏好HGC，但AIGC创作者通过海量内容生产，仍能获得与HGC创作者相当的总体参与度。深入分析揭示了算法内容分发机制在调节AIGC相关竞争关系方面的关键作用。这些发现为实施具有AIGC敏感度的分发算法与精准治理框架提供了理论依据，以保障在线内容平台的长期健康发展。

TLDR: A study of AI-generated vs. human-generated content on a video platform finds that AIGC achieves comparable engagement through high-volume production despite consumer preference for HGC, highlighting the role of algorithmic distribution.

简要说明: 一项针对视频平台的研究发现，AI生成内容（AIGC）通过高产实现与人类生成内容（HGC）相当的参与度，尽管消费者更偏好HGC，这突显了算法分发机制的作用。

Authors: Tianhao Shi, Yang Zhang, Xiaoyan Zhao, Fengbin Zhu, Chenyi Lei, Han Li, Wenwu Ou, Yang Song, Yongdong Zhang, Fuli Feng

ThinknCheck: Grounded Claim Verification with Compact, Reasoning-Driven, and Interpretable Models

Abstract (English): We present ThinknCheck, a 1B-parameter verifier for grounded claim verification that first produces a short, structured rationale and then a binary verdict. We construct LLMAggreFact-Think, a 24.1k reasoning-augmented training set derived from LLMAggreFact, and fine-tune a 4-bit Gemma3 model to follow this format. On LLMAggreFact, ThinknCheck attains 78.1 balanced accuracy (BAcc), surpassing MiniCheck-7B (77.4) with 7x fewer parameters; removing the reasoning step reduces BAcc to 57.5. On SciFact, ThinknCheck reaches 64.7 BAcc, a +14.7 absolute gain over MiniCheck-7B. By contrast, zero-shot chain-of-thought on the base Gemma3-1B harms accuracy relative to direct answers, and preference optimization with a simple format+accuracy reward underperforms supervised reasoning. To probe the latter, we introduce GSMClaims and a domain-specialized variant, ThinknCheck-Science, which improves across benchmarks, including 61.0\% accuracy on GSMClaims. Overall, explicit, supervised reasoning enables compact verifiers that are competitive while remaining resource-efficient and interpretable.

摘要（中文）: 我们提出ThinknCheck：一个用于有依据声明验证的10亿参数校验器，其首先生成简明的结构化推理过程，再输出二元判定结果。我们构建了LLMAggreFact-Think数据集——一个源自LLMAggreFact、包含2.41万条推理增强样本的训练集，并基于此对4位量化的Gemma3模型进行微调，使其遵循该推理格式。在LLMAggreFact数据集上，ThinknCheck达到78.1的平衡准确率（BAcc），以仅1/7的参数量超越MiniCheck-7B（77.4）；若移除推理步骤，BAcc会降至57.5。在SciFact数据集上，ThinknCheck获得64.7的BAcc，较MiniCheck-7B绝对提升14.7个百分点。相比之下，基础版Gemma3-1B的零样本思维链推理效果反而不如直接回答，而采用简单格式+准确率奖励的偏好优化方法也弱于监督式推理。为深入探究后者，我们引入GSMClaims数据集及领域特化变体ThinknCheck-Science，该模型在多个基准测试中实现提升，其中在GSMClaims上达到61.0%的准确率。总体而言，显式的监督推理机制使紧凑型校验器在保持资源高效性和可解释性的同时，仍具备竞争优势。

TLDR: This paper introduces ThinknCheck, a small, reasoning-driven language model for fact-checking, which uses a structured rationale step to improve verification accuracy.

简要说明: 本文介绍了ThinknCheck，一个用于事实核查的小型推理驱动语言模型，通过结构化推理步骤提高了验证准确性。

Authors: Delip Rao, Feijiang Han, Chris Callison-Burch

AromaGen: Interactive Generation of Rich Olfactory Experiences with Multimodal Language Models

Abstract (English): Smell's deep connection with food, memory, and social experience has long motivated researchers to bring olfaction into interactive systems. Yet most olfactory interfaces remain limited to fixed scent cartridges and pre-defined generation patterns, and the scarcity of large-scale olfactory datasets has further constrained AI-based approaches. We present AromaGen, an AI-powered wearable interface capable of real-time, general-purpose aroma generation from free-form text or visual inputs. AromaGen is powered by a multimodal LLM that leverages latent olfactory knowledge to map semantic inputs to structured mixtures of 12 carefully selected base odorants, released through a neck-worn dispenser. Users can iteratively refine generated aromas through natural language feedback via in-context learning. Through a controlled user study ($N = 26$), AromaGen matches human-composed mixtures in zero-shot generation and significantly surpasses them after iterative refinement, achieving a median similarity of 8/10 to real food aromas and reducing perceived artificiality to levels comparable to real food. AromaGen is a step towards real-world interactive aroma generation, opening new possibilities for communication, wellbeing, and immersive technologies.

摘要（中文）: 气味与食物、记忆及社交体验的深刻联系，长期以来驱动着研究者将嗅觉融入交互系统。然而，现有嗅觉接口大多受限于固定气味盒与预定义生成模式，且大规模嗅觉数据集的稀缺进一步制约了基于人工智能的方法发展。本文提出了AromaGen——一种基于人工智能的可穿戴接口，能够根据自由文本或视觉输入实时生成通用型气味。AromaGen由多模态大语言模型驱动，通过潜在嗅觉知识将语义输入映射至12种精心挑选的基础气味剂的结构化混合物，并经由颈戴式扩散器释放。用户可通过情境学习中的自然语言反馈迭代优化生成的气味。一项受控用户研究（N=26）表明，AromaGen在零样本生成中可达到与人工调配混合物相当的水平，经过迭代优化后更显著超越人工调配结果：其生成气味与真实食物气味的相似度中位数达到8/10（满分10分），并将人工感降至与真实食物相当的水平。AromaGen向着现实世界的交互式气味生成迈进了一步，为通信技术、健康福祉及沉浸式体验领域开辟了新的可能性。

TLDR: The paper presents AromaGen, a wearable AI system that uses a multimodal LLM to generate and refine real-time aromas from text or images for interactive experiences, not for robotics.

简要说明: 该论文提出了AromaGen，一种可穿戴AI系统，利用多模态LLM从文本或图像生成并实时精炼气味，用于交互体验，而非机器人应用。

Authors: Yunge Wen, Awu Chen, Jianing Yu, Jas Brooks, Hiroshi Ishii, Paul Pu Liang

Exploring Robust Multi-Agent Workflows for Environmental Data Management

Abstract (English): Embedding LLM-driven agents into environmental FAIR data management is compelling - they can externalize operational knowledge and scale curation across heterogeneous data and evolving conventions. However, replacing deterministic components with probabilistic workflows changes the failure mode: LLM pipelines may generate plausible but incorrect outputs that pass superficial checks and propagate into irreversible actions such as DOI minting and public release. We introduce EnviSmart, a production data management system deployed on campus-wide storage infrastructure for environmental research. EnviSmart treats reliability as an architectural property through two mechanisms: a three-track knowledge architecture that externalizes behaviors (governance constraints), domain knowledge (retrievable context), and skills (tool-using procedures) as persistent, interlocking artifacts; and a role-separated multi-agent design where deterministic validators and audited handoffs restore fail-stop semantics at trust boundaries before irreversible steps. We compare two production deployments. The University's GIS Center Ecological Archive (849 curated datasets) serves as a single-agent baseline. SF2Bench, a compound flooding benchmark comprising 2,452 monitoring stations and 8,557 published files spanning 39 years, validates the multi-agent workflow. The multi-agent approach improved both efficiency - completed by a single operator in two days with repeated artifact reuse across deployments - and reliability: audited handoffs detected and blocked a coordinate transformation error affecting all 2,452 stations before publication. A representative incident (ISS-004) demonstrated boundary-based containment with 10-minute detection latency, zero user exposure, and 80-minute resolution. This paper has been accepted at PEARC 2026.

摘要（中文）: 将大型语言模型驱动的智能体嵌入环境FAIR数据管理中极具吸引力——它们能将操作知识外化，并实现跨异构数据与动态规范的规模化数据治理。然而，用概率性工作流替代确定性组件会改变故障模式：LLM流程可能生成看似合理但实际错误的输出，这些输出通过表面检查后，会传播至诸如DOI注册与公开发布等不可逆操作中。我们提出EnviSmart，一个部署于校园级存储基础设施上、服务于环境研究的生产数据管理系统。EnviSmart通过两种机制将可靠性构建为架构属性：一是三轨知识架构，将行为（治理约束）、领域知识（可检索语境）与技能（工具使用流程）外化为持久化且相互锁定的构件；二是角色分离的多智能体设计，通过在不可逆操作前的信任边界部署确定性验证器与审计交接点，恢复故障停止语义。我们比较了两个生产环境部署案例：大学GIS中心生态档案库（包含849个标准化数据集）作为单智能体基线，而由2452个监测站点、8557个已发布文件、跨越39年数据的复合洪水基准数据集SF2Bench则验证了多智能体工作流。多智能体方法同时提升了效率（由单操作员在两天内完成，并实现了跨部署的构件复用）与可靠性：审计交接点在发布前检测并拦截了影响所有2452个站点的坐标转换错误。典型事件（ISS-004）展示了基于边界控制的故障隔离机制，实现10分钟检测延迟、零用户暴露及80分钟问题解决。本文已被PEARC 2026会议接收。

TLDR: This paper introduces EnviSmart, a multi-agent system for managing environmental data, focusing on reliability through knowledge architecture and deterministic validators to prevent errors in irreversible actions like public data release.

简要说明: 本文介绍了EnviSmart，一个用于管理环境数据的多智能体系统，通过知识架构和确定性验证器来保证可靠性，以防止在数据发布等不可逆操作中出现错误。

Authors: Boyuan Guan, Jason Liu, Yanzhao Wu, Kiavash Bahreini

Seclens: Role-specific Evaluation of LLM's for security vulnerablity detection

Abstract (English): Existing benchmarks for LLM-based vulnerability detection compress model performance into a single metric, which fails to reflect the distinct priorities of different stakeholders. For example, a CISO may emphasize high recall of critical vulnerabilities, an engineering leader may prioritize minimizing false positives, and an AI officer may balance capability against cost. To address this limitation, we introduce SecLens-R, a multi-stakeholder evaluation framework structured around 35 shared dimensions grouped into 7 measurement categories. The framework defines five role-specific weighting profiles: CISO, Chief AI Officer, Security Researcher, Head of Engineering, and AI-as-Actor. Each profile selects 12 to 16 dimensions with weights summing to 80, yielding a composite Decision Score between 0 and 100. We apply SecLens-R to evaluate 12 frontier models on a dataset of 406 tasks derived from 93 open-source projects, covering 10 programming languages and 8 OWASP-aligned vulnerability categories. Evaluations are conducted across two settings: Code-in-Prompt (CIP) and Tool-Use (TU). Results show substantial variation across stakeholder perspectives, with Decision Scores differing by as much as 31 points for the same model. For instance, Qwen3-Coder achieves an A (76.3) under the Head of Engineering profile but a D (45.2) under the CISO profile, while GPT-5.4 shows a similar disparity. These findings demonstrate that vulnerability detection is inherently a multi-objective problem and that stakeholder-aware evaluation provides insights that single aggregated metrics obscure.

摘要（中文）: 现有基于大语言模型的漏洞检测基准将模型性能压缩为单一指标，这无法反映不同利益相关方的差异化优先级。例如，首席信息安全官（CISO）可能强调对关键漏洞的高召回率，工程负责人可能优先考虑最小化误报，而人工智能主管则需在能力与成本间取得平衡。为弥补这一局限，我们提出SecLens-R——一个围绕7个测量类别下35个共享维度构建的多方利益相关者评估框架。该框架定义了五种角色专属的权重配置方案：CISO、首席人工智能官、安全研究员、工程负责人及AI自主执行者。每种方案选取12至16个维度，权重总和为80，最终生成0至100区间内的综合决策分数。 我们将SecLens-R应用于评估12个前沿模型，测试数据集包含来自93个开源项目的406项任务，涵盖10种编程语言和8个符合OWASP标准的漏洞类别。评估在两种设定下进行：代码提示（CIP）与工具调用（TU）。结果显示不同利益相关方视角下存在显著差异，同一模型的决策分数最大差值达31分。例如，Qwen3-Coder在工程负责人配置中获得A级（76.3分），但在CISO配置下仅得D级（45.2分）；GPT-5.4也表现出类似差异。这些发现表明漏洞检测本质上是多目标问题，而关注利益相关方的评估方法能揭示单一聚合指标所遮蔽的关键洞察。

TLDR: Presents Seclens-R, a multi-stakeholder evaluation framework for LLMs in code vulnerability detection, highlighting how performance varies significantly based on user role priorities.

简要说明: 提出Seclens-R，一个用于评估LLM代码漏洞检测的多方利益相关者框架，强调根据用户角色优先级的不同，模型性能存在显著差异。

Authors: Subho Halder, Siddharth Saxena, Kashinath Kadaba Shrish, Thiyagarajan M

RefinementEngine: Automating Intent-to-Device Filtering Policy Deployment under Network Constraints

Abstract (English): Translating security intent into deployable network enforcement rules and maintaining their effectiveness despite evolving cyber threats remains a largely manual process in most Security Operations Centers (SOCs). In large and heterogeneous networks, this challenge is complicated by topology-dependent reachability constraints and device-specific security control capabilities, making the process slow, error-prone, and a recurring source of misconfigurations. This paper presents RefinementEngine, an engine that automates the refinement of high-level security intents into low-level, deployment-ready configurations. Given a network topology, devices, and available security controls, along with high-level intents and Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI) reports, RefinementEngine automatically generates settings that implement the desired intent, counter reported threats, and can be directly deployed on target security controls. The proposed approach is validated through real-world use cases on packet and web filtering policies derived from actual CTI reports, demonstrating both correctness, practical applicability, and adaptability to new data.

摘要（中文）: 在多数安全运营中心(SOC)中，将安全意图转化为可部署的网络执行规则并在持续演变的网络威胁下保持其有效性，仍主要依赖于人工操作。在庞大且异构的网络环境中，拓扑相关的可达性约束与设备特定的安全控制能力使得这一挑战更为复杂，导致流程缓慢、易出错，并成为配置错误的常见根源。本文提出RefinementEngine——一种能够自动将高层级安全意图细化为可部署的低层级配置的引擎。基于网络拓扑、设备信息、可用安全控制策略、高层级意图以及网络威胁情报报告，RefinementEngine能自动生成满足预期意图、抵御已知威胁且可直接部署于目标安全控制设备的配置方案。通过基于真实网络威胁情报生成的数据包过滤与网页过滤策略的实际用例验证，该方案在正确性、实际适用性及对新数据的适应性方面均得到有效证明。

TLDR: This paper presents a system for automating the translation of high-level security intents into deployable network device configurations, validated on real-world filtering policy use cases.

简要说明: 本文提出了一种自动化系统，用于将高层级安全意图转换为可直接部署的网络设备配置，并通过真实世界的过滤策略用例进行了验证。

Authors: Davide Colaiacomo, Chiara Bonfanti, Cataldo Basile

OSCAR: Orchestrated Self-verification and Cross-path Refinement

Abstract (English): Diffusion language models (DLMs) expose their denoising trajectories, offering a natural handle for inference-time control; accordingly, an ideal hallucination mitigation framework should intervene during generation using this model-native signal rather than relying on an externally trained hallucination classifier. Toward this, we formulate commitment uncertainty localization: given a denoising trajectory, identify token positions whose cross-chain entropy exceeds an unsupervised threshold before factually unreliable commitments propagate into self-consistent but incorrect outputs. We introduce a suite of trajectory-level assessments, including a cross-chain divergence-at-hallucination (CDH) metric, for principled comparison of localization methods. We also introduce OSCAR, a training-free inference-time framework operationalizing this formulation. OSCAR runs N parallel denoising chains with randomized reveal orders, computes cross-chain Shannon entropy to detect high-uncertainty positions, and then performs targeted remasking conditioned on retrieved evidence. Ablations confirm that localization and correction contribute complementary gains, robust across N in {4, 8, 16}. On TriviaQA, HotpotQA, RAGTruth, and CommonsenseQA using LLaDA-8B and Dream-7B, OSCAR enhances generation quality by significantly reducing hallucinated content and improving factual accuracy through uncertainty-guided remasking, which also facilitates more effective integration of retrieved evidence. Its native entropy-based uncertainty signal surpasses that of specialized trained detectors, highlighting an inherent capacity of diffusion language models to identify factual uncertainty that is not present in the sequential token commitment structure of autoregressive models. We are releasing the codebase1 to support future research on localization and uncertainty-aware generation in DLMs.

摘要（中文）: 摘要： 扩散语言模型通过暴露其去噪轨迹，为推理时控制提供了天然的操作界面；因此，理想的幻觉缓解框架应利用这一模型原生信号在生成过程中进行干预，而非依赖外部训练的幻觉分类器。基于此，我们提出“承诺不确定性定位”方法：给定一个去噪轨迹，在事实不可靠的承诺传播为自洽但错误的输出之前，识别出跨链熵超过无监督阈值的词元位置。我们引入了一套轨迹级评估工具，包括跨链幻觉分歧度指标，以系统性比较不同定位方法。同时，我们提出OSCAR——一个无需训练、在推理时实现该方法的框架。OSCAR通过运行N条随机揭示顺序的并行去噪链，计算跨链香农熵以检测高不确定性位置，并基于检索到的证据进行针对性重掩码处理。消融实验证实，定位与校正策略能带来互补性增益，且在N取值为{4, 8, 16}时均保持稳健。在TriviaQA、HotpotQA、RAGTruth和CommonsenseQA数据集上使用LLaDA-8B与Dream-7B模型进行测试，OSCAR通过不确定性引导的重掩码机制显著减少幻觉内容、提升事实准确性，同时促进检索证据的更有效融合。其基于原生熵的不确定性信号超越了专用训练检测器的性能，突显出扩散语言模型在识别事实不确定性方面的内在能力，而这种能力在自回归模型的序列化词元承诺结构中并不存在。我们将公开代码库以支持未来关于扩散语言模型定位与不确定性感知生成的研究。

TLDR: This paper introduces OSCAR, a training-free inference-time framework for diffusion language models (DLMs) that uses parallel denoising chains and cross-chain entropy to localize and correct factual hallucinations during text generation, improving factual accuracy on QA benchmarks.

简要说明: 本文介绍了OSCAR，一种用于扩散语言模型的免训练推理框架，它使用并行去噪链和交叉链熵来定位和纠正文本生成过程中的事实性幻觉，在问答基准上提高了事实准确性。

Authors: Yash Shah, Abhijit Chakraborty, Naresh Kumar Devulapally, Vishnu Lokhande, Vivek Gupta

Automatic Image-Level Morphological Trait Annotation for Organismal Images

Abstract (English): Morphological traits are physical characteristics of biological organisms that provide vital clues on how organisms interact with their environment. Yet extracting these traits remains a slow, expert-driven process, limiting their use in large-scale ecological studies. A major bottleneck is the absence of high-quality datasets linking biological images to trait-level annotations. In this work, we demonstrate that sparse autoencoders trained on foundation-model features yield monosemantic, spatially grounded neurons that consistently activate on meaningful morphological parts. Leveraging this property, we introduce a trait annotation pipeline that localizes salient regions and uses vision-language prompting to generate interpretable trait descriptions. Using this approach, we construct Bioscan-Traits, a dataset of 80K trait annotations spanning 19K insect images from BIOSCAN-5M. Human evaluation confirms the biological plausibility of the generated morphological descriptions. We assess design sensitivity through a comprehensive ablation study, systematically varying key design choices and measuring their impact on the quality of the resulting trait descriptions. By annotating traits with a modular pipeline rather than prohibitively expensive manual efforts, we offer a scalable way to inject biologically meaningful supervision into foundation models, enable large-scale morphological analyses, and bridge the gap between ecological relevance and machine-learning practicality.

摘要（中文）: 形态特征是指生物体与周围环境相互作用过程中所呈现出的物理特征，这些特征为理解生物与环境的关系提供了关键线索。然而，提取这些特征目前仍是一个依赖专家、耗时缓慢的过程，限制了其在大规模生态研究中的应用。主要瓶颈在于缺乏将生物图像与特征级标注相关联的高质量数据集。本研究中，我们证明基于基础模型特征训练的稀疏自编码器能够产生具有单语义、空间定位的神经元，这些神经元在具有意义的形态部位上持续激活。利用这一特性，我们提出了一种特征标注流程，该流程可定位显著区域并利用视觉语言提示生成可解释的特征描述。通过此方法，我们构建了Bioscan-Traits数据集，其中包含来自BIOSCAN-5M的1.9万张昆虫图像共计8万项特征标注。人工评估证实了所生成形态描述在生物学上的合理性。我们通过全面的消融研究评估了设计敏感性，系统性地调整了关键设计选择，并测量了它们对最终特征描述质量的影响。通过采用模块化流程而非成本高昂的人工标注方式，我们提供了一种可扩展的路径，能将具有生物学意义的监督注入基础模型，支持大规模形态分析，从而弥合生态学意义与机器学习实用性之间的鸿沟。

TLDR: This paper introduces a pipeline using sparse autoencoders and vision-language prompting to automatically annotate morphological traits in biological images, creating a dataset for ecological studies.

简要说明: 本文提出了一种使用稀疏自编码器和视觉语言提示的流水线，用于自动标注生物图像中的形态特征，创建了一个用于生态学研究的数据集。

Authors: Vardaan Pahuja, Samuel Stevens, Alyson East, Sydne Record, Yu Su

NEMESIS: Noise-suppressed Efficient MAE with Enhanced Superpatch Integration Strategy

Abstract (English): Volumetric CT imaging is essential for clinical diagnosis, yet annotating 3D volumes is expensive and time-consuming, motivating self-supervised learning (SSL) from unlabeled data. However, applying SSL to 3D CT remains challenging due to the high memory cost of full-volume transformers and the anisotropic spatial structure of CT data, which is not well captured by conventional masking strategies. We propose NEMESIS, a masked autoencoder (MAE) framework that operates on local 128x128x128 superpatches, enabling memory-efficient training while preserving anatomical detail. NEMESIS introduces three key components: (i) noise-enhanced reconstruction as a pretext task, (ii) Masked Anatomical Transformer Blocks (MATB) that perform dual-masking through parallel plane-wise and axis-wise token removal, and (iii) NEMESIS Tokens (NT) for cross-scale context aggregation. On the BTCV multi-organ classification benchmark, NEMESIS with a frozen backbone and a linear classifier achieves a mean AUROC of 0.9633, surpassing fully fine-tuned SuPreM (0.9493) and VoCo (0.9387). Under a low-label regime with only 10% of available annotations, it retains an AUROC of 0.9075, demonstrating strong label efficiency. Furthermore, the superpatch-based design reduces computational cost to 31.0 GFLOPs per forward pass, compared to 985.8 GFLOPs for the full-volume baseline, providing a scalable and robust foundation for 3D medical imaging.

摘要（中文）: 体层摄影（CT）三维成像对于临床诊断至关重要，但三维数据的标注成本高昂且耗时，这促使研究者从无标注数据中进行自监督学习（SSL）。然而，将SSL应用于三维CT数据仍面临挑战：一方面，全卷Transformer模型内存开销巨大；另一方面，传统掩码策略难以有效捕捉CT数据的各向异性空间结构。本文提出NEMESIS框架——一种基于局部128×128×128超像素块的掩码自编码器（MAE），在保证内存高效训练的同时保留解剖细节。NEMESIS包含三个核心组件：（1）以噪声增强重建作为预训练任务；（2）掩码解剖Transformer模块（MATB）通过并行平面级与轴向级令牌删除实现双重掩码；（3）用于跨尺度上下文聚合的NEMESIS令牌（NT）。在BTCV多器官分类基准测试中，仅使用冻结骨干网络和线性分类器的NEMESIS模型平均AUROC达到0.9633，优于完全微调的SuPreM（0.9493）和VoCo（0.9387）模型。在仅使用10%标注数据的低标签场景下，其AUROC仍保持0.9075，展现出显著的标签效率优势。此外，基于超像素块的设计将单次前向计算量降至31.0 GFLOPs，较全卷基线模型的985.8 GFLOPs大幅降低，为三维医学影像分析提供了可扩展且鲁棒的解决方案。

TLDR: The paper proposes a memory-efficient masked autoencoder for self-supervised learning on 3D CT volumes, using noise-enhanced reconstruction and a novel dual-masking strategy to improve performance on medical image classification tasks.

简要说明: 该论文提出了一种用于3D CT体数据自监督学习的内存高效掩码自编码器，通过噪声增强重建和新颖的双重掩码策略，在医学图像分类任务上提升了性能。

Authors: Kyeonghun Kim, Hyeonseok Jung, Youngung Han, Hyunsu Go, Eunseob Choi, Seongbin Park, Junsu Lim, Jiwon Yang, Sumin Lee, Insung Hwang, Ken Ying-Kai Liao, Nam-Joon Kim

ByteRover: Agent-Native Memory Through LLM-Curated Hierarchical Context

Abstract (English): Memory-Augmented Generation (MAG) extends large language models with external memory to support long-context reasoning, but existing approaches universally treat memory as an external service that agents call into, delegating storage to separate pipelines of chunking, embedding, and graph extraction. This architectural separation means the system that stores knowledge does not understand it, leading to semantic drift between what the agent intended to remember and what the pipeline actually captured, loss of coordination context across agents, and fragile recovery after failures. In this paper, we propose ByteRover, an agent-native memory architecture that inverts the memory pipeline: the same LLM that reasons about a task also curates, structures, and retrieves knowledge. ByteRover represents knowledge in a hierarchical Context Tree, a file-based knowledge graph organized as Domain, Topic, Subtopic, and Entry, where each entry carries explicit relations, provenance, and an Adaptive Knowledge Lifecycle (AKL) with importance scoring, maturity tiers, and recency decay. Retrieval uses a 5-tier progressive strategy that resolves most queries at sub-100 ms latency without LLM calls, escalating to agentic reasoning only for novel questions. Experiments on LoCoMo and LongMemEval demonstrate that ByteRover achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on LoCoMo and competitive results on LongMemEval while requiring zero external infrastructure, no vector database, no graph database, no embedding service, with all knowledge stored as human-readable markdown files on the local filesystem.

摘要（中文）: 记忆增强生成（Memory-Augmented Generation，MAG）通过扩展大型语言模型的外部记忆功能来支持长上下文推理，但现有方法普遍将记忆视为外部服务，由智能体调用，并将存储工作委托给独立的文本分块、嵌入和图提取流程。这种架构分离意味着存储知识的系统并不理解知识本身，导致智能体希望记忆的内容与流程实际捕获的内容之间出现语义漂移，智能体间协调上下文丢失，且在故障后恢复困难。本文提出ByteRover，一种原生智能体记忆架构，其颠覆了传统记忆流程：由执行任务推理的同一大型语言模型负责知识的整理、构建和检索。ByteRover采用分层上下文树表示知识，这是一种基于文件的知识图谱，组织为领域、主题、子主题和条目四个层级，每个条目包含显式关系、来源信息以及具有重要性评分、成熟度分级和时效性衰减的自适应知识生命周期。检索采用五级渐进策略，大多数查询可在100毫秒内无需调用大型语言模型即得到解决，仅针对新颖问题才升级至智能体推理。在LoCoMo和LongMemEval上的实验表明，ByteRover在LoCoMo上达到最先进的准确率，在LongMemEval上获得有竞争力的结果，同时无需外部基础设施、向量数据库、图数据库或嵌入服务，所有知识均以人类可读的Markdown文件形式存储在本地文件系统中。

TLDR: Proposes ByteRover, an agent-native memory architecture that uses an LLM to curate a hierarchical knowledge graph for long-context reasoning, eliminating external infrastructure like vector databases.

简要说明: 提出了ByteRover，一种利用LLM构建层次化知识图谱的代理原生记忆架构，用于长上下文推理，无需外部向量数据库等基础设施。

Authors: Andy Nguyen, Danh Doan, Hoang Pham, Bao Ha, Dat Pham, Linh Nguyen, Hieu Nguyen, Thien Nguyen, Cuong Do, Phat Nguyen, Toan Nguyen

ThinkTwice: Jointly Optimizing Large Language Models for Reasoning and Self-Refinement

Abstract (English): We introduce ThinkTwice, a simple two-phase framework that jointly optimizes LLMs to solve reasoning problems and refine the answers, based on Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). In each pair of training steps, ThinkTwice first optimizes the model on solving reasoning problems, then optimizes it on refining its own solutions to the same problems, using the same binary correctness reward in both phases without correctness signals or critique annotations. Across five mathematical reasoning benchmarks and two model families including Qwen3-4B and Olmo3-7B, ThinkTwice substantially improves both reasoning and refinement performance over competitive online policy optimization baselines. Specifically, on Qwen3-4B, ThinkTwice outperforms GRPO on AIME by 5 percentage points before refinement and by 11.5 points after one self-refinement step, measured by pass@4. Analysis of the training dynamics of ThinkTwice reveals an implicit rectify-then-fortify curriculum: refinement predominantly corrects errors early in training and naturally shifts toward preserving already-correct solutions as the model improves, yielding a more rectified reward signal. Our work establishes joint training of reasoning and self-refinement as a principled and effective methodology for RLVR.

摘要（中文）: 我们提出了ThinkTwice框架——一个基于组相对策略优化（GRPO）的简单两阶段训练框架，旨在联合优化大语言模型，使其能够同时解决推理问题并优化自身给出的答案。在每个训练步骤对中，ThinkTwice首先针对问题求解阶段进行优化，随后针对模型对同一问题的解答进行自我优化。两个阶段均采用相同的二元正确性奖励信号，无需额外提供正确性标注或批评性注释。在涵盖五个数学推理基准测试及两种模型系列（包括Qwen3-4B与Olmo3-7B）的实验中，ThinkTwice相比当前主流的在线策略优化基线方法，在推理和优化能力上均取得显著提升。具体而言，在Qwen3-4B模型上，通过pass@4指标评估，ThinkTwice在AIME基准测试中相比GRPO基线在优化前阶段提升5个百分点，经过一次自我优化后提升幅度达到11.5个百分点。对ThinkTwice训练动态的分析揭示了一种隐式的“纠正-强化”学习机制：在训练早期阶段，优化过程主要集中于修正错误答案；随着模型能力提升，优化过程自然地转向对已有正确解的巩固强化，从而产生更为精确的奖励信号。本研究通过将推理与自我优化进行联合训练，为强化学习验证与修正（RLVR）领域提供了一种原则性且高效的方法论。

TLDR: This paper introduces ThinkTwice, a framework for jointly optimizing LLMs for reasoning and self-refinement using Group Relative Policy Optimization, improving performance on mathematical reasoning benchmarks.

简要说明: 本文介绍了ThinkTwice框架，通过群体相对策略优化联合优化大语言模型的推理和自修正能力，在数学推理基准上提升了性能。

Authors: Difan Jiao, Qianfeng Wen, Blair Yang, Zhenwei Tang, Ashton Anderson

NED-Tree: Bridging the Semantic Gap with Nonlinear Element Decomposition Tree for LLM Nonlinear Optimization Modeling

Abstract (English): Automating the translation of Operations Research (OR) problems from natural language to executable models is a critical challenge. While Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown promise in linear tasks, they suffer from severe performance degradation in real-world nonlinear scenarios due to semantic misalignment between mathematical formulations and solver codes, as well as unstable information extraction. In this study, we introduce NED-Tree, a systematic framework designed to bridge the semantic gap. NED-Tree employs (a) a sentence-by-sentence extraction strategy to ensure robust parameter mapping and traceability; and (b) a recursive tree-based structure that adaptively decomposes complex nonlinear terms into solver-compatible sub-elements. Additionally, we present NEXTOR, a novel benchmark specifically designed for complex nonlinear, extensive-constraint OR problems. Experiments across 10 benchmarks demonstrate that NED-Tree establishes a new state-of-the-art with 72.51% average accuracy, NED-Tree is the first framework that drives LLMs to resolve nonlinear modeling difficulties through element decomposition, achieving alignment between modeling semantics and code semantics. The NED-Tree framework and benchmark are accessible in the anonymous repository https://anonymous.4open.science/r/NORA-NEXTOR.

摘要（中文）: 将运筹学问题从自然语言自动翻译为可执行模型是一个关键挑战。虽然大型语言模型在线性任务中展现出潜力，但在实际非线性场景中，由于数学表达与求解器代码间的语义错位以及信息提取的不稳定性，其性能会严重下降。本研究提出NED-Tree这一系统性框架，旨在弥合语义鸿沟。该框架采用（a）逐句提取策略以确保稳健的参数映射与可追溯性；以及（b）基于递归的树状结构，将复杂的非线性项自适应地分解为求解器兼容的子元素。此外，我们构建了NEXTOR这一专门针对复杂非线性、多约束运筹学问题的新基准测试集。在10个基准测试中的实验表明，NED-Tree以72.51%的平均准确率刷新了当前最佳性能，成为首个通过元素分解驱动大型语言模型解决非线性建模难题、实现建模语义与代码语义对齐的框架。NED-Tree框架与基准测试集已在匿名仓库https://anonymous.4open.science/r/NORA-NEXTOR中公开。

TLDR: This paper introduces NED-Tree, a framework for translating natural language descriptions of complex nonlinear optimization problems into executable code, addressing a semantic gap that hinders Large Language Models.

简要说明: 本文提出NED-Tree框架，旨在解决大语言模型在将自然语言描述的复杂非线性优化问题转化为可执行代码时的语义鸿沟问题。

Authors: Zhijing Hu, Yufan Deng, Haoyang Liu, Changjun Fan

Harmonized Tabular-Image Fusion via Gradient-Aligned Alternating Learning

Abstract (English): Multimodal tabular-image fusion is an emerging task that has received increasing attention in various domains. However, existing methods may be hindered by gradient conflicts between modalities, misleading the optimization of the unimodal learner. In this paper, we propose a novel Gradient-Aligned Alternating Learning (GAAL) paradigm to address this issue by aligning modality gradients. Specifically, GAAL adopts an alternating unimodal learning and shared classifier to decouple the multimodal gradient and facilitate interaction. Furthermore, we design uncertainty-based cross-modal gradient surgery to selectively align cross-modal gradients, thereby steering the shared parameters to benefit all modalities. As a result, GAAL can provide effective unimodal assistance and help boost the overall fusion performance. Empirical experiments on widely used datasets reveal the superiority of our method through comparison with various state-of-the-art (SoTA) tabular-image fusion baselines and test-time tabular missing baselines. The source code is available at https://github.com/njustkmg/ICME26-GAAL.

摘要（中文）: 多模态表格-图像融合是一项新兴任务，在各领域受到越来越多的关注。然而，现有方法可能受到模态间梯度冲突的阻碍，误导单模态学习器的优化。本文提出一种新颖的梯度对齐交替学习（GAAL）范式，通过校准模态梯度来解决这一问题。具体而言，GAAL采用交替式单模态学习与共享分类器来解耦多模态梯度并促进交互。此外，我们设计了基于不确定性的跨模态梯度手术，以选择性对齐跨模态梯度，从而引导共享参数使所有模态受益。因此，GAAL能够提供有效的单模态辅助，并有助于提升整体融合性能。在多个广泛使用的数据集上的实证实验表明，通过与各种先进的表格-图像融合基线及测试时表格缺失基线进行比较，我们的方法具有显著优越性。源代码发布于https://github.com/njustkmg/ICME26-GAAL。

TLDR: Proposes a novel Gradient-Aligned Alternating Learning (GAAL) paradigm to address gradient conflicts between modalities for multimodal tabular-image fusion, improving model performance.

简要说明: 提出了一种新的梯度对齐交替学习（GAAL）范式，通过调整模态间梯度来解决多模态表格-图像融合中的梯度冲突问题，以提升模型性能。

Authors: Longfei Huang, Yang Yang

Does Your Optimizer Care How You Normalize? Normalization-Optimizer Coupling in LLM Training

Abstract (English): In LLM training, normalization layers and optimizers are typically treated as independent design choices. In a 3x2 factorial at 1B parameters and 1000 training steps, we show this assumption can fail: Dynamic Erf (Derf; Chen & Liu, 2025) suffers a large negative interaction with Muon (Jordan, 2024), with its gap to RMSNorm growing from +0.31 nats under AdamW to +0.97 under Muon, approximately three times larger. Dynamic Tanh (DyT; Zhu et al., 2025), included as a bounded-normalizer control, shows no such penalty. Our evidence points to two failure modes of erf under Muon's faster spectral-norm growth: saturation (lossy compression) and scale blindness (discarding activation magnitude). An EMA-blend that reintroduces running scale estimates recovers ~84% of the gap. Separately, reducing Derf's alpha from its published default (0.5 to 0.3) recovers ~80% by keeping erf in its near-linear regime, where it approximately preserves relative scale; this setting is not the published default of Chen & Liu (2025). Using Derf's published default alpha with Muon incurs a 0.66-nat interaction penalty without producing NaNs or divergence, making the failure easy to miss in short pilot runs.

摘要（中文）: 在大型语言模型训练中，归一化层与优化器通常被视为独立的设计选择。通过在十亿参数规模下进行1000步训练的3×2因子实验，我们发现这一假设可能不成立：动态Erf（Derf；Chen & Liu，2025）与Muon优化器（Jordan，2024）存在显著的负向交互作用，其相对于RMSNorm的优势差距从AdamW下的+0.31奈特扩大至Muon下的+0.97奈特，增幅约达三倍。作为有界归一化对照组的动态Tanh（DyT；Zhu et al.，2025）则未出现此类性能损失。证据表明，在Muon优化器引发的更快谱范数增长条件下，Erf存在两种失效模式：饱和态（有损压缩）与尺度盲态（丢失激活幅度信息）。通过引入滑动尺度估计的EMA混合方法可恢复约84%的性能差距；同时，将Derf的α参数从原默认值0.5降低至0.3（使其保持在近线性区间以保持相对尺度），可恢复约80%的性能差距——该设置并非Chen & Liu（2025）原论文的默认值。若将Derf原默认α参数与Muon优化器联用，会产生0.66奈特的交互损失，且不会引发NaN或发散现象，导致该问题在短期试运行中极易被忽视。

TLDR: This paper investigates the interaction between normalization layers (specifically Dynamic Erf) and optimizers (Muon) during LLM training, identifying a performance penalty due to activation saturation and scale blindness, and proposes mitigation strategies.

简要说明: 本文研究了LLM训练中归一化层（如动态Erf）与优化器（Muon）之间的相互作用，发现了由激活饱和和尺度盲区引起的性能损失，并提出了缓解策略。

Authors: Abdelrahman Abouzeid

PHMForge: A Scenario-Driven Agentic Benchmark for Industrial Asset Lifecycle Maintenance

Abstract (English): Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly deployed for complex tool-orchestration tasks, yet existing benchmarks fail to capture the rigorous demands of industrial domains where incorrect decisions carry significant safety and financial consequences. To address this critical gap, we introduce PHMForge, the first comprehensive benchmark specifically designed to evaluate LLM agents on Prognostics and Health Management (PHM) tasks through realistic interactions with domain-specific MCP servers. Our benchmark encompasses 75 expert-curated scenarios spanning 7 industrial asset classes (turbofan engines, bearings, electric motors, gearboxes, aero-engines) across 5 core task categories: Remaining Useful Life (RUL) Prediction, Fault Classification, Engine Health Analysis, Cost-Benefit Analysis, and Safety/Policy Evaluation. To enable rigorous evaluation, we construct 65 specialized tools across two MCP servers and implement execution-based evaluators with task-commensurate metrics: MAE/RMSE for regression, F1-score for classification, and categorical matching for health assessments. Through extensive evaluation of leading frameworks (ReAct, Cursor Agent, Claude Code) paired with frontier LLMs (Claude Sonnet 4.0, GPT-4o, Granite-3.0-8B), we find that even top-performing configurations achieve only 68\% task completion, with systematic failures in tool orchestration (23\% incorrect sequencing), multi-asset reasoning (14.9 percentage point degradation), and cross-equipment generalization (42.7\% on held-out datasets). We open-source our complete benchmark, including scenario specifications, ground truth templates, tool implementations, and evaluation scripts, to catalyze research in agentic industrial AI.

摘要（中文）: 大规模语言模型（LLM）智能体正日益被部署于复杂的工具编排任务中，然而现有基准测试未能反映工业领域的严苛要求——在这些领域中，错误决策可能引发严重的安全与财务后果。为填补这一关键空白，我们推出了PHMForge，这是首个专门通过与领域特定MCP服务器进行真实交互来评估LLM智能体在预测与健康管理（PHM）任务中表现的综合性基准测试。该基准涵盖75个专家设计的场景，横跨7个工业资产类别（涡扇发动机、轴承、电机、变速箱、航空发动机）及5项核心任务类型：剩余使用寿命（RUL）预测、故障分类、发动机健康分析、成本效益分析以及安全/政策评估。为实现严格评估，我们构建了跨两个MCP服务器的65个专用工具，并开发了基于执行的评估器，采用任务适配的指标：回归任务采用MAE/RMSE，分类任务采用F1分数，健康评估采用类别匹配。通过对主流框架（ReAct、Cursor Agent、Claude Code）与前沿大语言模型（Claude Sonnet 4.0、GPT-4o、Granite-3.0-8B）组合的广泛测试，我们发现即使最优配置也仅能完成68%的任务，且在工具编排（23%的序列错误）、多资产推理（性能下降14.9个百分点）和跨设备泛化（保留数据集上仅42.7%的准确率）方面存在系统性缺陷。我们已开源完整的基准测试资源，包括场景规范、真实数据模板、工具实现和评估脚本，以推动工业领域智能体人工智能的研究发展。

TLDR: PHMForge is a new benchmark for evaluating LLM agents on industrial Prognostics and Health Management (PHM) tasks, focusing on tool orchestration, reasoning, and generalization in a non-robotic domain.

简要说明: PHMForge 是一个用于评估工业预测与健康管理（PHM）任务中LLM智能体的新基准，专注于工具编排、推理和泛化能力，与机器人领域无关。

Authors: Ayan Das, Dhaval Patel

LLM Agents as Social Scientists: A Human-AI Collaborative Platform for Social Science Automation

Abstract (English): Traditional social science research often requires designing complex experiments across vast methodological spaces and depends on real human participants, making it labor-intensive, costly, and difficult to scale. Here we present S-Researcher, an LLM-agent-based platform that assists researchers in conducting social science research more efficiently and at greater scale by "siliconizing" both the research process and the participant pool. To build S-Researcher, we first develop YuLan-OneSim, a large-scale social simulation system designed around three core requirements: generality via auto-programming from natural language to executable scenarios, scalability via a distributed architecture supporting up to 100,000 concurrent agents, and reliability via feedback-driven LLM fine-tuning. Leveraging this system, S-Researcher supports researchers in designing social experiments, simulating human behavior with LLM agents, analyzing results, and generating reports, forming a complete human-AI collaborative research loop in which researchers retain oversight and intervention at every stage. We operationalize LLM simulation research paradigms into three canonical reasoning modes (induction, deduction, and abduction) and validate S-Researcher through systematic case studies: inductive reproduction of cultural dynamics consistent with Axelrod's theory, deductive testing of competing hypotheses on teacher attention validated against survey data, and abductive identification of a cooperation mechanism in public goods games confirmed by human experiments. S-Researcher establishes a new human--AI collaborative paradigm for social science, in which computational simulation augments human researchers to accelerate discovery across the full spectrum of social inquiry.

摘要（中文）: 传统社会科学研究通常需要设计复杂实验以探索广阔的方法论空间，并依赖真实人类参与者进行实施，导致研究过程劳动密集、成本高昂且难以规模化。本文提出S-Researcher——一个基于大语言模型智能体的平台，通过将研究过程与参与者群体“硅基化”，助力研究者更高效、更大规模地开展社会科学研究。为构建该平台，我们首先开发了大规模社会模拟系统YuLan-OneSim，其设计围绕三大核心要求：通过自然语言自动编程生成可执行场景的通用性、支持高达10万并发智能体的分布式架构可扩展性，以及通过反馈驱动的大语言模型微调实现的可靠性。依托该系统，S-Researcher支持研究者设计社会实验、用大语言模型智能体模拟人类行为、分析结果并生成报告，形成完整的人机协作研究闭环，研究者在各阶段均可保持监督与干预能力。我们将大语言模型模拟研究范式具体化为三种经典推理模式（归纳、演绎和溯因），并通过系统性案例验证S-Researcher的效能：基于阿克塞尔罗德理论成功复现文化动态的归纳推理、通过调查数据验证教师注意力竞争假设的演绎推理，以及经人类实验证实的公共物品博弈中合作机制的溯因识别。S-Researcher开创了社会科学研究的人机协作新范式，其中计算模拟增强人类研究者的能力，推动社会科学全领域探索的加速发展。

TLDR: This paper introduces S-Researcher, an LLM-agent-based platform that automates social science research by using LLM agents to simulate human participants and assist in experiment design, simulation, and analysis.

简要说明: 该论文介绍了S-Researcher，一个基于LLM智能体的平台，通过使用LLM智能体模拟人类参与者并辅助实验设计、模拟和分析，来自动化社会科学研究。

Authors: Lei Wang, Yuanzi Li, Jinchao Wu, Heyang Gao, Xiaohe Bo, Xu Chen, Ji-Rong Wen

Magic, Madness, Heaven, Sin: LLM Output Diversity is Everything, Everywhere, All at Once

Abstract (English): Research on Large Language Models (LLMs) studies output variation across generation, reasoning, alignment, and representational analysis, often under the umbrella of "diversity." Yet the terminology remains fragmented, largely because the normative objectives underlying tasks are rarely made explicit. We introduce the Magic, Madness, Heaven, Sin framework, which models output variation along a homogeneity-heterogeneity axis, where valuation is determined by the task and its normative objective. We organize tasks into four normative contexts: epistemic (factuality), interactional (user utility), societal (representation), and safety (robustness). For each, we examine the failure modes and vocabulary such as hallucination, mode collapse, bias, and erasure through which variation is studied. We apply the framework to analyze all pairwise cross-contextual interactions, revealing that optimizing for one objective, such as improving safety, can inadvertently harm demographic representation or creative diversity. We argue for context-aware evaluation of output variation, reframing it as a property shaped by task objectives rather than a model's intrinsic trait.

摘要（中文）: 大型语言模型（LLM）的研究将生成、推理、对齐与表征分析中的输出差异统称为“多样性”。然而，相关术语仍处于碎片化状态，这主要是因为任务背后的规范性目标往往未能明确界定。本文提出“魔法、疯狂、天堂、罪愆”框架，将输出差异建模在均质化-异质化轴上，其价值判断由具体任务及其规范性目标决定。我们将任务划分为四个规范性场景：认知性（事实准确性）、交互性（用户效用）、社会性（群体表征）和安全性（系统稳健性）。针对每个场景，我们考察了诸如幻觉、模式崩溃、偏见和抹除等导致输出差异的失效模式与术语体系。通过该框架，我们系统分析了所有跨场景的二元互动关系，发现优化单一目标（如提升安全性）可能无意中损害人口统计表征或创意多样性。我们主张应基于任务场景对输出差异进行情境化评估，将其重新定义为由任务目标塑造的特性，而非模型的内在属性。

TLDR: This paper proposes a conceptual framework (Magic, Madness, Heaven, Sin) to categorize and analyze the diverse outputs of LLMs based on task-specific normative objectives, arguing for context-aware evaluation rather than treating variation as an intrinsic model property.

简要说明: 本文提出了一个概念框架（Magic, Madness, Heaven, Sin），根据任务特定的规范性目标对LLM的多样化输出进行分类和分析，主张进行情境感知的评估，而非将输出多样性视为模型的内在属性。

Authors: Harnoor Dhingra

Type-Checked Compliance: Deterministic Guardrails for Agentic Financial Systems Using Lean 4 Theorem Proving

Abstract (English): The rapid evolution of autonomous, agentic artificial intelligence within financial services has introduced an existential architectural crisis: large language models (LLMs) are probabilistic, non-deterministic systems operating in domains that demand absolute, mathematically verifiable compliance guarantees. Existing guardrail solutions -- including NVIDIA NeMo Guardrails and Guardrails AI -- rely on probabilistic classifiers and syntactic validators that are fundamentally inadequate for enforcing complex multi-variable regulatory constraints mandated by the SEC, FINRA, and OCC. This paper presents the Lean-Agent Protocol, a formal-verification-based AI guardrail platform that leverages the Aristotle neural-symbolic model developed by Harmonic AI to auto-formalize institutional policies into Lean 4 code. Every proposed agentic action is treated as a mathematical conjecture: execution is permitted if and only if the Lean 4 kernel proves that the action satisfies pre-compiled regulatory axioms. This architecture provides cryptographic-level compliance certainty at microsecond latency, directly satisfying SEC Rule 15c3-5, OCC Bulletin 2011-12, FINRA Rule 3110, and CFPB explainability mandates. A three-phase implementation roadmap from shadow verification through enterprise-scale deployment is provided.

摘要（中文）: 金融服务领域自主性人工智能的快速演进引发了一场根本性的架构危机：大型语言模型作为概率性、非确定性的系统，正运行于需要绝对数学可验证合规保证的领域。现有护栏解决方案——包括英伟达NeMo Guardrails与Guardrails AI——依赖概率分类器和语法验证器，这些机制在本质上无法满足美国证券交易委员会、金融业监管局及货币监理署所要求的复杂多变量监管约束。本文提出精益智能体协议，这是一个基于形式化验证的AI护栏平台，利用Harmonic AI开发的亚里士多德神经符号模型，将机构政策自动形式化为Lean 4代码。所有拟议的智能体行为均被视为数学猜想：仅当Lean 4核心证明该行为满足预编译的监管公理时，才允许执行操作。该架构在微秒级延迟内提供密码学级别的合规确定性，直接满足美国证券交易委员会15c3-5规则、货币监理署2011-12号公告、金融业监管局3110规则及消费者金融保护局可解释性要求。研究同时提出了从影子验证到企业级部署的三阶段实施路线图。

TLDR: This paper proposes a formal-verification platform using the Lean 4 theorem prover to enforce strict, deterministic compliance guardrails for AI agents in financial services, addressing the probabilistic nature of LLMs in regulated environments.

简要说明: 本文提出了一种使用 Lean 4 定理证明器的形式化验证平台，为金融服务中的 AI 代理强制执行严格、确定性的合规护栏，以解决 LLM 在受监管环境中的概率性问题。

Authors: Devakh Rashie, Veda Rashi

DISCO-TAB: A Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning Framework for Privacy-Preserving Synthesis of Complex Clinical Data

Abstract (English): The development of robust clinical decision support systems is frequently impeded by the scarcity of high-fidelity, privacy-preserving biomedical data. While Generative Large Language Models (LLMs) offer a promising avenue for synthetic data generation, they often struggle to capture the complex, non-linear dependencies and severe class imbalances inherent in Electronic Health Records (EHR), leading to statistically plausible but clinically invalid records. To bridge this gap, we introduce DISCO-TAB (DIScriminator-guided COntrol for TABular synthesis), a novel framework that orchestrates a fine-tuned LLM with a multi-objective discriminator system optimized via Reinforcement Learning. Unlike prior methods relying on scalar feedback, DISCO-TAB evaluates synthesis at four granularities, token, sentence, feature, and row, while integrating Automated Constraint Discovery and Inverse-Frequency Reward Shaping to autonomously preserve latent medical logic and resolve minority-class collapse. We rigorously validate our framework across diverse benchmarks, including high-dimensional, small-sample medical datasets (e.g., Heart Failure, Parkinson's). Our results demonstrate that hierarchical feedback yields state-of-the-art performance, achieving up to 38.2% improvement in downstream clinical classifier utility compared to GAN and Diffusion baselines, while ensuring exceptional statistical fidelity (JSD < 0.01) and robust resistance to membership inference attacks. This work establishes a new standard for generating trustworthy, utility-preserving synthetic tabular data for sensitive healthcare applications.

摘要（中文）: 开发鲁棒的临床决策支持系统常因缺乏高保真且保护隐私的生物医学数据而受阻。虽然生成式大语言模型为合成数据生成提供了前景广阔的途径，但它们往往难以捕捉电子健康记录中固有的复杂非线性依赖关系与严重类别不平衡问题，导致生成的数据虽在统计上合理却缺乏临床有效性。为弥合这一差距，我们提出DISCO-TAB（面向表格合成的判别器引导控制框架），该创新框架通过强化学习优化的多目标判别器系统，协同调度微调后的大语言模型进行数据生成。与以往依赖标量反馈的方法不同，DISCO-TAB在词元、语句、特征和行四个粒度层面评估合成数据，同时集成自动约束发现与逆频率奖励重塑机制，以自主保持潜在的医学逻辑并解决少数类样本崩溃问题。我们在多样化基准测试中严格验证了该框架，包括高维度小样本医疗数据集（如心力衰竭、帕金森病）。实验结果表明，分层反馈机制实现了最先进的性能，相较于生成对抗网络和扩散模型基线方法，下游临床分类器效用提升达38.2%，同时确保卓越的统计保真度（JSD < 0.01）与对成员推理攻击的强抵抗能力。本研究为敏感医疗应用生成可信且保持效用的合成表格数据确立了新标准。

TLDR: This paper introduces a hierarchical reinforcement learning framework to synthesize high-fidelity, privacy-preserving clinical tabular data using a fine-tuned LLM guided by a multi-granularity discriminator, validated on medical datasets.

简要说明: 本文提出了一种分层强化学习框架，利用多粒度判别器引导的微调大语言模型来合成高保真、保护隐私的临床表格数据，并在医疗数据集上进行了验证。

Authors: Arshia Ilaty, Hossein Shirazi, Amir Rahmani, Hajar Homayouni

A Self-Evolving Agentic Framework for Metasurface Inverse Design

Abstract (English): Metasurface inverse design has become central to realizing complex optical functionality, yet translating target responses into executable, solver-compatible workflows still demands specialized expertise in computational electromagnetics and solver-specific software engineering. Recent large language models (LLMs) offer a complementary route to reducing this workflow-construction burden, but existing language-driven systems remain largely session-bounded and do not preserve reusable workflow knowledge across inverse-design tasks. We present an agentic framework for metasurface inverse design that addresses this limitation through context-level skill evolution. The framework couples a coding agent, evolving skill artifacts, and a deterministic evaluator grounded in physical simulation so that solver-specific strategies can be iteratively refined across tasks without modifying model weights or the underlying physics solver. We evaluate the framework on a benchmark spanning multiple metasurface inverse-design task types, with separate training-aligned and held-out task families. Evolved skills raise in-distribution task success from 38% to 74%, increase criteria pass fraction from 0.510 to 0.870, and reduce average attempts from 4.10 to 2.30. On held-out task families, binary success changes only marginally, but improvements in best margin together with shifts in error composition and agent behavior indicate partial transfer of workflow knowledge. These results suggest that the main value of skill evolution lies in accumulating reusable solver-specific expertise around reliable computational engines, thereby offering a practical path toward more autonomous and accessible metasurface inverse-design workflows.

摘要（中文）: 超表面逆向设计已成为实现复杂光学功能的核心，但将目标响应转化为可执行、与求解器兼容的工作流程仍需要计算电磁学及特定求解器软件工程的专业知识。近期的大语言模型为减轻工作流构建负担提供了补充途径，但现有语言驱动系统大多仍受限于单次会话，无法在跨逆向设计任务中保留可复用工作流知识。我们提出一种基于上下文级技能演化的超表面逆向设计智能体框架，以解决这一局限。该框架结合了编码智能体、演化的技能构件以及基于物理模拟的确定性评估器，使得特定求解器策略能在不修改模型权重或底层物理求解器的情况下跨任务迭代优化。我们在覆盖多种超表面逆向设计任务类型的基准测试中评估该框架，包含训练对齐任务族和独立保留任务族。演化后的技能使分布内任务成功率从38%提升至74%，标准通过率从0.510提高到0.870，平均尝试次数从4.10降至2.30。在保留任务族中，二元成功率仅有微小变化，但最佳边际值的提升以及错误构成和智能体行为的变化表明工作流知识已实现部分迁移。这些结果表明，技能演化的主要价值在于围绕可靠计算引擎积累可复用的特定求解器专业知识，从而为实现更自主、更易用的超表面逆向设计工作流程提供了可行路径。

TLDR: This paper presents a self-evolving agentic framework using LLMs to automate and improve the inverse design workflow for metasurfaces, accumulating reusable solver-specific skills across tasks.

简要说明: 本文提出了一种利用大语言模型的自进化智能体框架，用于自动化和改进超表面逆向设计流程，可在不同任务间积累可重用的求解器专用技能。
