Authors: Gabby Sanchez, Sneha Oommen, Cassandra T. Britto, Di Wang, Jung-De Chiou, Maria Spichkova

ModTrans: Translating Real-world Models for Distributed Training Simulator

Abstract (English): Large-scale distributed training has been a research hot spot in machine learning systems for industry and academia in recent years. However, conducting experiments without physical machines and corresponding resources is difficult. One solution is to leverage distributed training simulators, but current ones like ASTRA-sim do not support importing real-world developed models, which poses challenges for ML researchers seeking to use them. Based on this challenge, we developed ModTrans, a translator supporting format translation from any real-world model to the ASTRA-sim simulator's input, removing the barrier between machine learning experts and machine learning system researchers. The experiment results show that ModTrans's cost is negligible.

摘要（中文）: 近年来，大规模分布式训练已成为工业界与学术界在机器学习系统领域的研究热点。然而，在没有实体机器和相应资源的情况下进行实验十分困难。一种解决方案是利用分布式训练模拟器，但当前如ASTRA-sim等模拟器尚不支持导入真实场景开发的模型，这为希望使用该工具的机器学习研究者带来了挑战。基于此问题，我们开发了ModTrans——一款支持将任意真实模型格式转换为ASTRA-sim模拟器输入的翻译器，从而消除了机器学习专家与机器学习系统研究者之间的壁垒。实验结果表明，ModTrans引入的开销可忽略不计。

TLDR: This paper presents ModTrans, a tool for translating real-world ML models into a format compatible with the ASTRA-sim distributed training simulator, aiming to reduce the barrier for ML researchers to use simulation tools.

简要说明: 本文提出了ModTrans工具，可将真实世界开发的机器学习模型转换为ASTRA-sim分布式训练模拟器的输入格式，旨在降低机器学习研究人员使用仿真工具的门槛。

Authors: Yi Lyu

CRaFT: Circuit-Guided Refusal Feature Selection via Cross-Layer Transcoders

Abstract (English): As safety concerns around large language models (LLMs) grow, understanding the internal mechanisms underlying refusal behavior has become increasingly important. Recent work has studied this behavior by identifying internal features associated with refusal and manipulating them to induce compliance with harmful requests. However, existing refusal feature selection methods rely on how strongly features activate on harmful prompts, which tends to capture superficial signals rather than the causal factors underlying the refusal decision. We propose CRaFT, a circuit-guided refusal feature selection framework that ranks features by their influence on the model's refusal-compliance decision using prompts near the refusal boundary. On Gemma-3-1B-it, CRaFT improves attack success rate (ASR) from 6.7% to 48.2% and outperforms baseline methods across multiple jailbreak benchmarks. These results suggest that circuit influence is a more reliable criterion than activation magnitude for identifying features that causally mediate refusal behavior.

摘要（中文）: 随着人们对大型语言模型安全性的日益关注，理解拒绝行为的内在机制变得越来越重要。近期研究通过识别与拒绝行为相关的内部特征并操纵这些特征来促使模型遵从有害请求，从而探究这一行为。然而，现有的拒绝特征选择方法依赖于特征在有害提示上的激活强度，这往往捕捉到的是表面信号而非拒绝决策背后的因果因素。本文提出CRaFT，一种基于因果回路的拒绝特征选择框架，该框架通过使用接近拒绝决策边界的提示来评估特征对模型拒绝-遵从决策的影响程度，并据此对特征进行排序。在Gemma-3-1B-it模型上的实验表明，CRaFT将攻击成功率从6.7%提升至48.2%，并在多个越狱基准测试中优于现有基线方法。这些结果证明，相较于激活强度，回路影响程度是识别因果性调节拒绝行为特征的更可靠标准。

TLDR: The paper introduces CRaFT, a method for identifying and manipulating the internal 'circuit' features that causally drive refusal behavior in large language models, using boundary prompts to improve the selection process over activation-based methods.

简要说明: 本文提出了一种名为CRaFT的方法，通过边界提示识别和操纵大语言模型内部导致拒绝行为的因果‘回路’特征，相比基于激活幅度的方法，能更可靠地提升越狱攻击的成功率。

Authors: Su-Hyeon Kim, Hyundong Jin, Yejin Lee, Yo-Sub Han

Acoustic and perceptual differences between standard and accented Chinese speech and their voice clones

Abstract (English): Voice cloning is often evaluated in terms of overall quality, but less is known about accent preservation and its perceptual consequences. We compare standard and heavily accented Mandarin speech and their voice clones using a combined computational and perceptual design. Embedding-based analyses show no reliable accented-standard difference in original-clone distances across systems. In the perception study, clones are rated as more similar to their originals for standard than for accented speakers, and intelligibility increases from original to clone, with a larger gain for accented speech. These results show that accent variation can shape perceived identity match and intelligibility in voice cloning even when it is not reflected in an off-the-shelf speaker-embedding distance, and they motivate evaluating speaker identity preservation and accent preservation as separable dimensions.

摘要（中文）: 语音克隆通常从整体质量角度进行评估，但对其口音保留能力及感知影响的研究仍不充分。本研究通过计算与感知相结合的设计，比较了标准普通话与重度口音普通话及其语音克隆效果。基于嵌入向量的分析表明，在不同系统中，原始语音与克隆语音之间的距离并未呈现稳定的口音-标准差异。感知实验发现，相较于带口音者，标准发音者的克隆语音被评价为与原始语音更相似；同时克隆语音的清晰度较原始语音有所提升，且带口音语音的清晰度增益更为显著。这些结果表明，即使现成的说话人嵌入距离未能反映出口音差异，口音变化仍会影响语音克隆中感知身份匹配度和清晰度，这提示我们应将说话人身份保留与口音保留作为两个独立维度进行评估。

TLDR: This paper investigates accent preservation in voice cloning, comparing standard and accented Mandarin speech. It finds clones are perceived as more similar for standard speakers, and that accent variation affects perceived identity and intelligibility, even when not reflected in standard embedding metrics.

简要说明: 本文研究了语音克隆中的口音保持问题，比较了标准普通话和带口音的普通话及其克隆语音。研究发现，克隆语音在标准口音说话者上感知相似度更高，且口音差异影响身份感知和可懂度，尽管标准嵌入指标未能反映这些差异。

Authors: Tianle Yang, Chengzhe Sun, Phil Rose, Siwei Lyu

RAE-AR: Taming Autoregressive Models with Representation Autoencoders

Abstract (English): The latent space of generative modeling is long dominated by the VAE encoder. The latents from the pretrained representation encoders (e.g., DINO, SigLIP, MAE) are previously considered inappropriate for generative modeling. Recently, RAE method lights the hope and reveals that the representation autoencoder can also achieve competitive performance as the VAE encoder. However, the integration of representation autoencoder into continuous autoregressive (AR) models, remains largely unexplored. In this work, we investigate the challenges of employing high-dimensional representation autoencoders within the AR paradigm, denoted as \textit{RAE-AR}. We focus on the unique properties of AR models and identify two primary hurdles: complex token-wise distribution modeling and the high-dimensionality amplified training-inference gap (exposure bias). To address these, we introduce token simplification via distribution normalization to ease modeling difficulty and improve convergence. Furthermore, we enhance prediction robustness by incorporating Gaussian noise injection during training to mitigate exposure bias. Our empirical results demonstrate that these modifications substantially bridge the performance gap, enabling representation autoencoder to achieve results comparable to traditional VAEs on AR models. This work paves the way for a more unified architecture across visual understanding and generative modeling.

摘要（中文）: 生成模型的潜在空间长期由变分自编码器（VAE）编码器主导。以往认为，来自预训练表征编码器（如DINO、SigLIP、MAE）的潜在表示并不适合用于生成建模。近期，RAE方法的出现带来了希望，揭示出表征自编码器同样能达到与VAE编码器相竞争的性能。然而，将表征自编码器整合到连续自回归（AR）模型中的研究仍处于探索阶段。本文深入探讨了在AR范式下采用高维表征自编码器（称为“RAE-AR”）所面临的挑战。我们聚焦于AR模型的独特性质，识别出两大主要障碍：复杂的逐令牌分布建模，以及高维度下加剧的训练-推断差距（曝光偏差）。针对这些问题，我们通过分布归一化引入令牌简化，以降低建模难度并提升收敛效率。此外，我们在训练过程中加入高斯噪声注入，以增强预测鲁棒性并缓解曝光偏差。实验结果表明，这些改进显著缩小了性能差距，使表征自编码器在AR模型上取得了与传统VAE相当的结果。此项工作为视觉理解与生成建模架构的统一化铺平了道路。

TLDR: RAE-AR improves the integration of representation autoencoders into continuous autoregressive models for image generation, addressing training-inference gaps and high-dimensionality challenges.

简要说明: RAE-AR改善了表征自编码器在连续自回归模型中的整合，用于图像生成，解决了训练-推理差距和高维度挑战。

Authors: Hu Yu, Hang Xu, Jie Huang, Zeyue Xue, Haoyang Huang, Nan Duan, Feng Zhao

A Role-Based LLM Framework for Structured Information Extraction from Healthy Food Policies

Abstract (English): Current Large Language Model (LLM) approaches for information extraction (IE) in the healthy food policy domain are often hindered by various factors, including misinformation, specifically hallucinations, misclassifications, and omissions that result from the structural diversity and inconsistency of policy documents. To address these limitations, this study proposes a role-based LLM framework that automates the IE from unstructured policy data by assigning specialized roles: an LLM policy analyst for metadata and mechanism classification, an LLM legal strategy specialist for identifying complex legal approaches, and an LLM food system expert for categorizing food system stages. This framework mimics expert analysis workflows by incorporating structured domain knowledge, including explicit definitions of legal mechanisms and classification criteria, into role-specific prompts. We evaluate the framework using 608 healthy food policies from the Healthy Food Policy Project (HFPP) database, comparing its performance against zero-shot, few-shot, and chain-of-thought (CoT) baselines using Llama-3.3-70B. Our proposed framework demonstrates superior performance in complex reasoning tasks, offering a reliable and transparent methodology for automating IE from health policies.

摘要（中文）: 当前健康食品政策领域的信息提取大语言模型方法常受多种因素制约，包括政策文本结构多样性与不一致性导致的错误信息，具体表现为幻觉生成、错误分类和关键信息遗漏。为解决这些局限，本研究提出一种基于角色分工的大语言模型框架，通过分配专业化角色实现非结构化政策数据的自动信息提取：由大语言模型政策分析师负责元数据与机制分类，大语言模型法律战略专家识别复杂法律路径，大语言模型食品系统专家划分食品系统阶段。该框架通过将结构化领域知识（包括法律机制的明确定义与分类标准）融入角色定制提示词，模拟了专家分析工作流。我们在健康食品政策项目数据库的608项政策上进行评估，采用Llama-3.3-70B模型对比零样本学习、少样本学习和思维链基准方法。实验表明，该框架在复杂推理任务中表现优异，为健康政策信息自动化提取提供了可靠且透明的解决方案。

TLDR: This paper proposes a role-based LLM framework for structured information extraction from healthy food policy documents, improving accuracy over standard baselines by assigning specialized expert roles to the LLM.

简要说明: 本文提出了一种基于角色的LLM框架，用于从健康食品政策文件中进行结构化信息提取，通过为LLM分配专业角色来提升准确性，优于标准基线方法。

Authors: Congjing Zhang, Ruoxuan Bao, Jingyu Li, Yoav Ackerman, Shuai Huang, Yanfang Su

CuTeGen: An LLM-Based Agentic Framework for Generation and Optimization of High-Performance GPU Kernels using CuTe

Abstract (English): High-performance GPU kernels are critical to modern machine learning systems, yet developing efficient implementations remains a challenging, expert-driven process due to the tight coupling between algorithmic structure, memory hierarchy usage, and hardware-specific optimizations. Recent work has explored using large language models (LLMs) to generate GPU kernels automatically, but generated implementations often struggle to maintain correctness and achieve competitive performance across iterative refinements. We present CuTeGen, an agentic framework for automated generation and optimization of GPU kernels that treats kernel development as a structured generate--test--refine workflow. Unlike approaches that rely on one-shot generation or large-scale search over candidate implementations, CuTeGen focuses on progressive refinement of a single evolving kernel through execution-based validation, structured debugging, and staged optimization. A key design choice is to generate kernels using the CuTe abstraction layer, which exposes performance-critical structures such as tiling and data movement while providing a more stable representation for iterative modification. To guide performance improvement, CuTeGen incorporates workload-aware optimization prompts and delayed integration of profiling feedback. Experimental results on matrix multiplication and activation workloads demonstrate that the framework produces functionally correct kernels and achieves competitive performance relative to optimized library implementations.

摘要（中文）: 高性能GPU内核是现代机器学习系统的核心，然而由于算法结构、内存层次使用与硬件特定优化之间的紧密耦合，开发高效实现仍然是一项依赖专家经验的挑战性任务。近期研究尝试利用大型语言模型自动生成GPU内核，但生成的实现在迭代优化过程中往往难以保持正确性并达到有竞争力的性能。本文提出CuTeGen——一个用于GPU内核自动生成与优化的智能体框架，该框架将内核开发视为结构化的生成-测试-精炼工作流。区别于依赖单次生成或对候选实现进行大规模搜索的方法，CuTeGen通过基于执行的验证、结构化调试和分阶段优化，专注于对单个演化内核进行渐进式改进。其关键设计在于使用CuTe抽象层生成内核，该层暴露了分块和数据移动等性能关键结构，同时为迭代修改提供了更稳定的表示形式。为引导性能提升，CuTeGen整合了工作负载感知的优化提示机制，并采用延迟集成性能分析反馈的策略。在矩阵乘法和激活函数工作负载上的实验表明，该框架能够生成功能正确的内核，并在性能上达到与优化库实现相当的水平。

TLDR: A framework for using LLMs to iteratively generate and optimize GPU kernels via structured generation, testing, and refinement, demonstrated on matrix multiplication and activation workloads.

简要说明: 一个利用大型语言模型通过结构化生成、测试和优化，迭代式生成和优化GPU内核的框架，在矩阵乘法和激活函数工作负载上进行了演示。

Authors: Tara Saba, Anne Ouyang, Xujie Si, Fan Long

SelfGrader: Stable Jailbreak Detection for Large Language Models using Token-Level Logits

Abstract (English): Large Language Models (LLMs) are powerful tools for answering user queries, yet they remain highly vulnerable to jailbreak attacks. Existing guardrail methods typically rely on internal features or textual responses to detect malicious queries, which either introduce substantial latency or suffer from the randomness in text generation. To overcome these limitations, we propose SelfGrader, a lightweight guardrail method that formulates jailbreak detection as a numerical grading problem using token-level logits. Specifically, SelfGrader evaluates the safety of a user query within a compact set of numerical tokens (NTs) (e.g., 0-9) and interprets their logit distribution as an internal safety signal. To align these signals with human intuition of maliciousness, SelfGrader introduces a dual-perspective scoring rule that considers both the maliciousness and benignness of the query, yielding a stable and interpretable score that reflects harmfulness and reduces the false positive rate simultaneously. Extensive experiments across diverse jailbreak benchmarks, multiple LLMs, and state-of-the-art guardrail baselines demonstrate that SelfGrader achieves up to a 22.66% reduction in ASR on LLaMA-3-8B, while maintaining significantly lower memory overhead (up to 173x) and latency (up to 26x).

摘要（中文）: 摘要： 大语言模型（LLM）是回答用户查询的强大工具，但其仍极易受到越狱攻击的威胁。现有的防护方法通常依赖内部特征或文本响应来检测恶意查询，这些方法要么引入显著延迟，要么受限于文本生成的随机性。为克服这些局限，本文提出SelfGrader——一种轻量级防护方法，通过词元级对数概率将越狱检测转化为数值评分问题。具体而言，SelfGrader在紧凑的数值词元（NT）（如0-9）集合中评估用户查询的安全性，并将其对数概率分布解释为内部安全信号。为使这些信号与人类对恶意行为的直觉认知对齐，SelfGrader引入双视角评分规则，同时考量查询的恶意性和良性特征，从而生成稳定且可解释的评分：该评分既能反映危害程度，又能同步降低误报率。在多样化越狱基准测试、多类大语言模型及前沿防护基线的广泛实验中，SelfGrader在LLaMA-3-8B模型上实现了最高22.66%的攻击成功率下降，同时保持显著更低的内存开销（最高达173倍）与延迟（最高达26倍）。

TLDR: The paper proposes SelfGrader, a lightweight guardrail method for detecting jailbreak attacks on LLMs by grading user queries based on token-level logits to improve safety and reduce latency.

简要说明: 该论文提出了SelfGrader，一种轻量级的护栏方法，通过基于token级别logits对用户查询进行评分来检测LLMs的越狱攻击，以提高安全性并降低延迟。

Authors: Zikai Zhang, Rui Hu, Olivera Kotevska, Jiahao Xu

The Newton-Muon Optimizer

Abstract (English): The Muon optimizer has received considerable attention for its strong performance in training large language models, yet the design principle behind its matrix-gradient orthogonalization remains largely elusive. In this paper, we introduce a surrogate model that not only sheds new light on the design of Muon, but more importantly leads to a new optimizer. In the same spirit as the derivation of Newton's method, the surrogate approximates the loss as a quadratic function of the perturbation to a weight matrix $W$ using only three matrices: the gradient $G$, an output-space curvature matrix $H$, and the data matrix $Z$ that stacks the layer inputs. By minimizing this surrogate in one step and adopting a certain isotropic assumption on the weights, we obtain the closed-form update rule (up to momentum and weight decay) $W \leftarrow W - η\cdot \mathrm{msgn}(G(ZZ^\top)^{-1})$, where $η$ is the learning rate and $\mathrm{msgn}(X)=UV^\top$ if $X=USV^\top$ is a compact singular value decomposition. This new optimization method, which we refer to as Newton-Muon, shows that standard Muon can be interpreted as an implicit Newton-type method that neglects the right preconditioning induced by the input second moment. Empirically, on a reproduction of the earliest publicly released Modded-NanoGPT speedrun configuration using Muon for GPT-2 pretraining, Newton-Muon reaches the target validation loss in 6\% fewer iteration steps and reduces wall-clock training time by about 4\%.

摘要（中文）: Muon优化器因在训练大型语言模型中的卓越性能而备受关注，但其矩阵梯度正交化背后的设计原理在很大程度上仍不明确。本文引入一个代理模型，不仅为Muon的设计提供了新的视角，更重要的是由此推导出一种新的优化器。与牛顿法推导的思路相似，该代理模型仅使用三个矩阵——梯度$G$、输出空间曲率矩阵$H$以及堆叠层输入的数据矩阵$Z$，将损失近似为权重矩阵$W$扰动的二次函数。通过一步最小化该代理模型，并对权重采用各向同性的假设，我们得到闭式更新规则（忽略动量和权重衰减）：$W \leftarrow W - η\cdot \mathrm{msgn}(G(ZZ^\top)^{-1})$，其中$η$为学习率，$\mathrm{msgn}(X)=UV^\top$（当$X=USV^\top$为紧凑奇异值分解时）。我们将这一新优化方法称为Newton-Muon，它表明标准Muon可被解释为一种隐式牛顿型方法，其忽略了输入二阶矩所诱导的右预处理效应。实验表明，在采用Muon进行GPT-2预训练的最早公开Modded-NanoGPT速通配置复现中，Newton-Muon以减少6%的迭代步数达到目标验证损失，并将实际训练时间缩短约4%。

TLDR: A theoretical analysis of the Muon optimizer leads to a new optimizer called Newton-Muon, which is shown to be a Newton-type method and achieves slightly faster training for GPT-2 pretraining.

简要说明: 对Muon优化器的理论分析导出了名为Newton-Muon的新优化器，该优化器被证明是一种牛顿型方法，并在GPT-2预训练中实现了略微更快的训练。

Authors: Zhehang Du, Weijie Su

Reducing Hallucinations in LLM-based Scientific Literature Analysis Using Peer Context Outlier Detection

Abstract (English): Reducing hallucinations in Large Language Models (LLMs) is essential for improving the accuracy of data extraction from large text corpora. Current methods, like prompt engineering and chain-of-thought prompting, focus on individual documents but fail to consider relationships across a corpus. This paper introduces Peer Context Outlier Detection (P-COD), a novel approach that uses the relationships between documents to improve extraction accuracy. Our application domain is in scientific literature summarization, where papers with similar experiment settings should draw similar conclusions. By comparing extracted data to validated peer information within the corpus, we adjust confidence scores and flag low-confidence results for expert review. High-confidence results, supported by peer validation, are considered reliable. Our experiments demonstrate up to 98% precision in outlier detection across 6 domains of science, demonstrating that our design reduces hallucinations, enhances trust in automated systems, and allows researchers to focus on ambiguous cases, streamlining the data extraction workflows.

摘要（中文）: 降低大型语言模型（LLM）中的幻觉现象，对于提高从大型文本语料库中提取数据的准确性至关重要。当前方法如提示工程和思维链提示主要关注单个文档，但未能考虑语料库中文档间的关联。本文提出了一种新颖的跨文档关系利用方法——同行上下文异常检测（P-COD），以提升数据提取的准确性。我们的应用领域为科学文献综述，其中实验设置相似的论文应得出相似结论。通过将提取的数据与语料库中经过验证的同行信息进行比对，我们调整置信度分数并对低置信度结果进行专家审核标记。获得同行验证支持的高置信度结果被视为可靠数据。实验表明，在六个科学领域的异常检测中，我们的方法达到了高达98%的准确率，证明该设计能够有效减少幻觉、增强对自动化系统的信任，并使研究人员能够专注于模糊案例，从而优化数据提取工作流程。

TLDR: Proposes Peer Context Outlier Detection (P-COD) to reduce LLM hallucinations in scientific literature analysis by comparing extracted data against similar documents in a corpus, improving extraction precision.

简要说明: 提出Peer Context Outlier Detection（P-COD）方法，通过对比科学文献语料库中相似文档的提取数据，减少大语言模型在科学文献分析中的幻觉，提高信息提取精度。

Authors: Daniel Xie, Maxwell J. Jacobson, Adil Wazeer, Haiyan Wang, Xinghang Zhang, Yexiang Xue

Reproducible, Explainable, and Effective Evaluations of Agentic AI for Software Engineering

Abstract (English): With the advancement of Agentic AI, researchers are increasingly leveraging autonomous agents to address challenges in software engineering (SE). However, the large language models (LLMs) that underpin these agents often function as black boxes, making it difficult to justify the superiority of Agentic AI approaches over baselines. Furthermore, missing information in the evaluation design description frequently renders the reproduction of results infeasible. To synthesize current evaluation practices for Agentic AI in SE, this study analyzes 18 papers on the topic, published or accepted by ICSE 2026, ICSE 2025, FSE 2025, ASE 2025, and ISSTA 2025. The analysis identifies prevailing approaches and their limitations in evaluating Agentic AI for SE, both in current research and potential future studies. To address these shortcomings, this position paper proposes a set of guidelines and recommendations designed to empower reproducible, explainable, and effective evaluations of Agentic AI in software engineering. In particular, we recommend that Agentic AI researchers make their Thought-Action-Result (TAR) trajectories and LLM interaction data, or summarized versions of these artifacts, publicly accessible. Doing so will enable subsequent studies to more effectively analyze the strengths and weaknesses of different Agentic AI approaches. To demonstrate the feasibility of such comparisons, we present a proof-of-concept case study that illustrates how TAR trajectories can support systematic analysis across approaches.

摘要（中文）: 随着Agentic AI的发展，研究人员越来越多地利用自主智能体来解决软件工程中的挑战。然而，支撑这些智能体的大语言模型往往如同黑箱，使得Agentic AI方法相较于基线方法的优越性难以得到合理解释。此外，评估设计描述中的信息缺失常常导致实验结果无法复现。为了综合当前软件工程领域Agentic AI的评估实践，本研究分析了发表于ICSE 2026、ICSE 2025、FSE 2025、ASE 2025及ISSTA 2025的18篇相关论文。通过分析，本文梳理了当前研究及未来潜在研究中评估软件工程领域Agentic AI的主流方法及其局限性。针对这些不足，本立场论文提出了一套指导原则与建议，旨在推动软件工程中Agentic AI评估实现可复现、可解释且高效的目标。我们特别建议Agentic AI研究者公开其思维-行动-结果轨迹及大语言模型交互数据（或这些产物的摘要版本），以便后续研究能够更有效地分析不同Agentic AI方法的优势与局限。为了验证此类对比研究的可行性，我们还展示了一个概念验证案例，说明如何通过思维-行动-结果轨迹支持跨方法的系统性分析。

TLDR: This position paper analyzes and proposes guidelines for reproducible, explainable, and effective evaluation of Agentic AI in software engineering, focusing on the analysis of thought-action-result trajectories and LLM interactions.

简要说明: 这篇立场论文分析并提出了在软件工程中可复现、可解释和有效的 Agentic AI 评估指南，重点关注思想-行动-结果轨迹和大型语言模型交互的分析。

Authors: Jingyue Li, André Storhaug

Semantically Annotated Multimodal Dataset for RF Interpretation and Prediction

Abstract (English): Current limitations in wireless modeling and radio frequency (RF)-based AI are primarily driven by a lack of high-quality, measurement-based datasets that connect RF signals to their physical environments. RF heatmaps, the typical form of such data, are high-dimensional and complex but lack the geometric and semantic context needed for interpretation, constraining the development of supervised machine learning models. To address this bottleneck, we propose a new class of multimodal datasets that combines RF measurements with auxiliary modalities like high-resolution cameras and lidar to bridge the gap between RF signals and their physical causes. The proposed data collection will span diverse indoor and outdoor environments, featuring both static and dynamic scenarios, including human activities ranging from walking to subtle gestures. By achieving precise spatial and temporal co-registration and creating digital replicas for voxel-level annotation, this dataset will enable transformative AI research. Key tasks include the forward problem of predicting RF heatmaps from visual data to revolutionize wireless system design, and the inverse problem of inferring scene semantics from RF signals, creating a new form of RF-based perception.

摘要（中文）: 当前无线建模及基于射频的人工智能面临的主要局限在于缺乏高质量、基于实测的数据集，这些数据应能建立射频信号与其物理环境之间的联系。射频热图作为此类数据的典型形式，虽具有高维度和复杂性，却缺乏解读所需的几何与语义上下文，从而制约了监督式机器学习模型的发展。为突破这一瓶颈，我们提出一种新型多模态数据集，将射频测量数据与高分辨率相机、激光雷达等辅助模态相结合，以弥合射频信号与其物理成因之间的鸿沟。所提出的数据收集将涵盖多样化的室内外环境，包含静态与动态场景，并涉及从行走到细微手势等多种人类活动。通过实现精确的时空配准并创建用于体素级标注的数字孪生环境，该数据集将推动变革性的人工智能研究。核心任务包括从视觉数据预测射频热图的正向问题——这将彻底改变无线系统设计，以及从射频信号推断场景语义的逆向问题——从而开创一种全新的射频感知形式。

TLDR: Proposes a multimodal dataset combining RF measurements with vision/lidar to link RF signals to physical scenes, enabling AI tasks like predicting RF maps from vision and inferring scene semantics from RF signals.

简要说明: 提出一个结合射频测量与视觉/激光雷达的多模态数据集，旨在连接射频信号与物理场景，支持从视觉数据预测射频热图、从射频信号推断场景语义等AI任务。

Authors: Steve Blandino, Jelena Senic, Raied Caromi, Samuel Berweger, Anuraag Bodi, Camillo Gentile, Nada Golmie

Friends and Grandmothers in Silico: Localizing Entity Cells in Language Models

Abstract (English): Language models can answer many entity-centric factual questions, but it remains unclear which internal mechanisms are involved in this process. We study this question across multiple language models. We localize entity-selective MLP neurons using templated prompts about each entity, and then validate them with causal interventions on PopQA-based QA examples. On a curated set of 200 entities drawn from PopQA, localized neurons concentrate in early layers. Negative ablation produces entity-specific amnesia, while controlled injection at a placeholder token improves answer retrieval relative to mean-entity and wrong-cell controls. For many entities, activating a single localized neuron is sufficient to recover entity-consistent predictions once the context is initialized, consistent with compact entity retrieval rather than purely gradual enrichment across depth. Robustness to aliases, acronyms, misspellings, and multilingual forms supports a canonicalization interpretation. The effect is strong but not universal: not every entity admits a reliable single-neuron handle, and coverage is higher for popular entities. Overall, these results identify sparse, causally actionable access points for analyzing and modulating entity-conditioned factual behavior.

摘要（中文）: 语言模型能够回答许多以实体为中心的事实性问题，但其中涉及哪些内部机制仍不清楚。我们在多个语言模型中对这一问题展开研究。我们使用针对每个实体的模板化提示来定位实体选择性MLP神经元，并通过对基于PopQA的问答示例进行因果干预来验证这些神经元。从PopQA抽取的200个实体构成的集合中，定位到的神经元集中在模型早期层。负向消融操作会引发特定实体遗忘，而在占位符标记处进行受控注入时，相比于平均实体和错误单元对照，能提升答案检索效果。对于许多实体，一旦上下文初始化，激活单个定位神经元即可恢复与实体一致的预测结果，这符合紧凑实体检索机制，而非纯粹依赖深度渐增的逐步信息丰富过程。对别名、缩写、拼写错误及多语言形式的鲁棒性支持了"规范化表征"的解释。该效应虽强但非普适：并非每个实体都存在可靠的单神经元操控点，且热门实体的覆盖度更高。总体而言，这些结果为分析和调控实体关联的事实性行为提供了稀疏且可因果干预的切入点。

TLDR: This paper investigates the internal mechanisms of language models for entity-centric factual recall, localizing and causally manipulating specific neurons responsible for entity retrieval, which suggests a compact, canonicalized representation for many entities.

简要说明: 本研究探究语言模型在实体相关事实问答中的内部机制，通过定位和因果干预特定神经元，揭示了实体检索的紧凑、规范化表示形式。

Authors: Itay Yona, Dan Barzilay, Michael Karasik, Mor Geva

Can LLMs Predict Academic Collaboration? Topology Heuristics vs. LLM-Based Link Prediction on Real Co-authorship Networks

Abstract (English): Can large language models (LLMs) predict which researchers will collaborate? We study this question through link prediction on real-world co-authorship networks from OpenAlex (9.96M authors, 108.7M edges), evaluating whether LLMs can predict future scientific collaborations using only author profiles, without access to graph structure. Using Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct across three historical eras of AI research, we find that LLMs and topology heuristics capture distinct signals and are strongest in complementary settings. On new-edge prediction under natural class imbalance, the LLM achieves AUROC 0.714--0.789, outperforming Common Neighbors, Jaccard, and Preferential Attachment, with recall up to 92.9\%; under balanced evaluation, the LLM outperforms \emph{all} topology heuristics in every era (AUROC 0.601--0.658 vs.\ best-heuristic 0.525--0.538); on continued edges, the LLM (0.687) is competitive with Adamic-Adar (0.684). Critically, 78.6--82.7\% of new collaborations occur between authors with no common neighbor -- a blind spot where all topology heuristics score zero but the LLM still achieves AUROC 0.652 by reasoning from author metadata alone. A temporal metadata ablation reveals that research concepts are the dominant signal (removing concepts drops AUROC by 0.047--0.084). Providing pre-computed graph features to the LLM \emph{degrades} performance due to anchoring effects, confirming that LLMs and topology methods should operate as separate, complementary channels. A socio-cultural ablation finds that name-inferred ethnicity and institutional country do not predict collaboration beyond topology, reflecting the demographic homogeneity of AI research. A node2vec baseline achieves AUROC comparable to Adamic-Adar, establishing that LLMs access a fundamentally different information channel -- author metadata -- rather than encoding the same structural signal differently.

摘要（中文）: 大型语言模型（LLM）能否预测研究者之间的合作行为？本研究通过在OpenAlex的真实合著网络（包含996万作者、1.087亿条边）上进行链接预测，评估LLM能否仅凭作者档案（无需图结构信息）预测未来的科学合作。基于Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct模型在人工智能研究的三个历史时期进行实验，我们发现LLM与拓扑启发式方法捕捉到不同信号，并在互补场景中表现最强。在自然类别不平衡的新边预测任务中，LLM的AUROC达到0.714–0.789，超越共同邻居、Jaccard系数和优先连接等基线方法，召回率最高达92.9%；在平衡评估中，LLM在每个时期均优于所有拓扑启发式方法（AUROC 0.601–0.658 vs. 最佳启发式0.525–0.538）；在持续边预测中，LLM（0.687）与Adamic-Adar方法（0.684）表现相当。关键发现是：78.6–82.7%的新合作发生在无共同邻居的作者之间——这是所有拓扑启发式方法得分为零的盲区，而LLM仅通过作者元数据推理仍能达到0.652的AUROC。时序元数据消融实验显示研究概念是主导信号（移除概念会使AUROC下降0.047–0.084）。向LLM提供预计算图特征会因锚定效应降低性能，这证实了LLM与拓扑方法应作为独立互补的通道运行。社会文化消融实验发现，基于姓名推断的种族和机构所属国家在拓扑特征之外对合作预测无贡献，反映出人工智能研究领域的人口同质性。node2vec基线取得的AUROC与Adamic-Adar相当，表明LLM利用了根本不同的信息通道——作者元数据，而非对相同结构信号进行差异化编码。

TLDR: This paper uses LLMs to predict future academic collaborations from author metadata, analyzing its performance against topological graph heuristics on co-authorship networks.

简要说明: 该论文利用大型语言模型根据作者元数据预测学术合作，并在合著网络中对标拓扑图启发式方法评估其性能。

Authors: Fan Huang, Munjung Kim

Preference learning in shades of gray: Interpretable and bias-aware reward modeling for human preferences

Abstract (English): Learning human preferences in language models remains fundamentally challenging, as reward modeling relies on subtle, subjective comparisons or shades of gray rather than clear-cut labels. This study investigates the limits of current approaches and proposes a feature-augmented framework to better capture the multidimensional nature of human judgment. Using the Anthropic HHRLHF dataset, we evaluate ten diverse large language models LLMs under a standard pairwise preference setting, where baseline performance remains below 0.74 ROC AUC, highlighting the difficulty of the task. To address this, we enrich textual representations with interpretable signals: response length, refusal indicators, toxicity scores and prompt response semantic similarity, enabling models to explicitly capture key aspects of helpfulness, safety and relevance. The proposed hybrid approach yields consistent improvements across all models, achieving up to 0.84 ROC AUC and significantly higher pairwise accuracy, with DeBERTav3Large demonstrating the best performance. Beyond accuracy, we integrate SHAP and LIME to provide fine-grained interpretability, revealing that model decisions depend on contextualized safety and supportive framing rather than isolated keywords. We further analyze bias amplification, showing that while individual features have weak marginal effects, their interactions influence preference learning.

摘要（中文）: 学习人类对语言模型的偏好仍是一项根本性挑战，因为奖励建模依赖于微妙、主观的比较或灰色地带，而非明确的标签。本研究探讨了现有方法的局限性，并提出了一种特征增强框架，以更好地捕捉人类判断的多维特性。基于Anthropic HHRLLF数据集，我们在标准成对偏好设置下评估了十个不同的大语言模型，其基线性能均低于0.74 ROC AUC，凸显了该任务的难度。为此，我们通过可解释信号增强文本表示：响应长度、拒绝指标、毒性分数及提示-响应语义相似度，使模型能够显式捕捉有益性、安全性和相关性的关键维度。所提出的混合方法在所有模型中均实现了稳定提升，最高达到0.84 ROC AUC并显著提高成对准确率，其中DeBERTa-v3-Large表现出最佳性能。除准确率外，我们结合SHAP和LIME方法提供细粒度可解释性分析，揭示模型决策依赖于情境化的安全框架与支持性表达，而非孤立的关键词。进一步分析表明，尽管单一特征的边际效应较弱，但其交互作用会影响偏好学习中的偏差放大。

TLDR: This paper proposes a feature-augmented framework for human preference learning in large language models, focusing on interpretability and bias analysis using safety and relevance signals, applied to the Anthropic HHRLHF dataset.

简要说明: 本研究提出了一种用于大型语言模型人类偏好学习的特征增强框架，利用安全性和相关性等信号，重点在于可解释性和偏见分析，并应用于Anthropic HHRLHF数据集。

Authors: Simona-Vasilica Oprea, Adela Bâra

CXR-LT 2026 Challenge: Projection-Aware Multi-Label and Zero-Shot Chest X-Ray Classification

Abstract (English): This challenge tackles multi-label classification for known chest X-ray (CXR) lesions and zero-shot classification for unseen ones. To handle diverse CXR projections, we integrate projection-specific models via a classification network into a unified framework. For zero-shot classification (Task 2), we extend CheXzero with a novel dual-branch architecture that combines contrastive learning, Asymmetric Loss (ASL), and LLM-generated descriptive prompts. This effectively mitigates severe long-tail imbalances and maximizes zero-shot generalization. Additionally, strong data and test-time augmentations (TTA) ensure robustness across both tasks.

摘要（中文）: 本项研究旨在解决已知胸部X光片（CXR）病灶的多标签分类与未知病灶的零样本分类问题。为处理多样化的CXR拍摄角度，我们通过分类网络将针对特定拍摄角度的模型集成至统一框架中。针对零样本分类任务（任务2），我们基于CheXzero框架提出了一种新型双分支架构，该架构融合了对比学习、非对称损失函数以及大语言模型生成的描述性提示，有效缓解了极端长尾数据分布问题，并最大化零样本泛化能力。此外，在两项任务中均采用强数据增强与测试时增强策略，确保了模型在不同场景下的鲁棒性。

TLDR: A medical imaging paper proposing a unified framework for multi-label and zero-shot classification of chest X-ray lesions using projection-specific models, contrastive learning, and LLM-generated prompts.

简要说明: 一篇医学影像论文，提出一个统一框架，用于胸部X光片的已知和未知病变的多标签及零样本分类，结合投影特定模型、对比学习和LLM生成提示。

Authors: Juno Cho, Dohui Kim, Mingeon Kim, Hyunseo Jang, Chang Sun Lee, Jong Chul Ye

ViT-Explainer: An Interactive Walkthrough of the Vision Transformer Pipeline

Abstract (English): Transformer-based architectures have become the shared backbone of natural language processing and computer vision. However, understanding how these models operate remains challenging, particularly in vision settings, where images are processed as sequences of patch tokens. Existing interpretability tools often focus on isolated components or expert-oriented analysis, leaving a gap in guided, end-to-end understanding of the full inference pipeline. To bridge this gap, we present ViT-Explainer, a web-based interactive system that provides an integrated visualization of Vision Transformer inference, from patch tokenization to final classification. The system combines animated walkthroughs, patch-level attention overlays, and a vision-adapted Logit Lens within both guided and free exploration modes. A user study with six participants suggests that ViT-Explainer is easy to learn and use, helping users interpret and understand Vision Transformer behavior.

摘要（中文）: 基于Transformer的架构已成为自然语言处理与计算机视觉的共享基础模型。然而，理解这些模型的工作原理仍然具有挑战性，尤其是在视觉任务中，图像被处理为补丁标记序列。现有的可解释性工具往往侧重于孤立组件或专家导向分析，缺乏对完整推理流程的引导式端到端理解。为填补这一空白，我们提出ViT-Explainer——一个基于网络的交互式系统，能够提供从补丁标记化到最终分类的视觉Transformer推理全过程集成可视化。该系统结合了动画演示、补丁级注意力叠加层以及适配视觉任务的Logit Lens技术，同时支持引导式与自由探索两种模式。一项包含六名参与者的用户研究表明，ViT-Explainer易于学习使用，能有效帮助用户解读和理解视觉Transformer的行为机制。

TLDR: A web-based interactive visualization tool for understanding the full inference pipeline of Vision Transformers, from patch tokenization to classification.

简要说明: 一个基于Web的交互式可视化工具，用于理解Vision Transformer从图像分块到分类的完整推理流程。

Authors: Juan Manuel Hernandez, Mariana Fernandez-Espinosa, Denis Parra, Diego Gomez-Zara

Beyond the Fold: Quantifying Split-Level Noise and the Case for Leave-One-Dataset-Out AU Evaluation

Abstract (English): Subject-exclusive cross-validation is the standard evaluation protocol for facial Action Unit (AU) detection, yet reported improvements are often small. We show that cross-validation itself introduces measurable stochastic variance. On BP4D+, repeated 3-fold subject-exclusive splits produce an empirical noise floor of $\pm 0.065$ in average F1, with substantially larger variation for low-prevalence AUs. Operating-point metrics such as F1 fluctuate more than threshold-independent measures such as AUC, and model ranking can change under different fold assignments. We further evaluate cross-dataset robustness using a Leave-One-Dataset-Out (LODO) protocol across five AU datasets. LODO removes partition randomness and exposes domain-level instability that is not visible under single-dataset cross-validation. Together, these results suggest that gains often reported in cross-fold validation may fall within protocol variance. Leave-one-dataset-out cross-validation yields more stable and interpretable findings

摘要（中文）: 主题排他性交叉验证是面部动作单元检测的标准评估方法，但文献中报道的性能提升往往十分有限。本研究表明，交叉验证本身会引入可测量的随机方差。在BP4D+数据集上，重复进行3折主题排他性划分会在平均F1分数上产生±0.065的经验性噪声基底，而对于低出现频率的动作单元，其波动幅度更大。相较于与阈值无关的评估指标（如AUC），F1等基于操作点的度量指标波动更为显著，且模型排名会因不同的折划分方案而发生变化。 为进一步评估跨数据集鲁棒性，我们在五个动作单元数据集上采用留一数据集交叉验证协议进行分析。该方法消除了划分随机性，并揭示了在单数据集交叉验证中无法观察到的领域级不稳定性。综合来看，这些结果表明交叉验证中常报告的性能提升可能处于协议方差范围内。留一数据集交叉验证能够产生更稳定且更具解释性的研究结果。

TLDR: This paper quantifies the stochastic variance introduced by standard cross-validation in facial Action Unit (AU) detection, advocating for a Leave-One-Dataset-Out protocol for more stable and interpretable evaluation of models.

简要说明: 本文量化了面部动作单元检测中标准交叉验证引入的随机方差，并主张使用留一数据集出协议以获得更稳定和可解释的模型评估结果。

Authors: Saurabh Hinduja, Gurmeet Kaur, Maneesh Bilalpur, Jeffrey Cohn, Shaun Canavan

CASHG: Context-Aware Stylized Online Handwriting Generation

Abstract (English): Online handwriting represents strokes as time-ordered trajectories, which makes handwritten content easier to transform and reuse in a wide range of applications. However, generating natural sentence-level online handwriting that faithfully reflects a writer's style remains challenging, since sentence synthesis demands context-dependent characters with stroke continuity and spacing. Prior methods treat these boundary properties as implicit outcomes of sequence modeling, which becomes unreliable at the sentence scale and under limited compositional diversity. We propose CASHG, a context-aware stylized online handwriting generator that explicitly models inter-character connectivity for style-consistent sentence-level trajectory synthesis. CASHG uses a Character Context Encoder to obtain character identity and sentence-dependent context memory and fuses them in a bigram-aware sliding-window Transformer decoder that emphasizes local predecessor--current transitions, complemented by gated context fusion for sentence-level context.Training proceeds through a three-stage curriculum from isolated glyphs to full sentences, improving robustness under sparse transition coverage. We further introduce Connectivity and Spacing Metrics (CSM), a boundary-aware evaluation suite that quantifies cursive connectivity and spacing similarity. Under benchmark-matched evaluation protocols, CASHG consistently improves CSM over comparison methods while remaining competitive in DTW-based trajectory similarity, with gains corroborated by a human evaluation.

摘要（中文）: 在线手写将笔迹表示为时间有序的轨迹，这使得手写内容在各类应用中更易于转换与复用。然而，生成自然且忠实反映书写者风格的句子级在线手写仍具挑战，因为句子合成需要具有笔画连续性和间距的上下文相关字符。现有方法将这些边界属性视为序列建模的隐式结果，这在句子尺度及有限组合多样性下表现不可靠。我们提出CASHG——一种上下文感知的在线手写风格生成器，其显式建模字符间连接性以实现风格一致的句子级轨迹合成。CASHG通过字符上下文编码器获取字符身份和句子相关的上下文记忆，并在关注局部前驱-当前转移的双字滑动窗口Transformer解码器中融合这些信息，同时通过门控上下文融合机制补充句子级上下文。训练采用从孤立字形到完整句子的三阶段课程学习策略，提升了稀疏过渡覆盖下的鲁棒性。我们进一步提出连接性与间距度量标准——一种量化草书连笔和间距相似性的边界感知评估体系。在基准匹配的评估协议下，CASHG在连接性与间距度量上持续优于对比方法，同时在基于动态时间规整的轨迹相似性评估中保持竞争力，其提升效果通过人工评估得到进一步验证。

TLDR: Proposes a context-aware Transformer-based method for generating natural, style-consistent, sentence-level online handwriting trajectories by explicitly modeling inter-character connectivity and spacing.

简要说明: 提出一种基于上下文感知的Transformer方法，用于生成自然、风格一致的句子级在线手写轨迹，通过显式建模字符间连接性和间距来实现。

Authors: Jinsu Shin, Sungeun Hong, Jin Yeong Bak

Country-wide, high-resolution monitoring of forest browning with Sentinel-2

Abstract (English): Natural and anthropogenic disturbances are impacting the health of forests worldwide. Monitoring forest disturbances at scale is important to inform conservation efforts. Here, we present a scalable approach for country-wide mapping of forest greenness anomalies at the 10 m resolution of Sentinel-2. Using relevant ecological and topographical context and an established representation of the vegetation cycle, we learn a predictive quantile model of the normalised difference vegetation index (NDVI) derived from Sentinel-2 data. The resulting expected seasonal cycles are used to detect NDVI anomalies across Switzerland between April 2017 and August 2025. Goodness-of-fit evaluations show that the conditional model explains 65% of the observed variations in the median seasonal cycle. The model consistently benefits from the local context information, particularly during the green-up period. The approach produces coherent spatial anomaly patterns and enables country-wide quantification of forest browning. Case studies with independent reference data from known events illustrate that the model reliably detects different types of disturbances.

摘要（中文）: 自然与人为干扰正影响着全球森林的健康状况。开展大规模森林干扰监测对指导保护工作具有重要意义。本文提出了一种基于哨兵2号10米分辨率数据的可扩展方法，用于在全国范围内绘制森林绿度异常图。通过结合相关生态与地形背景信息以及已建立的植被周期表征模型，我们学习出基于哨兵2号数据归一化植被指数（NDVI）的预测分位数模型。利用所得的预期季节性周期，可检测2017年4月至2025年8月期间瑞士全境的NDVI异常。拟合优度评估表明，该条件模型能够解释中位数季节性周期观测变异的65%。模型持续受益于局部背景信息，尤其在植被返青期表现显著。该方法生成的空间异常模式具有连贯性，实现了全国尺度森林褐变现象的量化分析。结合已知事件的独立参考数据进行的案例研究表明，该模型能可靠检测各类森林干扰。

TLDR: The paper presents a scalable method for monitoring forest health and detecting disturbances across Switzerland using Sentinel-2 satellite imagery and a quantile model of the NDVI vegetation index.

简要说明: 本文提出了一种利用Sentinel-2卫星影像和NDVI植被指数的分位数模型，对瑞士全国的森林健康状况进行规模化监测和干扰检测的方法。

Authors: Samantha Biegel, David Brüggemann, Francesco Grossi, Michele Volpi, Konrad Schindler, Benjamin D. Stocker

Network Structure in UK Payment Flows: Evidence on Economic Interdependencies and Implications for Real-Time Measurement

Abstract (English): Network analysis of inter-industry payment flows reveals structural economic relationships invisible to traditional bilateral measurement approaches, with significant implications for real-time economic monitoring. Analysing 532,346 UK payment records (2017--2024) across 89 industry sectors, we demonstrate that graph-theoretic features which include centrality measures and clustering coefficients improve payment flow forecasting by 8.8 percentage points beyond traditional time-series methods. Critically, network features prove most valuable during economic disruptions: during the COVID-19 pandemic, when traditional forecasting accuracy collapsed (R2} falling from 0.38 to 0.19), network-enhanced models maintained substantially better performance, with network contributions reaching +13.8 percentage points. The analysis identifies Financial Services, Wholesale Trade, and Professional Services as structurally central industries whose network positions indicate systemic importance beyond their transaction volumes. Network density increased 12.5\% over the sample period, with visible disruption during 2020 followed by recovery exceeding pre-pandemic integration levels. These findings suggest payment network monitoring could enhance official statistics production by providing leading indicators of structural economic change and improving nowcasting accuracy during periods when traditional temporal patterns prove unreliable.

摘要（中文）: 产业间支付流的网络分析揭示了传统双边测量方法无法观测的结构性经济关系，这对实时经济监测具有重要启示。通过对英国89个行业部门532,346条支付记录（2017-2024年）的分析，我们发现包含中心性指标和聚类系数在内的图论特征将支付流预测精度较传统时间序列方法提升8.8个百分点。关键发现表明，网络特征在经济动荡时期最具价值：在COVID-19大流行期间，当传统预测精度崩溃时（R²从0.38降至0.19），网络增强模型仍保持显著更好的性能，网络贡献度达到+13.8个百分点。该分析确定金融服务、批发贸易和专业服务业为结构性核心产业，其网络位置显示的系统重要性远超交易量规模。样本期内网络密度增长12.5%，其中2020年出现明显中断，随后恢复至超越疫情前的一体化水平。这些发现表明，支付网络监测可通过提供结构性经济变化的先行指标，并在传统时间模式失效时期提高即时预测精度，从而增强官方统计数据的生成能力。

TLDR: This paper analyzes UK inter-industry payment flows using network analysis to improve economic forecasting and monitoring, showing significant benefits during disruptions like the COVID-19 pandemic.

简要说明: 该论文通过分析英国产业间支付流网络，提出利用图论特征改善经济预测，特别是在COVID-19等经济混乱时期，其模型表现优于传统方法。

Authors: Aditya Humnabadkar

Curia-2: Scaling Self-Supervised Learning for Radiology Foundation Models

Abstract (English): The rapid growth of medical imaging has fueled the development of Foundation Models (FMs) to reduce the growing, unsustainable workload on radiologists. While recent FMs have shown the power of large-scale pre-training to CT and MRI analysis, there remains significant room to optimize how these models learn from complex radiological volumes. Building upon the Curia framework, this work introduces Curia-2, which significantly improves the original pre-training strategy and representation quality to better capture the specificities of radiological data. The proposed methodology enables scaling the architecture up to billion-parameter Vision Transformers, marking a first for multi-modal CT and MRI FMs. Furthermore, we formalize the evaluation of these models by extending and restructuring CuriaBench into two distinct tracks: a 2D track tailored for slice-based vision models and a 3D track for volumetric benchmarking. Our results demonstrate that Curia-2 outperforms all FMs on vision-focused tasks and fairs competitively to vision-language models on clinically complex tasks such as finding detection. Weights will be made publicly available to foster further research.

摘要（中文）: 医学影像的快速发展推动了对基础模型的研究，以缓解放射科医生日益增长且不可持续的工作负担。尽管近期的基础模型已展现大规模预训练在CT和MRI分析中的潜力，但这些模型如何从复杂的放射学三维数据中学习仍有巨大优化空间。基于Curia框架，本研究提出Curia-2模型，通过显著改进原始预训练策略与表征质量，以更精准捕捉放射学数据的特性。该方法实现了亿级参数视觉Transformer架构的扩展，开创了多模态CT与MRI基础模型的先河。此外，我们通过将CuriaBench扩展重构为两个独立评估体系——针对基于切片的二维视觉模型任务与面向三维体积数据的基准测试——建立了系统化的模型评估标准。实验结果表明，Curia-2在视觉任务上优于所有基础模型，且在病灶检测等临床复杂任务中表现出与视觉语言模型相当的竞争力。我们将公开模型权重以促进后续研究。

TLDR: Curia-2 is a billion-parameter vision foundation model for medical imaging, specifically designed for CT and MRI analysis, with new pre-training strategies and a 2D/3D benchmark.

简要说明: Curia-2是一个用于医学影像（CT和MRI）的十亿参数视觉基础模型，采用了新的预训练策略并提出了2D/3D基准测试。

Authors: Antoine Saporta, Baptiste Callard, Corentin Dancette, Julien Khlaut, Charles Corbière, Leo Butsanets, Amaury Prat, Pierre Manceron

Automated Prostate Gland Segmentation in MRI Using nnU-Net

Abstract (English): Accurate segmentation of the prostate gland in multiparametric MRI (mpMRI) is a fundamental step for a wide range of clinical and research applications, including image registration, volume estimation, and radiomic analysis. However, manual delineation is time-consuming and subject to inter-observer variability, while general-purpose segmentation tools often fail to provide sufficient accuracy for prostate-specific tasks. In this work, we propose a dedicated deep learning-based approach for automatic prostate gland segmentation using the nnU-Net v2 framework. The model leverages multimodal mpMRI data, including T2-weighted imaging, diffusion-weighted imaging (DWI), and apparent diffusion coefficient (ADC) maps, to exploit complementary tissue information. Training was performed on 981 cases from the PI-CAI dataset using whole-gland annotations, and model performance was assessed through 5-fold cross-validation and external validation on an independent cohort of 54 patients from Hospital La Fe. The proposed model achieved a mean Dice score of 0.96 +/- 0.00 in cross-validation and 0.82 on the external test set, demonstrating strong generalization despite domain shift. In comparison, a general-purpose approach (TotalSegmentator) showed substantially lower performance, with a Dice score of 0.15, primarily due to under-segmentation of the gland. These results highlight the importance of task-specific, multimodal segmentation strategies and demonstrate the potential of the proposed approach for reliable integration into clinical research workflows. To facilitate reproducibility and deployment, the model has been fully containerized and is available as a ready-to-use inference tool.

摘要（中文）: 在多参数磁共振成像（mpMRI）中实现前列腺腺体的精确分割是众多临床与科研应用的基础步骤，包括图像配准、体积估算以及影像组学分析。然而，手动勾划分割既耗时又存在观察者间差异，而通用分割工具通常难以在前列腺特异性任务中提供足够的精度。本研究提出一种基于深度学习的专用方法，利用nnU-Net v2框架实现前列腺腺体自动分割。该模型融合多模态mpMRI数据（包括T2加权成像、扩散加权成像及其表观扩散系数图），以挖掘互补的组织信息。我们使用PI-CAI数据集中981例全腺体标注数据进行训练，并通过五折交叉验证及在拉费医院54例独立患者队列上的外部验证评估模型性能。所提模型在交叉验证中平均戴斯系数达0.96±0.00，在外部测试集上为0.82，显示出面对域偏移时优异的泛化能力。相比之下，通用分割工具在同等测试条件下仅获得0.15的戴斯系数，主要因腺体分割不足导致。这些结果凸显了任务特异性多模态分割策略的重要性，并证明该方法具备可靠融入临床研究流程的潜力。为促进可重复性与部署应用，该模型已完全容器化，可作为即用型推理工具公开获取。

TLDR: This paper proposes a deep learning model based on nnU-Net v2 for automated segmentation of the prostate gland in MRI, achieving high Dice scores on internal and external validation, and is presented as a tool for clinical research.

简要说明: 本研究提出了一种基于nnU-Net v2框架的深度学习模型，用于MRI中前列腺腺体的自动分割，在内部和外部验证中均取得了较高的Dice分数，并作为临床研究工具发布。

Authors: Pablo Rodriguez-Belenguer, Gloria Ribas, Javier Aquerreta Escribano, Rafael Moreno-Calatayud, Leonor Cerda-Alberich, Luis Marti-Bonmati

Rethinking Representations for Cross-Domain Infrared Small Target Detection: A Generalizable Perspective from the Frequency Domain

Abstract (English): The accurate target-background separation in infrared small target detection (IRSTD) highly depends on the discriminability of extracted representations. However, most existing methods are confined to domain-consistent settings, while overlooking whether such discriminability can generalize to unseen domains. In practice, distribution shifts between training and testing data are inevitable due to variations in observational conditions and environmental factors. Meanwhile, the intrinsic indistinctiveness of infrared small targets aggravates overfitting to domain-specific patterns. Consequently, the detection performance of models trained on source domains can be severely degraded when deployed in unseen domains. To address this challenge, we propose a spatial-spectral collaborative perception network (S$^2$CPNet) for cross-domain IRSTD. Moving beyond conventional spatial learning pipelines, we rethink IRSTD representations from a frequency perspective and reveal inconsistencies in spectral phase as the primary manifestation of domain discrepancies. Based on this insight, we develop a phase rectification module (PRM) to derive generalizable target awareness. Then, we employ an orthogonal attention mechanism (OAM) in skip connections to preserve positional information while refining informative representations. Moreover, the bias toward domain-specific patterns is further mitigated through selective style recomposition (SSR). Extensive experiments have been conducted on three IRSTD datasets, and the proposed method consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance under diverse cross-domain settings.

摘要（中文）: 红外小目标检测（IRSTD）中的精确目标与背景分离高度依赖于所提取特征的可区分性。然而，现有方法大多局限于域内一致性设定，忽视了这种可区分性是否能推广到未知领域。实践中，由于观测条件和环境因素的变化，训练与测试数据之间的分布差异不可避免。同时，红外小目标固有的模糊性加剧了模型对特定领域模式的过拟合。因此，当在未知域部署时，基于源域训练的模型检测性能会出现严重下降。为应对这一挑战，我们提出一种面向跨域红外小目标检测的空间-频谱协同感知网络（S$^2$CPNet）。突破传统空间学习范式，我们从频率视角重新审视红外小目标特征表达，发现频谱相位的不一致性是域差异的主要表现形式。基于此发现，我们设计了相位校正模块（PRM）以获取泛化性的目标感知能力。随后，在跳跃连接中采用正交注意力机制（OAM），在精炼有效特征的同时保留位置信息。此外，通过选择性风格重组（SSR）进一步缓解模型对特定领域模式的偏向。在三个红外小目标检测数据集上的大量实验表明，所提方法在多种跨域场景下均能取得先进的性能表现。

TLDR: This paper proposes a spatial-spectral network for cross-domain infrared small target detection, focusing on frequency-domain representations to improve generalization across different environmental conditions.

简要说明: 本文提出了一种用于跨域红外小目标检测的空间-光谱协作感知网络，通过从频域角度重新思考表示以提高跨不同环境条件的泛化能力。

Authors: Yimin Fu, Songbo Wang, Feiyan Wu, Jialin Lyu, Zhunga Liu, Michael K. Ng

Enhancing Medical Visual Grounding via Knowledge-guided Spatial Prompts

Abstract (English): Medical Visual Grounding (MVG) aims to identify diagnostically relevant phrases from free-text radiology reports and localize their corresponding regions in medical images, providing interpretable visual evidence to support clinical decision-making. Although recent Vision-Language Models (VLMs) exhibit promising multimodal reasoning ability, their grounding remains insufficient spatial precision, largely due to a lack of explicit localization priors when relying solely on latent embeddings. In this work, we analyze this limitation from an attention perspective and propose KnowMVG, a Knowledge-prior and global-local attention enhancement framework for MVG in VLMs that explicitly strengthens spatial awareness during decoding. Specifically, we present a knowledge-enhanced prompting strategy that encodes phrase related medical knowledge into compact embeddings, together with a global-local attention that jointly leverages coarse global information and refined local cues to guide precise region localization. localization. This design bridges high-level semantic understanding and fine-grained visual perception without introducing extra textual reasoning overhead. Extensive experiments on four MVG benchmarks demonstrate that our KnowMVG consistently outperforms existing approaches, achieving gains of 3.0% in AP50 and 2.6% in mIoU over prior state-of-the-art methods. Qualitative and ablation studies further validate the effectiveness of each component.

摘要（中文）: 医学视觉定位旨在从自由文本放射学报告中识别具有诊断意义的短语，并定位其在医学图像中的对应区域，从而为临床决策提供可解释的视觉证据。尽管现有的视觉语言模型展现出强大的多模态推理能力，但其定位结果仍缺乏足够的空间精度，这主要源于仅依赖隐式嵌入而缺乏显式定位先验知识。本研究从注意力机制的角度分析了这一局限，提出了KnowMVG框架——一种基于知识先验和全局-局部注意力增强的视觉语言模型医学视觉定位方法，显式强化解码过程中的空间感知能力。具体而言，我们设计了一种知识增强提示策略，将短语相关的医学知识编码为紧凑的嵌入表示；同时提出全局-局部注意力机制，协同利用粗略的全局信息与精细的局部线索来指导精确区域定位。该设计在无需引入额外文本推理开销的前提下，实现了高层语义理解与细粒度视觉感知的融合。在四个医学视觉定位基准数据集上的实验表明，KnowMVG始终优于现有方法，在AP50指标上提升3.0%，在mIoU指标上提升2.6%。定性分析与消融实验进一步验证了各模块的有效性。

TLDR: This paper proposes a knowledge-guided framework to improve the spatial precision of Vision-Language Models for medical visual grounding, which involves localizing text phrases in radiology images.

简要说明: 本文提出了一种知识引导的框架，用于提高视觉语言模型在医学视觉定位（将放射学报告中的文本短语与图像区域对应）中的空间精度。

Authors: Yifan Gao, Tao Zhou, Yi Zhou, Ke Zou, Yizhe Zhang, Huazhu Fu

Night Eyes: A Reproducible Framework for Constellation-Based Corneal Reflection Matching

Abstract (English): Corneal reflection (glint) detection plays an important role in pupil-corneal reflection (P-CR) eye tracking, but in practice it is often handled as heuristics embedded within larger systems, making reproducibility difficult across hardware setups. We introduce a 2D geometry-driven, constellation-based pipeline for mulit-glint detection and matching, focusing on reproducibility and clear evaluation. Inspired by lost-in-space star identification, we treat glints as structured constellations rather than independent blobs. We propose a Similarity-Layout Alignment (SLA) procedure which adapts constellation matching to the specific constraints of multi-LED eye tracking. The framework brings together controlled over-detection, adaptive candidate fallback, appearance-aware scoring, and optional semantic layout priors while keeping detection and correspondence explicitly separated. Evaluated on a public multi-LED dataset, the system provides stable identity-preserving correspondence under noisy conditions. We release code, presets, and evaluation scripts to enable transparent replication, comparison, and dataset annotation.

摘要（中文）: 角膜反射光斑检测在瞳孔-角膜反射式眼动追踪中具有重要作用，但在实际应用中常作为启发式算法嵌入大型系统，导致不同硬件配置下的可复现性较差。我们提出一种基于二维几何结构的星群式多光斑检测与匹配流程，注重可复现性与清晰评估。受"空间迷失"星体识别技术启发，我们将光斑视作结构化星群而非独立斑点。提出相似性-布局对齐算法，使星群匹配适应多LED眼动追踪的特殊约束。该框架整合了可控过检测、自适应候补回退机制、外观感知评分系统及可选的语义布局先验知识，同时保持检测与对应关系的显式分离。在公开多LED数据集上的测试表明，系统能在噪声环境下提供稳定的身份保持型对应关系。我们公开了代码、预设参数与评估脚本，以支持透明的复现、比较与数据集标注工作。

TLDR: The paper introduces a reproducible, constellation-based pipeline for detecting and matching corneal reflections (glints) in eye tracking, using 2D geometry and similarity-layout alignment, inspired by lost-in-space star identification.

简要说明: 本文提出了一种可复现的、基于星群匹配的角膜反射检测与匹配流程，采用2D几何和相似性-布局对齐方法，灵感来自空间星体识别。

Authors: Virmarie Maquiling, Yasmeen Abdrabou, Enkelejda Kasneci

GS^2: Graph-based Spatial Distribution Optimization for Compact 3D Gaussian Splatting

Abstract (English): 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has demonstrated breakthrough performance in novel view synthesis and real-time rendering. Nevertheless, its practicality is constrained by the high memory cost due to a huge number of Gaussian points. Many pruning-based 3DGS variants have been proposed for memory saving, but often compromise spatial consistency and may lead to rendering artifacts. To address this issue, we propose graph-based spatial distribution optimization for compact 3D Gaussian Splatting (GS\textasciicircum2), which enhances reconstruction quality by optimizing the spatial distribution of Gaussian points. Specifically, we introduce an evidence lower bound (ELBO)-based adaptive densification strategy that automatically controls the densification process. In addition, an opacity-aware progressive pruning strategy is proposed to further reduce memory consumption by dynamically removing low-opacity Gaussian points. Furthermore, we propose a graph-based feature encoding module to adjust the spatial distribution via feature-guided point shifting. Extensive experiments validate that GS\textasciicircum2 achieves a compact Gaussian representation while delivering superior rendering quality. Compared with 3DGS, it achieves higher PSNR with only about 12.5\% Gaussian points. Furthermore, it outperforms all compared baselines in both rendering quality and memory efficiency.

摘要（中文）: 三维高斯泼溅（3DGS）在新视角合成与实时渲染中已展现出突破性性能。然而，由于大量高斯点造成的高内存开销，其实用性受到限制。为降低内存占用，已有多种基于剪枝的3DGS变体被提出，但这些方法往往牺牲空间一致性，可能导致渲染伪影。为解决这一问题，我们提出基于图结构的空间分布优化方法（GS²），通过优化高斯点的空间分布来提升重建质量。具体而言，我们引入了一种基于证据下界（ELBO）的自适应致密化策略，能够自动控制高斯点的致密化过程。此外，提出了一种透明度感知的渐进式剪枝策略，通过动态移除低透明度高斯点进一步降低内存消耗。同时，我们设计了基于图结构的特征编码模块，通过特征引导的点位移调整空间分布。大量实验验证表明，GS²在实现紧凑高斯表示的同时，提供了更优的渲染质量。与3DGS相比，该方法仅需约12.5%的高斯点即可获得更高的峰值信噪比。此外，其在渲染质量与内存效率方面均优于所有对比基线方法。

TLDR: A method for optimizing the spatial distribution of Gaussian points in 3D Gaussian Splatting to reduce memory consumption while maintaining high rendering quality.

简要说明: 一种优化3D高斯溅射中高斯点空间分布的方法，以在保持高渲染质量的同时减少内存消耗。

Authors: Xianben Yang, Tao Wang, Yuxuan Li, Yi Jin, Haibin Ling

Combining Boundary Supervision and Segment-Level Regularization for Fine-Grained Action Segmentation

Abstract (English): Recent progress in Temporal Action Segmentation (TAS) has increasingly relied on complex architectures, which can hinder practical deployment. We present a lightweight dual-loss training framework that improves fine-grained segmentation quality with only one additional output channel and two auxiliary loss terms, requiring minimal architectural modification. Our approach combines a boundary-regression loss that promotes accurate temporal localization via a single-channel boundary prediction and a CDF-based segment-level regularization loss that encourages coherent within-segment structure by matching cumulative distributions over predicted and ground-truth segments. The framework is architecture-agnostic and can be integrated into existing TAS models (e.g., MS-TCN, C2F-TCN, FACT) as a training-time loss function. Across three benchmark datasets, the proposed method improves segment-level consistency and boundary quality, yielding higher F1 and Edit scores across three different models. Frame-wise accuracy remains largely unchanged, highlighting that precise segmentation can be achieved through simple loss design rather than heavier architectures or inference-time refinements.

摘要（中文）: 近期时序动作分割领域的研究日益依赖复杂架构，这可能会阻碍实际应用部署。我们提出了一种轻量级双损失训练框架，仅需增加一个输出通道和两个辅助损失项即可提升细粒度分割质量，且对架构改动极小。该方法结合了边界回归损失与基于累积分布函数的片段级正则化损失：前者通过单通道边界预测提升时序定位精度，后者通过匹配预测片段与真实片段的累积分布来增强片段内部结构的一致性。该框架与具体架构无关，可作为训练时损失函数集成到现有时序动作分割模型（如MS-TCN、C2F-TCN、FACT）中。在三个基准数据集上的实验表明，该方法有效提升了片段一致性与边界质量，在三种不同模型上均实现了更高的F1分数和编辑分数。帧级精度基本保持不变，这证明通过简明的损失设计即可实现精确分割，无需依赖复杂架构或推理阶段的优化策略。

TLDR: This paper introduces a lightweight dual-loss training framework for Temporal Action Segmentation (TAS), improving boundary quality and segment-level consistency with minimal architectural changes. It is a vision method focused on fine-grained video understanding, not on robotics or embodied agents.

简要说明: 本文提出了一种用于时序动作分割的轻量级双损失训练框架，通过最小化架构修改来提升边界质量和段内一致性。这是一种专注于细粒度视频理解的视觉方法，不涉及机器人或具身智能体。

Authors: Hinako Mitsuoka, Kazuhiro Hotta

Enhanced Polarization Locking in VCSELs

Abstract (English): While optical injection locking (OIL) of vertical-cavity surface-emitting lasers (VCSELs) has been widely studied in the past, the polarization dynamics of OIL have received far less attention. Recent studies suggest that polarization locking via OIL could enable novel computational applications such as polarization-encoded Ising computers. However, the inherent polarization preference and limited polarization switchability of VCSELs hinder their use for such purposes. To address these challenges, we fabricate VCSELs with tailored oxide aperture designs and combine these with bias current tuning to study the overall impact on polarization locking. Experimental results demonstrate that this approach reduces the required injection power (to as low as 3.6 μW) and expands the locking range. To investigate the impact of the approach, the spin-flip model (SFM) is used to analyze the effects of amplitude anisotropy and bias current on polarization locking, demonstrating strong coherence with experimental results.

摘要（中文）: 虽然垂直腔面发射激光器（VCSEL）的光注入锁定技术在过去已得到广泛研究，但其偏振动力学特性却鲜有关注。近期研究表明，通过光注入锁定实现偏振锁定可应用于偏振编码伊辛计算机等新型计算领域。然而，VCSEL固有的偏振偏好与有限的偏振切换能力阻碍了其在此类应用中的发展。为应对这些挑战，我们制备了具有定制氧化孔径设计的VCSEL器件，并结合偏置电流调谐技术，系统研究了其对偏振锁定的综合影响。实验结果表明，该方法能显著降低所需注入功率（最低至3.6 μW）并扩大锁定范围。为深入探究该方法的机理，我们采用自旋翻转模型分析振幅各向异性和偏置电流对偏振锁定的影响，理论结果与实验数据呈现出高度一致性。

TLDR: This paper presents a study on enhancing polarization locking in vertical-cavity surface-emitting lasers (VCSELs) through tailored oxide aperture designs and bias current tuning, aimed at enabling novel computational applications like polarization-encoded Ising computers.

简要说明: 本研究通过定制氧化物孔径设计和偏置电流调谐来增强垂直腔面发射激光器（VCSEL）的偏振锁定，旨在实现偏振编码伊辛计算机等新型计算应用。

Authors: Zifeng Yuan, Dewen Zhang, Lei Shi, Yutong Liu, Aaron Danner

Ranking-Guided Semi-Supervised Domain Adaptation for Severity Classification

Abstract (English): Semi-supervised domain adaptation leverages a few labeled and many unlabeled target samples, making it promising for addressing domain shifts in medical image analysis. However, existing methods struggle with severity classification due to unclear class boundaries. Severity classification involves naturally ordered class labels, complicating adaptation. We propose a novel method that aligns source and target domains using rank scores learned via ranking with class order. Specifically, Cross-Domain Ranking ranks sample pairs across domains, while Continuous Distribution Alignment aligns rank score distributions. Experiments on ulcerative colitis and diabetic retinopathy classification validate the effectiveness of our approach, demonstrating successful alignment of class-specific rank score distributions.

摘要（中文）: 半监督域自适应方法利用少量标注目标样本和大量未标注目标样本，使其在解决医学图像分析中的域偏移问题上展现出广阔前景。然而，现有方法因类别边界模糊在严重程度分级任务中面临挑战。严重程度分级涉及天然有序的类别标签，这增加了域适应的复杂性。本文提出一种新颖方法，通过引入类别顺序的排序机制学习秩得分，从而实现源域与目标域的对齐。具体而言，跨域排序模块对跨域样本对进行排序，而连续分布对齐模块则实现秩得分分布的对齐。在溃疡性结肠炎和糖尿病视网膜病变分级任务上的实验验证了我们方法的有效性，成功实现了针对特定类别的秩得分分布对齐。

TLDR: Proposes a ranking-guided semi-supervised domain adaptation method for severity classification in medical images, using cross-domain ranking and continuous distribution alignment to handle ordered class labels.

简要说明: 提出了一种用于医学图像严重程度分类的排序引导半监督域适应方法，通过跨域排序和连续分布对齐处理有序类别标签。

Authors: Shota Harada, Ryoma Bise, Kiyohito Tanaka, Seiichi Uchida

SafeRoPE: Risk-specific Head-wise Embedding Rotation for Safe Generation in Rectified Flow Transformers

Abstract (English): Recent Text-to-Image (T2I) models based on rectified-flow transformers (e.g., SD3, FLUX) achieve high generative fidelity but remain vulnerable to unsafe semantics, especially when triggered by multi-token interactions. Existing mitigation methods largely rely on fine-tuning or attention modulation for concept unlearning; however, their expensive computational overhead and design tailored to U-Net-based denoisers hinder direct adaptation to transformer-based diffusion models (e.g., MMDiT). In this paper, we conduct an in-depth analysis of the attention mechanism in MMDiT and find that unsafe semantics concentrate within interpretable, low-dimensional subspaces at head level, where a finite set of safety-critical heads is responsible for unsafe feature extraction. We further observe that perturbing the Rotary Positional Embedding (RoPE) applied to the query and key vectors can effectively modify some specific concepts in the generated images. Motivated by these insights, we propose SafeRoPE, a lightweight and fine-grained safe generation framework for MMDiT. Specifically, SafeRoPE first constructs head-wise unsafe subspaces by decomposing unsafe embeddings within safety-critical heads, and computes a Latent Risk Score (LRS) for each input vector via projection onto these subspaces. We then introduce head-wise RoPE perturbations that can suppress unsafe semantics without degrading benign content or image quality. SafeRoPE combines both head-wise LRS and RoPE perturbations to perform risk-specific head-wise rotation on query and key vector embeddings, enabling precise suppression of unsafe outputs while maintaining generation fidelity. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SafeRoPE achieves SOTA performance in balancing effective harmful content mitigation and utility preservation for safe generation of MMDiT. Codes are available at https://github.com/deng12yx/SafeRoPE.

摘要（中文）: 基于整流流变换器（如SD3、FLUX）的文本到图像生成模型近期在生成保真度上取得了显著成就，但对不安全语义的鲁棒性依然较弱，尤其当面临多词元交互的触发时。现有缓解方法主要依赖微调或注意力调节以进行概念消除，但其高昂计算成本及专为U-Net去噪器设计的架构，阻碍了它们直接适配于基于变换器的扩散模型（如MMDiT）。本文深入分析了MMDiT中的注意力机制，发现不安全语义集中于注意力头层面的可解释低维子空间中，其中有限的一组安全关键头负责不安全特征提取。进一步研究显示，扰动应用于查询和键向量的旋转位置编码可有效修改生成图像中的特定概念。基于此发现，我们提出轻量化细粒度安全生成框架SafeRoPE。该方法首先通过分解安全关键头中的不安全嵌入来构建头级不安全子空间，并通过将输入向量投影至这些子空间计算潜在风险评分。随后，我们引入头级RoPE扰动以抑制不安全语义，同时保持良性内容与图像质量不受影响。SafeRoPE结合头级潜在风险评分与RoPE扰动，对查询和键向量嵌入执行风险感知的头级旋转操作，实现精准抑制不安全输出并维持生成保真度。大量实验表明，SafeRoPE在平衡有害内容消除与效用保持方面达到了当前最优性能。代码已开源。

TLDR: Proposes a lightweight method for making transformer-based diffusion models (MMDiT) safe by perturbing rotary positional embeddings in unsafe attention heads, suppressing harmful content while preserving image quality.

简要说明: 提出一种轻量级方法，通过扰动不安全注意力头中的旋转位置嵌入（RoPE），使基于Transformer的扩散模型（MMDiT）生成安全内容，在抑制有害信息的同时保持图像质量。

Authors: Xiang Yang, Feifei Li, Mi Zhang, Geng Hong, Xiaoyu You, Min Yang

Ultrasound-CLIP: Semantic-Aware Contrastive Pre-training for Ultrasound Image-Text Understanding

Abstract (English): Ultrasound imaging is widely used in clinical diagnostics due to its real-time capability and radiation-free nature. However, existing vision-language pre-training models, such as CLIP, are primarily designed for other modalities, and are difficult to directly apply to ultrasound data, which exhibit heterogeneous anatomical structures and diverse diagnostic attributes. To bridge this gap, we construct US-365K, a large-scale ultrasound image-text dataset containing 365k paired samples across 52 anatomical categories. We establish Ultrasonographic Diagnostic Taxonomy (UDT) containing two hierarchical knowledge frameworks. Ultrasonographic Hierarchical Anatomical Taxonomy standardizes anatomical organization, and Ultrasonographic Diagnostic Attribute Framework formalizes nine diagnostic dimensions, including body system, organ, diagnosis, shape, margins, echogenicity, internal characteristics, posterior acoustic phenomena, and vascularity. Building upon these foundations, we propose Ultrasound-CLIP, a semantic-aware contrastive learning framework that introduces semantic soft labels and semantic loss to refine sample discrimination. Moreover, we construct a heterogeneous graph modality derived from UDAF's textual representations, enabling structured reasoning over lesion-attribute relations. Extensive experiments with patient-level data splitting demonstrate that our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance on classification and retrieval benchmarks, while also delivering strong generalization to zero-shot, linear probing, and fine-tuning tasks.

摘要（中文）: 超声成像因其实时性和无辐射特性，在临床诊断中被广泛应用。然而，现有视觉-语言预训练模型（如CLIP）主要针对其他模态设计，难以直接适用于呈现异质解剖结构和多样化诊断属性的超声数据。为弥合这一差距，我们构建了US-365K大规模超声图文数据集，涵盖52个解剖类别共36.5万组配对样本。我们建立了包含两个层次化知识框架的超声诊断分类体系（UDT）：超声层次化解剖分类体系规范了组织结构，超声诊断属性框架则形式化了包括身体系统、器官、诊断结论、形状、边缘、回声特性、内部特征、后方声学现象及血管分布在内的九个诊断维度。基于此，我们提出语义感知对比学习框架Ultrasound-CLIP，通过引入语义软标签和语义损失函数优化样本区分能力。此外，我们构建了基于超声诊断属性框架文本表征的异构图模态，实现对病灶-属性关系的结构化推理。采用患者级数据划分的广泛实验表明，该方法在分类与检索基准测试中达到最先进性能，同时在零样本学习、线性探测和微调任务中展现出强大的泛化能力。

TLDR: The paper introduces Ultrasound-CLIP, a semantic-aware contrastive learning framework pre-trained on a large-scale ultrasound image-text dataset, designed for medical image understanding and diagnostic tasks.

简要说明: 本文提出了Ultrasound-CLIP，一个基于大规模超声图像-文本数据集的语义感知对比学习框架，专为医学图像理解和诊断任务而设计。

Authors: Jiayun Jin, Haolong Chai, Xueying Huang, Xiaoqing Guo, Zengwei Zheng, Zhan Zhou, Junmei Wang, Xinyu Wang, Jie Liu, Binbin Zhou

SteerFlow: Steering Rectified Flows for Faithful Inversion-Based Image Editing

Abstract (English): Recent advances in flow-based generative models have enabled training-free, text-guided image editing by inverting an image into its latent noise and regenerating it under a new target conditional guidance. However, existing methods struggle to preserve source fidelity: higher-order solvers incur additional model inferences, truncated inversion constrains editability, and feature injection methods lack architectural transferability. To address these limitations, we propose SteerFlow, a model-agnostic editing framework with strong theoretical guarantees on source fidelity. In the forward process, we introduce an Amortized Fixed-Point Solver that implicitly straightens the forward trajectory by enforcing velocity consistency across consecutive timesteps, yielding a high-fidelity inverted latent. In the backward process, we introduce Trajectory Interpolation, which adaptively blends target-editing and source-reconstruction velocities to keep the editing trajectory anchored to the source. To further improve background preservation, we introduce an Adaptive Masking mechanism that spatially constrains the editing signal with concept-guided segmentation and source-target velocity differences. Extensive experiments on FLUX.1-dev and Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium demonstrate that SteerFlow consistently achieves better editing quality than existing methods. Finally, we show that SteerFlow extends naturally to a complex multi-turn editing paradigm without accumulating drift.

摘要（中文）: 基于流的生成模型近期取得了重要进展，通过将图像反演至隐空间噪声并在新目标条件引导下重建，实现了无需训练即可进行文本引导的图像编辑。然而，现有方法难以保持源图像保真度：高阶求解器需要额外模型推理，截断反演限制了可编辑性，而特征注入方法缺乏架构通用性。针对这些局限，我们提出SteerFlow——一个具有强理论保真度保证的模型无关编辑框架。在前向过程中，我们引入"摊销定点求解器"，通过强制相邻时间步间的速度一致性，隐式地拉直前向轨迹，从而获得高保真度的反演隐向量。在反向过程中，我们提出"轨迹插值"方法，自适应混合目标编辑速度与源重建速度，使编辑轨迹始终锚定源图像。为进一步提升背景保留效果，我们引入"自适应掩码机制"，利用概念引导的分割和源-目标速度差对编辑信号进行空间约束。在FLUX.1-dev和Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium上的大量实验表明，SteerFlow在编辑质量上持续优于现有方法。最后，我们展示了该框架可自然扩展到复杂多轮次编辑场景，且不会产生漂移累积。

TLDR: A method for improving text-guided image editing by inverting and steering flow-based generative models to better preserve source fidelity during edits.

简要说明: 一种通过反转和引导基于流的生成模型，在文本引导的图像编辑中更好地保持源图像保真度的方法。

Authors: Thinh Dao, Zhen Wang, Kien T. Pham, Long Chen

Bias mitigation in graph diffusion models

Abstract (English): Most existing graph diffusion models have significant bias problems. We observe that the forward diffusion's maximum perturbation distribution in most models deviates from the standard Gaussian distribution, while reverse sampling consistently starts from a standard Gaussian distribution, which results in a reverse-starting bias. Together with the inherent exposure bias of diffusion models, this results in degraded generation quality. This paper proposes a comprehensive approach to mitigate both biases. To mitigate reverse-starting bias, we employ a newly designed Langevin sampling algorithm to align with the forward maximum perturbation distribution, establishing a new reverse-starting point. To address the exposure bias, we introduce a score correction mechanism based on a newly defined score difference. Our approach, which requires no network modifications, is validated across multiple models, datasets, and tasks, achieving state-of-the-art results.Code is at https://github.com/kunzhan/spp

摘要（中文）: 现有的大多数图扩散模型存在显著的偏差问题。我们观察到，在多数模型中，前向扩散的最大扰动分布偏离标准高斯分布，而反向采样却始终从标准高斯分布开始，这导致了反向起点偏差。结合扩散模型固有的曝光偏差问题，这些因素共同导致了生成质量的下降。本文提出了一种综合方法来缓解这两种偏差。为减少反向起点偏差，我们采用了一种新设计的Langevin采样算法，使其与前向最大扰动分布保持一致，从而建立新的反向起始点。针对曝光偏差问题，我们引入了一种基于新定义的分数差异的分数校正机制。该方法无需修改网络结构，在多个模型、数据集和任务中得到验证，并取得了最先进的结果。代码已发布于https://github.com/kunzhan/spp。

TLDR: This paper proposes a method to mitigate bias issues in graph diffusion models, focusing on reverse-starting bias and exposure bias, improving generation quality without modifying network architecture.

简要说明: 本文提出了一种缓解图扩散模型中偏差问题的方法，重点解决反向起始偏差和曝光偏差，在不修改网络架构的情况下提高生成质量。

Authors: Meng Yu, Kun Zhan

HOT: Harmonic-Constrained Optimal Transport for Remote Photoplethysmography Domain Adaptation

Abstract (English): Remote photoplethysmography (rPPG) enables non-contact physiological measurement from facial videos; however, its practical deployment is often hindered by substantial performance degradation under domain shift. While recent deep learning-based rPPG methods have achieved strong performance on individual datasets, they frequently overfit to appearance-related factors, such as illumination, camera characteristics, and color response, that vary significantly across domains. To address this limitation, we introduce frequency domain adaptation (FDA) as a principled strategy for modeling appearance variation in rPPG. By transferring low-frequency spectral components that encode domain-dependent appearance characteristics, FDA encourages rPPG models to learn invariance to appearance variations while retaining cardiac-induced signals. To further support physiologically consistent alignment under such appearance variation, we propose Harmonic-Constrained Optimal Transport (HOT), which leverages the harmonic property of cardiac signals to guide alignment between original and FDA-transferred representations. Extensive cross-dataset experiments demonstrate that the proposed FDA and HOT framework effectively enhances the robustness and generalization of rPPG models across diverse datasets.

摘要（中文）: 远程光电容积描记法（rPPG）能够通过面部视频实现非接触式生理测量，但其实际应用常因领域偏移导致的性能显著下降而受阻。尽管近期基于深度学习的rPPG方法在独立数据集上取得了优异表现，但这些方法往往过度拟合于外观相关因素，如光照、摄像机特性和色彩响应等，这些因素在不同领域间存在显著差异。为解决这一局限，我们提出频域适应（FDA）作为一种原则性策略，用于建模rPPG中的外观变化。通过迁移编码领域相关外观特征的低频频谱分量，FDA促使rPPG模型学习对外观变化的不变性，同时保留心脏诱导信号。为进一步支持在外观变化下保持生理一致性的对齐，我们提出谐波约束最优传输（HOT），该方法利用心脏信号的谐波特性来指导原始表示与FDA迁移表示之间的对齐。跨数据集的广泛实验表明，所提出的FDA与HOT框架有效增强了rPPG模型在不同数据集间的鲁棒性与泛化能力。

TLDR: This paper proposes a frequency domain adaptation method and harmonic-constrained optimal transport framework to improve the generalization of remote photoplethysmography models across different datasets, focusing on appearance variation.

简要说明: 本文提出了一种频率域适应方法和谐波约束的最优传输框架，旨在提高远程光电容积描记技术模型在不同数据集上的泛化能力，主要解决外观变化问题。

Authors: Ba-Thinh Nguyen, Thi-Duyen Ngo, Thanh-Trung Huynh, Thanh-Ha Le, Huy-Hieu Pham

Mitigating the ID-OOD Tradeoff in Open-Set Test-Time Adaptation

Abstract (English): Open-set test-time adaptation (OSTTA) addresses the challenge of adapting models to new environments where out-of-distribution (OOD) samples coexist with in-distribution (ID) samples affected by distribution shifts. In such settings, covariate shift-for example, changes in weather conditions such as snow-can alter ID samples, reducing model reliability. Consequently, models must not only correctly classify covariate-shifted ID (csID) samples but also effectively reject covariate-shifted OOD (csOOD) samples. Entropy minimization is a common strategy in test-time adaptation to maintain ID performance under distribution shifts, while entropy maximization is widely applied to enhance OOD detection. Several studies have sought to combine these objectives to tackle the challenges of OSTTA. However, the intrinsic conflict between entropy minimization and maximization inevitably leads to a trade-off between csID classification and csOOD detection. In this paper, we first analyze the limitations of entropy maximization in OSTTA and then introduce an angular loss to regulate feature norm magnitudes, along with a feature-norm loss to suppress csOOD logits, thereby improving OOD detection. These objectives form ROSETTA, a $\underline{r}$obust $\underline{o}$pen-$\underline{se}$t $\underline{t}$est-$\underline{t}$ime $\underline{a}$daptation. Our method achieves strong OOD detection while maintaining high ID classification performance on CIFAR-10-C, CIFAR-100-C, Tiny-ImageNet-C and ImageNet-C. Furthermore, experiments on the Cityscapes validate the method's effectiveness in real-world semantic segmentation, and results on the HAC dataset demonstrate its applicability across different open-set TTA setups.

摘要（中文）: 开放集测试时适应（OSTTA）旨在解决模型在新环境下的适应挑战，其中分布外样本与受分布偏移影响的分布内样本共存。在此类场景中，协变量偏移（例如天气条件变化，如积雪）可能改变分布内样本，从而降低模型可靠性。因此，模型不仅需要正确分类协变量偏移的分布内样本，还必须有效拒绝协变量偏移的分布外样本。熵最小化是测试时适应中保持分布内性能的常用策略，而熵最大化则被广泛应用于增强分布外检测。已有若干研究尝试结合这两种目标以应对OSTTA的挑战。然而，熵最小化与最大化之间的内在矛盾不可避免地导致了对协变量偏移分布内样本分类与协变量偏移分布外样本检测之间的权衡。本文首先分析了熵最大化在OSTTA中的局限性，随后引入角度损失以调节特征范数大小，并结合特征范数损失以抑制协变量偏移分布外样本的logit值，从而提升分布外检测能力。这些目标共同构成了ROSETTA方法——一种鲁棒的开放集测试时适应框架。该方法在CIFAR-10-C、CIFAR-100-C、Tiny-ImageNet-C和ImageNet-C数据集上实现了强大的分布外检测能力，同时保持了高水平的分布内分类性能。此外，在Cityscapes数据集上的实验验证了该方法在真实世界语义分割任务中的有效性，而HAC数据集上的结果则证明了其在不同开放集测试时适应配置中的广泛适用性。

TLDR: This paper introduces ROSETTA, a method for Open-Set Test-Time Adaptation that aims to improve both in-distribution classification and out-of-distribution detection under covariate shift, with experiments on image classification benchmarks and semantic segmentation tasks.

简要说明: 本文提出了一种名为ROSETTA的开集测试时适应方法，旨在改善协变量偏移下的分布内分类和分布外检测性能，并在图像分类基准和语义分割任务上进行了实验验证。

Authors: Wenjie Zhao, Jia Li, Xin Dong, Yapeng Tian, Yu Xiang, Yunhui Guo

Satellite-Free Training for Drone-View Geo-Localization

Abstract (English): Drone-view geo-localization (DVGL) aims to determine the location of drones in GPS-denied environments by retrieving the corresponding geotagged satellite tile from a reference gallery given UAV observations of a location. In many existing formulations, these observations are represented by a single oblique UAV image. In contrast, our satellite-free setting is designed for multi-view UAV sequences, which are used to construct a geometry-normalized UAV-side location representation before cross-view retrieval. Existing approaches rely on satellite imagery during training, either through paired supervision or unsupervised alignment, which limits practical deployment when satellite data are unavailable or restricted. In this paper, we propose a satellite-free training (SFT) framework that converts drone imagery into cross-view compatible representations through three main stages: drone-side 3D scene reconstruction, geometry-based pseudo-orthophoto generation, and satellite-free feature aggregation for retrieval. Specifically, we first reconstruct dense 3D scenes from multi-view drone images using 3D Gaussian splatting and project the reconstructed geometry into pseudo-orthophotos via PCA-guided orthographic projection. This rendering stage operates directly on reconstructed scene geometry without requiring camera parameters at rendering time. Next, we refine these orthophotos with lightweight geometry-guided inpainting to obtain texture-complete drone-side views. Finally, we extract DINOv3 patch features from the generated orthophotos, learn a Fisher vector aggregation model solely from drone data, and reuse it at test time to encode satellite tiles for cross-view retrieval. Experimental results on University-1652 and SUES-200 show that our SFT framework substantially outperforms satellite-free generalization baselines and narrows the gap to methods trained with satellite imagery.

摘要（中文）: 无人机视角地理定位（DVGL）的目标是在无GPS环境下，通过无人机对某位置的观测数据，从参考图库中检索出对应的地理标记卫星图块，从而确定无人机的位置。许多现有方法中，这些观测数据仅以单张倾斜无人机图像表示。与此不同，我们提出的无卫星数据设定专为多视角无人机序列设计，这类序列在跨视图检索前用于构建几何归一化的无人机端位置表示。现有方法在训练过程中依赖卫星图像，无论是通过配对监督还是无监督对齐，这在卫星数据不可用或受限时限制了实际部署。本文提出一种无卫星训练（SFT）框架，通过三个阶段将无人机图像转换为跨视图兼容的表示：无人机端三维场景重建、基于几何的伪正射影像生成以及用于检索的无卫星特征聚合。具体而言，我们首先利用三维高斯泼溅技术从多视角无人机图像重建稠密三维场景，并通过PCA引导的正射投影将重建的几何结构投影为伪正射影像。该渲染阶段直接在重建的场景几何上操作，无需渲染时的相机参数。随后，我们采用轻量级几何引导修复技术优化这些正射影像，以获取纹理完整的无人机端视图。最后，我们从生成的正射影像中提取DINOv3图像块特征，仅使用无人机数据学习费舍尔向量聚合模型，并在测试时复用该模型对卫星图块进行编码以实现跨视图检索。在University-1652和SUES-200数据集上的实验结果表明，我们的SFT框架显著优于无卫星泛化基线方法，并缩小了与使用卫星图像训练方法之间的性能差距。

TLDR: This paper proposes a satellite-free training framework for drone-view geo-localization, using 3D reconstruction and pseudo-orthophoto generation to enable cross-view retrieval without satellite imagery during training.

简要说明: 本文提出了一种无人机视图地理定位的无卫星训练框架，利用3D重建和伪正射影像生成，实现在训练期间无需卫星图像的跨视图检索。
